2. engine.js:21-24 — `TRIM` is the single source of truth; otherwise the timeline is built on the full blob while only the trimmed part is heard, and captions desync from picture.
3. engine.js:46-48 — the `'+0%'` volume string lost its sign and became `0.9`; number `volumeNum` takes priority (100 = unity).
4. engine.js:215-217 / app.js:446-448 / ocr.js:104 — vision OCR returns no bboxes; a bubble without coords is **always** rendered as a bottom caption and never zoomed to. Inventing a rect is forbidden.
5. engine.js:303-305 — user-cut clips carry `audio.noTrim === true`; trimming them again desynchronises `seg.duration` from the audio.
6. engine.js:455-461 — a `suspended` AudioContext does not advance `currentTime`; the clock freezes, the frame loop never exits and MediaRecorder never stops. `resume()` is mandatory, and if it fails the whole render aborts.
7. engine.js:474-476 — watchdog `rec.stop()` at `(total+20)*1000` for a stuck clock / missing timeline element.
8. engine.js:490-492 — `currentItem` can return `undefined` on an empty timeline; without an explicit `rec.stop()` the recording hung forever.
9. engine.js:561-563 — music loop `step` must be `> 0`, else `pos` never grows and the loop never ends.
10. engine.js:625-628 — the worker FS is reused; a 100 MB video otherwise accumulates in RAM until page reload ⟹ `deleteFile` after every job.
11. engine.js:631-634 — one FFmpeg instance per page (core ≈ 32 MB, each recreate re-parses the wasm).
12. engine.js:663-664 — conversions strictly serialized; the worker has a single FS and two parallel `exec` calls mix in/out files.
13. util.js:11-14 — `nowEdgeString` must keep the RFC-1123 comma and must not append `Z` after the parens; two incompatible formats used to coexist in one connection.
14. util.js:37-39 — `typeof crypto !== 'undefined'` guard (direct `crypto` access threw `ReferenceError`).
15. util.js:204 — `padSamples` must be computed in **samples**, not bytes.
16. util.js:243-247 — a signal ending while "active" must still flush the tail segment (regression-tested, smoke.mjs:196-203).
17. voices.js:231-236 — Edge binary frames carry a `u16` header-length prefix plus 2 trailing bytes; payload starts at `2 + hl + 2`.
18. voices.js:133-136 — `User-Agent` cannot be set in `fetch` (forbidden header name), so Chromium UA spoofing was dead code; identity is `Sec-MS-GEC` only.
19. voices.js:182 — `WebSocket` must be opened **without** a subprotocol (server answers 403).
20. voices.js:167-170 — `xml:lang` from the voice; hardcoded `en-US` made ru/ja voices read with an English prosody.
21. app.js:623-631 — clip-take distribution was `segs[i % segs.length]` with `i` over **all** book lines (two heroes got the same cut at the same position); now per-role order with `bubble.clipSeg` manual override.
22. app.js:1200-1204 — `bindSettings()` is re-run on import/reset; without the one-shot guard each handler duplicated and triggered N re-renders.
23. app.js:1548 / 292 — page `w/h` are backfilled from the decoded image; `0` would poison `resolveCanvas('auto')` (hence `|| 1` fallbacks in `cameraFor`).
24. sw.js:40 — a previous-version cache must be served outside `waitUntil` (navigation must not be blocked).

### Port-critical divergences to decide
- Web path is rAF-clock + `captureStream(fps)`; MediaCodec wants deterministic PTS `k/fps`. Use `total` rounded up to a whole frame count for the last frame.
- Web path mixes audio in real time through WebAudio; native should pre-render the whole bus to PCM (reuse §6 math exactly) and feed MediaCodec — that also makes the `min(pb.dur, it.dur+0.1)` cap and the `+0.1 s` tail deterministic.

  1. `trimSilence(samples, sr)` — util.js:200, its own defaults `{threshold=0.02, margin=0.09, winMs=10}`: peak-window scan in 10 ms windows, first/last window with `peak > 0.02`, padded by `margin*sr` samples; all-silence ⇒ `{start:0,end:0}`.
  2. `sliceSegments(samples.subarray(tStart,tEnd), sr, {threshold, minSilence, minClip, maxClip})` — util.js:215, its **own** `winMs=40` is used (not forwarded): per-40 ms-window RMS activity `= mean(v²) > threshold²`, `minSil = max(1, floor(minSilence/0.04)) = 8` windows (0.32 s), segments emitted when `e-s >= minClip (0.3)` and clamped to `s+maxClip (16 s)`; flushed at end if still active. Returns `[{startS, endS}]`.
  3. Remap to original signal coordinates: `.map(s => ({startS: s.startS + tStart/sr, endS: s.endS + tStart/sr}))`.
  4. `onProgress(1, 'Нарезка выполнена')`; returns `{url, duration, sr, segs, samples}`.
- `importAudio` (app.js:250-271): `setProgress(0.15, `Декод ${file.name}…`)`, then `setProgress(0.9,'Нарезка по тишине…')`; each seg → `{startS, endS, duration: endS-startS, blob: samplesToWav(samples.subarray(floor(startS*sr), floor(endS*sr)), sr)}`.
- `samplesToWav` (app.js:273-286): **WAV 16-bit PCM MONO at the source `sr` (no resample)**, clamp ±1, `v<0 ? v*0x8000 : v*0x7fff`, 44-byte canonical RIFF/WAVE header, `Blob{type:'audio/wav'}`.
- Clip model: `{id: uuid(), name: file.name, url: objectURL, duration, sr, count: segBlobs.length, segs: segBlobs}`.
- **Video:** treated as audio only. `isAudioFile` returns true for `video/*` and VIDEO_EXT, so an `.mp4/.mkv/.mov/.avi/.m4v/.webm` goes through the same `clipsFromAudio` → `decodeAudioData`; there is **no demuxing, no frame extraction, no video background track**. ffmpeg.wasm (`@ffmpeg/ffmpeg@0.12.10` + `@ffmpeg/core@0.12.6`) is used **only at export**: `['-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','23','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-c:a','aac','-b:a','160k','-movflags','+faststart']`, MP3 `-codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 4`, GIF `-vf fps=12,scale=480:-1:flags=lanczos`. Mix/render rate is fixed `sr = 44100` (engine.js:527) with `resampleLinear`; render silence trim `TRIM = {threshold:0.012, margin:0.05, minDur:0.25}` (engine.js:24). MediaRecorder bitrate `min(16e6, w*h*fps*0.14)`, mimes tried in order `video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus`, `vp8,opus`, `vp9`, `webm`.

## 5. OCR — local (Tesseract.js 5.1.1) → ML Kit
- **Preprocessing = scale only.** `makeCanvas(url, maxDim=1600)` (ocr.js:43-51): `loadImage(url)` → `scale = Math.min(1, 1600/Math.max(naturalWidth, naturalHeight||1))` (**downscale only, never upscale**), `c.width = max(1, round(w*scale))`, `c.height = max(1, round(h*scale))`, `drawImage(img,0,0,c.width,c.height)`. **No grayscale, no threshold/binarization, no contrast stretch, no denoise, no sharpening.** `onProgress(0.02)`.
- Worker (ocr.js:13-30): `Tesseract.createWorker(langs, 1, { logger })` — **OEM = 1 (LSTM_ONLY)**; `langs = Array.isArray(lang) ? lang.join('+') : lang`; single module-level worker cached, `terminate()`d and recreated whenever `langs` changes; `loadScript('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js@5.1.1/dist/tesseract.min.js')`; throw `'Tesseract не загружен (нет сети?)'`. Logger forwards **only** `m.status === 'recognizing text'` numeric `m.progress`.
- `worker.recognize(canvas)` — **no output options and no `setParameters` anywhere in the repo**. Effective engine defaults from tesseract.js worker: `tessedit_pageseg_mode = SINGLE_BLOCK ("6")`, `tessedit_char_whitelist: ''`, `tessjs_create_hocr/tsv: "1"`, output `{text:true, blocks:true, hocr:true, tsv:true, rest false}`.
- ⚠ **Bug to fix in the port:** 5.1.1 `data` has **no top-level `words`** (fields: `text,hocr,tsv,box,unlv,osd,pdf,imageColor,imageGrey,imageBinary,confidence,blocks,layoutBlocks,psm,oem,version,debug`). ocr.js:96 `data.words || []` is therefore always `[]` → whole-page Tesseract path currently yields **0 bubbles**. Correct source: `data.blocks[i].paragraphs[j].lines[k].words[l] = {text, confidence, bbox:{x0,y0,x1,y1}, baseline, is_bold, is_italic, font_name, font_size, is_serif, is_smallcaps, font_id, symbols, choices}`.
- `wordsToBubbles(words, pageW, pageH, {rtl, vertical})` (ocr.js:32-41): drop `!w.text || !String(w.text).trim()`; map → `{x:bbox.x0, y:bbox.y0, w:bbox.x1-bbox.x0, h:bbox.y1-bbox.y0, text:w.text, conf:w.confidence}`.
- **Coordinate space:** pixels of the ≤1600 px OCR canvas — the same space as `page.w/page.h` and bubble `x/y/w/h` (no normalization, no rotation).
- `clusterBubbleWords` (util.js:113-154): O(n²) union-find; `thrX = Math.max(14, pageW*0.055)`, `thrY = Math.max(12, pageH*0.028)`; merge when `gapX < thrX && gapY < thrY` (axis gaps `max(0, max(a0,b0)-min(a1,b1))`); bubble `rect:[minX,minY,maxX-minX,maxY-minY]` + `x,y,w,h`; words sorted `(a.y-b.y)||(a.x-b.x)`; `text = words.map(w=>w.text).join(' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()`; also returns `words` array.
- `sortBubblesReadingOrder(bubbles, {rtl, vertical, cols=2})` (util.js:160-184): `pageW = max(x+w) || 1`, `pageH = max(y+h) || 1`. `vertical`: `col = floor(x/(pageW/cols))`, sort by col (rtl ⇒ descending) then `y` then `x`. Non-vertical: **6 horizontal bands**, `band = Math.min(5, Math.floor((y + h/2)/(pageH/6)))`, sort by band asc then `x` asc (rtl ⇒ descending by `x+w`).
- Flags (ocr.js:97-98): `rtl = settings.rtl === true || lang==='jpn' || lang==='chi_sim' || lang==='kor'`; `vertical = lang==='jpn'`. (`settings.rtl` has no UI and is not in `defaultSettings()`.)
- Result: `{bubbles, raw: data.text || '', w: canvas.width, h: canvas.height, boxes: true}`.
- Languages (index.html `#opt-lang` / ocr.js:60): `rus, eng, chi_sim, jpn, kor, spa, fra, deu, por` → Tesseract codes identical; display names `{rus:'русский',eng:'английский',chi_sim:'китайский',jpn:'японский',kor:'корейский',spa:'испанский',fra:'французский',deu:'немецкий',por:'португальский'}`. `tesseractLanguages()` = `Object.keys((await Tesseract.initialize()).loadedLangs||{}).sort()`.
- **Preprocessing before OCR region crop:** `ocrRegion` (ocr.js:126-141) `c.width=max(1,round(b.w))`, `c.height=max(1,round(b.h))`, `drawImage(canvas, b.x, b.y, c.width, c.height, 0,0,c.width,c.height)`; tesseract → `data.text || ''`; vision → `toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9)` and `lines.join('\n')`.

## 6. OCR via AI vision (ocr.js:103-122 + ai.js:641-667)
- Trigger: `settings.ocr` is a provider id ≠ `'tesseract'` (the `#opt-ocr` select = `'tesseract'` + all `providerHasVision` providers, curated→keyless→`localeCompare(name,'ru')`).
- Image: `canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85)` → `data:image/jpeg;base64,…` (`ocrRegion` uses **0.9**). `vsettings = {...settings, ai: settings.ocr}`. `onProgress(0.2)` → call → `onProgress(0.9)`.
- **Prompt (verbatim, `langName` interpolated):**
  `Прочитай весь текст на этом изображении (${langName}). Это страница манги/комикса. Верни строго JSON массив строк в том порядке, в котором их нужно читать. Внутри double quotes. Не добавляй ничего кроме JSON.`
- Gemini (`chatGeminiVision`, ai.js:622): `POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${settings.aimodel||'gemini-2.0-flash'}:generateContent?key=…`; body `{contents:[{parts:[{text:prompt},{inline_data:{mime_type, data}}]}]}`; `mime_type = dataURL.split(';base64,')[0].split(':')[1] || 'image/jpeg'`; reply = `j.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map(p=>p.text).join('') || ''`.
- Anthropic (`chatAnthropicVision`, ai.js:669): headers `x-api-key`, `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`; body `{model: settings.aimodel||'claude-sonnet-4-5', max_tokens: 4096, messages:[{role:'user',content:[{type:'text',text:prompt},{type:'image',source:{type:'base64',media_type,data}}]}]}`; reply = `(j.content||[]).map(x=>x.text).join('')`; regex `^data:([^;]+);base64,(.*)$` else `{type:'image',source:{type:'url',url:dataURL}}`.
- OpenAI-compatible (`openAICompat`): `messages:[{role:'user',content:[{type:'text',text:prompt},{type:'image_url',image_url:{url:dataURL}}]}]`, `gap: settings.aiGap ?? 4000`.
- Expected shape: **plain JSON array of strings** (no bbox). Parse/repair `parseJsonLoose(s)` (ai.js:382-391): `trim` → `JSON.parse` → else first `/\{[\s\S]*\}/` → else first `/\[[\s\S]*\]/` → else `null`. Then `Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.filter(s => s && String(s).trim()) : String(out).split('\n').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)`.
- `ocrRegion` accepts array or string (`Array.isArray(lines) ? lines.join('\n') : String(lines||'')`).
- Bubbles: `rows = Math.max(1, lines.length)`; each → `{id: uuid(), text, tr:'', roleId:'', x:null, y:null, w:null, h:null, order: i/rows}`; returns `{bubbles, raw: lines.join('\n'), w: W, h: H, boxes:false}` — no invented 5×N grid.

## 7. Bubble detection before OCR (YOLO ONNX, yolo.js)
- `detectBubbles` used when `settings.detect === 'yolo' || settings.bubbleDetect === 'yolo'` (default `detect:'yolo'`, app.js:46). `onProgress(0.05)`; `onProgress(0.05 + n*0.4)` for download; `onProgress(0.08,'первое скачивание модели облачков (~108МБ)…')`.
- Model `yolov8m-seg-bubble` — `https://huggingface.co/kitsumed/yolov8m_seg-speech-bubble/resolve/main/model_dynamic.onnx`, `size: 108982949`, `nPred: 37` (4 bbox + 1 cls + 32 mask), `imgsz: 640`; runtime `onnxruntime-web@1.20.1`, `executionProviders:['wasm']`; cached in IndexedDB key `model:bubbles:<modelId>` (+ `:meta`).
- `letterbox(img,640)`: `ratio = min(640/iw, 640/ih)`, `nw/nh = max(1,round(iw*ratio))`, `dx/dy = round((640-n)/2)`, pad fill **`#808080`**, RGB `float32 /255` (no mean/std normalization), tensor `images: [1,3,640,640]`.
- `decode(pred, ratio, dx, dy, W, H)`: `sc = pred[4*N+j]`, drop `< CONF = 0.25`; `cx,cy,w,h = pred[0..3*N+j]`; `(cx±w/2-dx)/ratio`; clamp `x,y ≥ 0` and right/bottom to `W,H` ⇒ field names exactly `{x, y, w, h, conf}` in canvas px.
- `nms(dets)`: sort by `conf` desc, drop `w < 8 || h < 8`, suppress if `iou > IOU = 0.45`.
- Loop: `onProgress(0.45 + (i/boxes.length)*0.5, `OCR облачка ${i+1}/${boxes.length}`)`; bubble pushed as `{x:b.x, y:b.y, w:b.w, h:b.h, text: text.trim()}`; `raw += (raw?'\n':'')+text.trim()`; return only `if (bubbles.length)` → `{bubbles, raw, w:canvas.width, h:canvas.height, boxes:true}`. Any throw ⇒ `onProgress(0.45)`, `console.warn('yolo detect:', e.message)`, fall through to plain path (never fails the page).

## 8. Merge into script / engine consumers
- `ocrAll(goToScript)` (app.js:429-459) loops all pages, `lang = settings.lang`; per page: `p.bubbles = (res.bubbles||[]).map(b => ({id: b.id||uuid(), text: b.text, tr: b.tr||'', roleId: b.roleId||'', x: b.x, y: b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h, order: b.order}))`; `p.bubblesHaveBoxes = res.boxes !== false`; then `renderPagesGrid/renderScript/scriptStatus/autoSaveTimer`, `settab('script')`, `toast('OCR завершён')`.
- Bubble record (final): `{id, text, tr, roleId, x, y, w, h, order, audio:{blob,duration,noTrim?}}`. Manual add: `{id:uuid(), text:'', tr:'', roleId:'', x:10, y:10, w:120, h:40}`.
- `bubbleHasBox(b,page)` (engine.js:153): `page.bubblesHaveBoxes===false` ⇒ false; else `x!=null && y!=null && w>0 && h>0`. No box ⇒ no Ken-Burrs zoom and caption falls back: `mode = hasBox ? (settings.caption||'bubble') : (settings.caption==='none' ? 'none' : 'sub')`.
- Zoom math (`cameraFor`, engine.js:159-199): `cover = max(W/pw, H/ph)`; `pan` mode `crop = cover*1.15`; `smart` mode `zoomFrom = cover*1.2` → `zoomTo = cover*max(1, min(2.6, max(W/(b.w*1.3+1), H/(b.h*1.3+1))))` eased with smoothstep `a*a*(3-2a)` over `item.dur`; idle `cover*1.12`; all crop rects clamped to page.
- `buildTimeline` (engine.js:65-91): `gap = (settings.gap ?? 350)/1000`; page without bubbles ⇒ `{bubble:null, dur:1.8, kind:'idle'}`; with bubbles: `+0.55` in, per line `+0.25` (first) or `+gap`, `dur = b.audio?.duration || estimateSpeakDur(text)` = `max(1.1, min(14, len/13 + 0.55)) + (/\s/ ? 0.15 : 0)`, then `+gap*0.6`; `+0.5` between pages; `total = t + 0.9`.
- Status line: `Реплик: N · с ролью: N · озвучено: N/N · страниц: N`.
- Persistence: `projectForStore()` drops `url` (kept `file` Blob) → IndexedDB `voicecomic`/kv, keys `project`,`settings`; autoSave debounce 600 ms; QuotaExceeded text in §9.

## 9. Error handling / user-facing strings (verbatim, Russian)
Import (thrown by import.js, surfaced by `toast(e.message || String(e),'err')`):
- `Анализ файлов…` / `Анализ файла…` / `Загрузка картинки…` (progress)
- `Разбор ${files[f].name}…`, `Распаковка ${name}`, `Растеризация страницы ${i}/${doc.numPages}` (progress)
- `Не удалось загрузить PDF-движок`
- `Не удалось загрузить JSZip (нет сети?)`
- `Архив ${ext} не поддерживается: используйте ZIP/CBZ или RAR/CBR`  (covers `tar`,`7z`)
- `Формат не поддерживается для страниц: ${ext || 'без расширения'}`
- `Не удалось прочитать звук: ${e.message}`
- `Не получилось определить тип файлов` (err)
- `Аудио и изображения в одном списке: обработаны только страницы — загрузите по отдельнему` — exact template: `'Аудио и изображения в одном списке: обработаны только ' + (pageFiles.length ? 'страницы' : 'аудио') + ' — загрузите по отдельности'`
- `Добавлено страниц: ${project.pages.length}` (ok)
- `Звук нарезан на фразы` (ok); `Нарезка по тишине…`; `Нарезка выполнена`; `Декод ${file.name}…`
- `Нет нарезок` (err); `Нет фраз для музыки` (err); `Нарезанный клип → фоновая музыка` (ok)
- `Не удалось показать страницу` (page editor, if `loadImage` fails)
- Quota: `не хватило места в хранилище браузера. Выгрузите проект в JSON и удалите лишние страницы/нарезки`; also `Автосохранение: …`, `Ошибка сохранения: …`, `Сохранено в IndexedDB`.

OCR:
- `Tesseract не загружен (нет сети?)`
- `первое скачивание модели облачков (~108МБ)…`; `OCR облачка ${i+1}/${boxes.length}`; `OCR страницы ${i+1}/${n}…`; `OCR ${i+1}/${n}`; `стр. ${i}: ${res.bubbles.length} реплик`
- `Нет страниц` (err) when `ocrAll` runs with 0 pages
- `OCR: ${e.message}` (err, per page, then continues)
- `OCR завершён` (ok, always at the end)
- `Сначала получите текст (OCR)` (err, for `aiRoles` with no bubbles)
- YOLO: `модель ${id}: не задан URL`, `модель ${id}: HTTP ${status}`, `не удалось загрузить ${src}`, `Скачивание: ${e.message}`, `Модель облачков скачана`
- AI vision: `Gemini: нужен API-ключ (Опции → ИИ-провайдер → ключ)`, `Gemini vision ${status}`, `Claude: нужен API-ключ`, `Claude vision ${status}`
- Toast timing (util.js:382): `kind==='err'` → 6000 ms, else 2800 ms; classes `'' | 'ok' | 'err'`.

## 10. Port deltas to decide
1. Tesseract whole-page path is dead (`data.words`) — ML Kit `Text.TextBlock→Line→Element` with `boundingBox` gives the equivalent `{x,y,w,h,text,confidence}`; map Tesseract `bbox.x0..x1` → `Rect`.
2. `junrar` password support: JS hard-codes `''`; add a password dialog or explicit "0 pages extracted" warning (currently silent).
3. ZIP/RAR entries must be **magic-byte sniffed** (mime is not stored), and `guessMime` mislabels `jfif`/`jpg` as the fallback `image/jpeg`.
4. No EXIF rotation today — `ExifInterface` + `Matrix` post-rotation is required for parity of `page.w/h` and all bubble bboxes.
5. Scale limits: PDF ≤1900 px & ≤2.2× (158.4 dpi), JPEG q0.86, white background; OCR canvas ≤1600 px, vision JPEG 0.85 (page) / 0.9 (crop); hard cap 700 pages/file; no image downscaling at all.

## 0. Porting-critical facts up front
- **There is NO client-side streaming anywhere.** `chat()`/`chatWithImage()`/`visionExtractLines()` are all `fetch` → `r.json()`. Grep for `stream|event-stream|getReader` in `js/` matches only comments in ai.js. The **only SSE consumer is the Node relay** (it forces `stream:true` upstream, folds SSE to a plain JSON chat.completion). In Kotlin you either keep the relay's fold-then-return-JSON behaviour, or implement SSE yourself.
- Dispatch order in `chat()` (ai.js:401): `p.gemini` → `chatGemini`; `p.anthropic` → `chatAnthropic`; else `openAICompat`.
- Settings keys consumed: `ai` (pid), `aimodel`, `key`, `aiurl`, `aiGap` (default 2500), `zenRelay` (trailing slashes stripped). Defaults in `app.js:44-52`: `{ocr:'tesseract', detect:'yolo', lang:'rus', trlang:'ru', ai:'pollinations', key:'', aiurl:'', aimodel:'openai', aiGap:2500, zenRelay:'', voiceBackend:'edge', proxy:'', backendUrl:'', backendToken:'', …}`.

### Request/response shapes (exact)
**OpenAI-compat** (`openAICompat`, ai.js:469-506) — request body:
```json
{ "model": "<mid>", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"…"}], "temperature": 0.5,
  "response_format": {"type":"json_object"} }
```
- `temperatureFor(model, json)`: `json→0.1`; else `undefined` (field deleted) when `REASONING_MODELS = /^(o[1-9]\d*(\.\d+)?(-|$)|gpt-5|codex)/i` matches; else `0.5`.
- `response_format` only when `opts.json`; if HTTP **400** and body matches `/response_format|json_object/i` → drop it and retry once (`wantJsonMode=false; attempt=0`).
- Response read: `j.choices[0].message.content` (string, may be array → `JSON.stringify` then `parseJsonLoose`). If `json` requested, `parseJsonLoose` first.
- **Retry policy**: `429` → up to 3 waits, `sleep(5000*waits)` then re-send (same body). Other errors: `AbortError` rethrown; `400..499` (except handled 429) rethrown immediately; otherwise max 3 retries with `sleep(gap*(attempt+1))`; error message format `` `${name} ${status}: ${text.slice(0,180)}` `` with `err.status` set.
- Images: `messagesWithImages` appends to **every** `user` message the same part `{type:'image_url', image_url:{url: img.dataURL||img}}` using **`images[0]` only** (ai.js:436-446). String content is first wrapped into `[{type:'text',text:…}]`.

**Gemini** (`chatGemini`, ai.js:529-572) — URL `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent?key={key}`; headers only `Content-Type`. Body:
```json
{ "contents": [{"role":"user"|"model","parts":[{"text":"…"}]}],
  "systemInstruction": {"parts":[{"text":"<joined system msgs, \n\n>"}]} }
```
- `role:'assistant'→'model'`; system messages joined with `\n\n` and never sent as turns; if `contents` empty → `[{role:'user',parts:[{text:'ping'}]}]`.
- Image: pushed into the **last** part list as `{"inline_data":{"mime_type":<from dataURL 'data:X;base64,' → X, default 'image/jpeg'>,"data":<b64>}}`.
- Response: `j.candidates[0].content.parts.map(p=>p.text).join('')`; if empty and `candidates[0].finishReason !== 'STOP'` → throw `Gemini {finishReason} ({promptFeedback.blockReason})` with `status=400`. Retry: 429 ×3 @ `5000*waits`; else `sleep(gap*attempt)`, max 3. Error message `Gemini {status}: {text.slice(0,150)}`.
- `chatGeminiVision` (exported, ai.js:622) — no retry: `{"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":prompt},{"inline_data":{...}}]}]}`, throws `` `Gemini vision ${status}` ``.

**Anthropic** (`chatAnthropic`, ai.js:574-620) — headers `{'Content-Type':'application/json','x-api-key':key,'anthropic-version':'2023-06-01'}`. Body:
```json
{ "model":"…", "max_tokens":4096, "messages":[{"role":"user"|"assistant","content":"…|[…]"}], "system":"<joined system msgs, \n\n>" }
```
- Empty messages → `[{role:'user',content:'ping'}]`. Image appended to last message content as `{"type":"image","source":{"type":"base64","media_type":<mime>,"data":<b64>}}`; `chatAnthropicVision` (ai.js:669) uses regex `/^data:([^;]+);base64,(.*)$/s`, else `{"type":"image","source":{"type":"url","url":dataURL}}`, `max_tokens:4096`, no retry. Response: `(j.content||[]).map(x=>x.text).join('')`. Same 429/4xx/retry policy as Gemini (`Claude {status}: …`).

**Pollinations model list** — `GET https://text.pollinations.ai/models` → array; keep entries with `tier === 'anonymous'`, add `m.name` + every `m.aliases[]` into a Set (`refreshFreeModels`, ai.js:360). `mergeFreeModels('pollinations', list)` appends `{id, free:true}` to `PROVIDERS.pollinations.models` and returns the count added; then `invalidateModelCache()` in modelsui. Fallback `FREE_MODELS_FALLBACK = ['openai']`.

## 3. `relay/zen-relay.mjs` — exhaustive behaviour
**Server**: `node:http`, port = `process.argv[2] || process.env.ZEN_RELAY_PORT || 8789`. Routes: `GET /healthz` → `{ok:true, zen:'https://opencode.ai/zen/v1', version:'1.18.31', tools:11}`; `POST /v1/chat/completions` → `handleChat`; `OPTIONS *` → 204; everything else → 404 `{error:{type:'not_found',message:<pathname>}}`. No other path rewriting, no `/v1/responses` exposed to clients.
**CORS (on every response)**: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET,POST,OPTIONS`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: *`, `Access-Control-Expose-Headers: *`.
**Upstream headers — built from scratch, nothing is forwarded** (`identityHeaders`, zen-relay.mjs:74-86). Full list:
```
'Content-Type': 'application/json'
'User-Agent': `opencode/${OPENCODE_VERSION}`   // OPENCODE_VERSION = '1.18.31'
'x-opencode-client': 'cli'
'x-opencode-project': 'global'
'x-opencode-session': ocId('ses_')             // fresh per request
'x-opencode-request': ocId('msg_')             // fresh per request
'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream'
'Authorization': <client's req.headers.authorization, VERBATIM, only if present>
```
`ocId(prefix)` = `prefix + (Date.now()*0x1000).toString(16).padStart(12,'0').slice(-12) + 14 random base62 chars` → e.g. `ses_…`, `msg_…`. **Stripped (never forwarded):** every other incoming header, e.g. `content-length`, `host`, `accept-encoding`, `origin`, `referer`, cookies, `x-api-key`, custom client headers. Note `Authorization` is the *only* client header that survives, and it is **overridden by identity value only in the sense that it is re-set**; nothing is merged/preserved otherwise.
**Body forwarding**: body is read fully, `JSON.parse`d (400 `{error:{type:'invalid_request_error',message:'Bad JSON body'}}` on failure). `model` required non-empty string → else 400 `{type:'invalid_request_error',message:'model is required'}`. Then `out = {...body, model, stream:true, …}` — i.e. **all other client fields pass through unchanged**, with these overrides:
- *chat path* (`ZEN + '/chat/completions'`): `stream:true`; `tool_choice: body.tool_choice || 'auto'`; `tools: mergeTools(body.tools)` = `body.tools` verbatim if non-empty array, else the full `builtin_tools.json` array; `messages: body.messages.length ? body.messages : [{type:'user',content:'ping'}]` (note `PROBE_MSG` uses key **`type`**, not `role`); `delete out.unused`.
- *responses path* (`ZEN + '/responses'`): `stream:true`; `tool_choice:'auto'`; `tools: responsesTools()` = `builtin_tools.json` mapped to `{type:'function', name:f.function.name, description:f.function.description, parameters:f.function.parameters}` (i.e. **function object flattened**, the `function` wrapper dropped) — client tools are ignored here; `max_output_tokens: Math.max(body.max_output_tokens || 800, 800)`; `input: body.messages.map(m=>({role:m.role||'user', content:[{type:'input_text', text: textOf(m.content)}]}))` or `[{role:'user',content:[{type:'input_text',text:'ping'}]}]`; `delete out.messages`; `delete out.max_tokens`. `textOf` joins array parts' `.text` with `\n`.
**Upstream call**: `fetch(url,{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(out),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(90000)})` → network failure = 502 `{error:{type:'relay_error',message:'Upstream unreachable: '+e.message}}`. Response is fully buffered as text (`await upstream.text()`). `status !== 200` → if `content-type` contains `json` the upstream JSON body is re-sent verbatim with the **same status code**, else `{error:{type:'upstream_error',message:'Zen HTTP <status>'}}`.
**SSE folding** (this is the only streaming logic):
- `sseFoldChat`: split on `/\r?\n/`, trim, keep lines starting with `data:`, payload = `line.slice(5).trim()`; skip empty and `[DONE]`; JSON parse errors skipped. If `o.error` → remember error and continue. Else accumulate `o.choices[0].delta.content`; `finish_reason` from `choices[0].finish_reason` (default `'stop'`); `delta.reasoning_content` is **discarded** (`content += ''`). Errors → `{finish_reason:'error', error: errText(err)}`; `finish_reason==='length'` → error `'модель упёрлась в лимит длины ответа (сократите запрос)'`; empty content → `'модель вернула пустой ответ'`.
- `sseFoldResponses`: `type==='response.output_text.delta'` → `content += o.delta`; `response.completed` → `status=o.response.status||'completed'`; `response.incomplete` → `incomplete=o.response.incomplete_details`; `response.failed` or `error` or `response.error` → err. Errors: `incomplete` → `'модель не закончила ответ: '+(incomplete.reason||'incomplete')`; `status!=='completed'` → `'статус ответа zen: '+status`; empty → `'модель вернула пустой ответ'`. Success → `{content,status,stopped,finish_reason:'stop'}`.
- Any `result.error` → HTTP **502** `{error:{type: isResponses ? 'upstream_failed' : 'upstream_error', message: result.error}}` (failures are never masked by a 200 with empty content).
- Success → 200 `completionJson(model,result)` = `{id:'chatcmpl-relay-'+Date.now(), object:'chat.completion', created: Math.floor(Date.now()/1000), model, choices:[{index:0, message:{role:'assistant', content: result.content}, finish_reason}], usage}`.
- `usageOf`: real numbers from `usage.prompt_tokens|input_tokens` and `usage.completion_tokens|output_tokens` when non-zero; otherwise `{prompt_tokens:0, completion_tokens: chars, total_tokens: chars, estimated:true}` (zen sends no tokenizer).
**"Official tools" payload** = verbatim `relay/builtin_tools.json`: a top-level JSON **array of 11** `{type:'function', function:{name, description, parameters}}` objects, `parameters` = `{$schema, type:'object', properties:{…}, required:[…]}` with `$schema` present. Names + `required`: `bash`(`command`; props `command,timeout,workdir`), `edit`(`filePath,oldString,newString`; +`replaceAll`), `glob`(`pattern`; +`path`), `grep`(`pattern`; +`path,include`), `read`(`filePath`; +`offset,limit`), `skill`(`name`), `task`(`description,prompt,subagent_type`; +`task_id,command`), `todowrite`(`todos`), `webfetch`(`url`; +`format,timeout`), `websearch`(`query`; +`numResults,livecrawl,type,contextMaxCharacters`), `write`(`content,filePath`). Descriptions are long opencode-CLI English help texts. **Ship this file byte-identical as an asset** and embed as a JSON array.

## 5. Model picker (modelsui.js) — filters & live verify
Filter state `f = {cat, tab, quality, q}`; initial `{cat:'nokey', tab:'all', quality:'curated', q:''}`. `match(mt,f)` (modelsui.js:51-66) is AND-only, exact semantics:
- `f.tab !== 'all'` ⇒ `mt.pid === f.tab`.
- `f.quality === 'curated'` ⇒ `mt.curated === true` (curated ⇔ present in `CURATED_PROVIDERS`).
- `cat` chips: `all` (no test) · `nokey` ⇒ `mt.nokey` · `free` ⇒ `mt.free` · `paid` ⇒ `mt.paid` · `vision` ⇒ `mt.vision` · `smart` ⇒ `mt.smart` · `dumb` ⇒ `!mt.smart` · `orch` ⇒ `mt.orchestrator`.
- `f.q` ⇒ case-insensitive substring of `(label + ' ' + providerName + ' ' + pid + ' ' + mid)`.
`modelMeta(pid,mid)` (ai.js:288-305) fields: `{pid, mid, label(m.label||mid), providerName((p.name||pid).split(' ·')[0]), nokey: p.key===false || m.nokey===true, free: modelKind==='free', paid: modelKind==='paid', vision: p.vision===true, curated: p.curated===true, requiresKey: p.key===true, smart: isSmartModel(), orchestrator: p.orchestrator===true}`. `modelKind` ⇒ `'free'` if `p.key===false` or `m.free===true`, else `'paid'` (`nokey` alone is **not** free-tier but `isFreeModel()` treats `free||nokey||key===false` as free).
`isSmartModel` (ai.js:276-285): lowercase `(label + ' ' + mid)`; first `/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*b\b/` match → smart iff `>= 32`; else `DUMB_KEYS` ⇒ dumb (`mini|lite|light|small|tiny|fast|flash|haiku|instant|nano|micro|pico|sprint|cheap|quick|compact|pixel|\b0.\db\b|1.5b|2b|…|27b|32b|…|400b-a3b|…|gpt-oss-20b\b`); else `SMART_KEYS` ⇒ smart (`reason|rational|thinking|thinker|opus|sonnet|pro$|ultra|max$|flash-thinking|r1|r2|qwq|\bo1..o4\b|grok-3|grok-4|deepseek-v4|deepseek-r1|deepseek-chat|glm-5|kimi-k3|qwen3-(235|430|max)|premium|200b|…|1.5-trillion|trillion`); **default = smart**.
Sort `rank(mt)`: 0 curated+nokey, 1 curated+free, 2 curated+paid, 3 nokey, 4 free, 5 else; tie → provider name `localeCompare('ru')` then label. `flatCache` memoised; `invalidateModelCache()` after `mergeFreeModels`. Provider tabs (deduped by pid, "Все модели" prepended); clicking a non-curated tab forces `quality='all'`; clicking a tab whose `key===true` and has no nokey model while `cat==='nokey'` resets `cat='all'`. Model tree groups by prefix before the first `/` (`''` = root), `<details open>` when ≤6 items. Tag labels: `🆓 без ключа`, `🔁 через релей` (nokey && requiresKey), `бесплатно`/`платно`, `👁 vision`, `🎛 оркестратор`, `🧠 умная`/`⚡ быстрая`, `проверено` (curated).
**Verify live** (`probeModel`, ai.js:313-331): builds `settings = {...settings, ai:pid, aimodel:mid}`; `AbortController` with **`setTimeout(…, 20000)`**; calls `chat(s, [{role:'user',content:'ping'}], {signal, minGap:0})` — i.e. a real non-streaming request, `temperature 0.5`, no `json` mode. **Success = promise resolves** (empty string counts as success — no content check). Failure = throws; `err` string truncated to 140 chars. Result cached in `MODEL_HEALTH: Map<'pid::mid', {ok, ms, err, ts}>` (session lifetime only). `probeVisible()` probes filtered rows **sequentially** in list order. Pollinations refresh button → `refreshFreeModels()` + `mergeFreeModels('pollinations', list)`.

## 6. chat.js feature
- Persistence (store.js, IndexedDB `voicecomic` v2, stores `kv` + `chat`): sessions at `chat['sessions']` = `[{id:'s'+Date.now(), title:'Сессия DD.MM, HH:MM', ts}]`; messages at `chat['msgs:'+sid]`; current session id in `kv['chat:current']`; settings in `kv['settings']`.
- Message record: `{role:'user'|'ai'|'err'|'system', content:string, ts:number, typing?:true, files?:[{file:File, name, size, type, dataURL?, text?}]}`. UI: `msg.user|msg.ai|msg.err`; images render `<img class="att" src=dataURL>`, others `📎 name · size`; `fmtSize` = `>1048576 → (n/1048576).toFixed(1)+' МБ'`, `>1024 → Math.round(n/1024)+' КБ'`, else `n+' Б'`; all text HTML-escaped via `escapeHtml` (`& < > " '`).
- **No streaming**: a placeholder `{role:'ai', typing:true}` is shown until the single non-stream reply arrives, then replaced by `{role:'ai', content:String(answer)}` or `{role:'err', content:'Ошибка: '+msg}`.
- Attachments: from `#chat-file` `change`; `{file,name,size,type}`; images get `dataURL` via `FileReader.readAsDataURL` (async, no await before send). Text extraction: MIME must match `TEXTY = /^(text\/|application\/(json|xml|javascript|x-yaml|yaml|toml|sql|graphql))/` **or** be empty; `size > 400*1024` → skipped; binary sniff `/[\x00-\x08\x0e-\x1f]/` in first 512 chars → skipped; text truncated to 400 KB. All texts concatenated as `--- файл «NAME» ---\n<text>`, joined with `\n\n`, prefixed `'\n\n[Содержимое приложенных файлов]\n'`, whole block truncated to `MAX_TOTAL_CHARS = 24000`.
- Request: `history` = messages excluding `typing`/`err`/`system`, **last `MAX_COPY = 12`**, excluding the just-added user message; `userTurn = {role:'user', content:(text||'(без текста)') + attachBlock}`; body = `[{role:'system',content:systemPrompt}, ...history, userTurn]`. If any image → `chatWithImage(settings, msgs, images[0].dataURL)` (only the **first** image is ever sent; also flattens messages via `messages.filter(m=>m.role!=='system').map(m=>(m.role==='user'?'Пользователь: ':'ИИ: ')+m.content).join('\n')` and throws if `!provider.vision`); else `chat(...)`. Both **non-streaming**, no `opts.json`, `minGap` unset → `settings.aiGap` (2500).
- Session title: first reply sets `title = (text || files[0].name || 'Сессия').trim().slice(0,40)` only if it still starts with `'Сессия '`; sessions re-sorted by `ts` desc.
- **On-device vs backend: there is no such split in chat.js.** Every chat call is direct to the provider through ai.js. Backend modes exist only elsewhere: `settings.voiceBackend` `'edge'` (default) | `'browser'` | `'edge-proxy'` (voices.js:263, with `settings.proxy`), and `settings.backendUrl`/`backendToken` for the FastAPI terminal/files service (`backend/main.py`: `/pty` WebSocket, files list/upload/download/delete, exec, GitHub-PAT auth, `VOICECOMIC_WORKSPACE`). For a native port: chat = direct OkHttp; TTS/terminal = whatever the Kotlin equivalents are.

## 7. yolo.js — speech-bubble DETECTION (not "you only live once", not a cache)
Purpose: locate speech balloons on a comic page so Tesseract can OCR each balloon separately. On-device inference via **onnxruntime-web WASM** (1.20.1 from jsDelivr: `.../dist/ort.min.js`, `ort.env.wasm.wasmPaths = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.20.1/dist/'`).
- Registry `YOLO_MODELS` (only one entry): `yolov8m-seg-bubble` → `{id:'yolov8m-seg-bubble', name:'YOLOv8m-seg (kitsumed/speech-bubble)', url:'https://huggingface.co/kitsumed/yolov8m_seg-speech-bubble/resolve/main/model_dynamic.onnx', size:108982949, nPred:37, imgsz:640}`. `setYoloModel` also accepts `'custom'` (assumes standard v8-seg, user-supplied URL) — no registry entry exists for it.
- Cache: IndexedDB `kv['model:bubbles:<modelId>']` = raw `Uint8Array`; `kv['model:bubbles:<modelId>:meta']` = `{bytes, version|at}` (avoids reading 108 MB to test presence). `bubbleModelStatus()` → `{ready, bytes, modelId}`; `bubbleModelTargetBytes()`; `bubbleModelClear()` deletes both and invalidates the session.
- In-memory cache: module-level `_session` + `_sessionId` (one `InferenceSession` reused across pages; `ort.InferenceSession.create(bytes,{executionProviders:['wasm']})`). Download with progress via `fetch(url)` + `r.body.getReader()` reading `content-length`.
- Preprocess `letterbox(img,640)`: pad `#808080`, ratio = `min(640/w,640/h)`, centred, RGB `float32` 0..1, tensor `[1,3,640,640]`.
- Postprocess: `output0.data` decoded as `[1, N_PRED=37, N]`; class score at row `4*N+j`, bbox rows `0..3*N`; coords un-letterboxed and clamped; `CONF = 0.25`; `IOU = 0.45`; NMS drops boxes with `w<8 || h<8`. Returns `[{x,y,w,h,conf}]` in source pixels.
- Consumers: `ocr.js:64-90` (`settings.detect === 'yolo'`) → per-box `ocrRegion()` crop OCR (Tesseract or vision provider) → bubbles `{x,y,w,h,text}`; any failure falls through to the full-page OCR path. Kotlin equivalent: onnxruntime-android (AAR) + OkHttp download + the same letterbox/NMS math; no need for the 108 MB IndexedDB blob if you cache to app files dir.

## 8. All prompt texts, verbatim
**(a) OCR via vision** — `visionExtractLines` (ai.js:641-667). `${langName}` from ocr.js map (`rus:'русский', eng:'английский', chi_sim:'китайский', jpn:'японский', kor:'корейский', spa:'испанский', fra:'французский', deu:'немецкий', por:'португальский'`). No `response_format`; parsed with `parseJsonLoose`, else newline-split.
```
Прочитай весь текст на этом изображении (${langName}). Это страница манги/комикса. Верни строго JSON массив строк в том порядке, в котором их нужно читать. Внутри double quotes. Не добавляй ничего кроме JSON.
```
Demanded schema: `["строка1","строка2", …]` (array of strings, reading order).
**(b) Cast / role assignment** — `analyzeRoles` (ai.js:697-746), `ROLE_BATCH = 60` lines per request, `minGap: 6000`, `json:true`. `${langName}` from app.js:498 (`rus/eng/chi_sim/jpn/kor` only). System prompt (verbatim, with the line-break escapes shown as they are in source):
```
Ты — режиссёр дубляжа манги/комикса. Определи, кто говорит каждую реплику. Язык реплик: ${langName}. Правила:
1. В characters перечисли КАЖДОГО говорящего один раз: {"name":"Имя","gender":"male|female|other"}.
2. В lines верни {"idx":<номер из входа>,"character":"имя ровно как в characters"} для КАЖДОЙ реплики.
3. Имя выбирай устойчиво: один и тот же герой на всех страницах должен называться одинаково, сначала по имени, а не по прозвищу.
4. Закадровый текст, внутренний монолог и мысли автора — character: "Нарратор".
5. Если говорящего определить невозможно — character: "?" (не выдумывай имя).
6. Верни строго JSON без пояснений.
```
(the `Язык реплик: …` clause is omitted entirely when `langName === ''`).
User turn: `Реплики (JSON): ` + `JSON.stringify([{idx,page,text}, …])`.
Demanded schema: `{"characters":[{"name":string,"gender":"male"|"female"|"other"}],"lines":[{"idx":int,"character":string}]}`. Parsing: chars deduped by `name.toLowerCase().replace(/ё/g,'е')`; `lines` entries kept only if `Number.isInteger(idx) && idx>=0 && idx<lines.length`; a batch without a `lines` array is recorded in `missing:[{from,to}]`. Returns `{characters, items, batches, missing}` or `null` if both empty.
**(c) Translation** — `translateLines` (ai.js:751-777), batches of `B = 30`, `minGap: 4000`, `json:true`, `await sleep(300)` after each batch.
```
Ты — профессиональный переводчик манги/комиксов. Переведи реплики на язык: ${toLang}. Сохрани смысл обращений/имён. Верни строго JSON: [{"idx":0,"text":"..."}]
```
User turn: `Реплики: ` + `JSON.stringify([{idx,text}, …])`. Demanded schema: `[{"idx":int,"text":string}]`; non-array response throws `API вернул не JSON-массив: <raw.slice(0,120)>`; out-of-range/blank `idx` ignored; output array is same length as input with `null` holes. `countTranslated(out)` counts non-blank strings.
**(d) Chat system prompt** — chat.js:142, verbatim:
```
Ты — помощник пользователя приложения VoiceComic (комиксы → озвученное видео). Отвечай по-русски, коротко и по делу. Пользователь может присылать изображения и файлы: изображения разбирай как страницы манги/комикса, текстовые файлы прочитывай и комментируй.
```
Always sent as the first message; a stored `role:'system'` message is read but explicitly discarded (`void sys`).
**(e) YOLO** — **no prompts whatsoever**; pure ONNX detection. No LLM involvement.
**(f) Probe prompt** — `ping` (ai.js:320); relay fallback probe `'ping'` (zen-relay.mjs:53, `PROBE_MSG`).
**(g) Other user-visible AI strings** (verbatim): keyless-Zen error in ai.js:412-417:
```
«${model}» — free tier OpenCode Zen без ключа. Браузер не может напрямую отправить identity-заголовки opencode CLI (User-Agent, x-opencode-*), поэтому такие модели работают через мини-релей: команда «node relay/zen-relay.mjs», её URL задайте в настройках («URL Zen-релея»), либо добавьте ключ Zen.
```
plus `Свой провайдер: не задан адрес OpenAI-совместимого API`, `«<name>» не умеет смотреть изображения (выберите vision-провайдер)`, `Gemini: нужен API-ключ`, `Anthropic: нужен API-ключ`, `Claude: нужен API-ключ`, `Gemini: нужен API-ключ (Опции → ИИ-провайдер → ключ)`, `«${model}» (Jev) — это не чат-модель, а «система решений» (state+questions); в VoiceComic не используется.`
`parseJsonLoose` (ai.js:382): `JSON.parse` → else first `\{[\s\S]*\}` block → else first `\[[\s\S]*\]` block → else `null`.

### Kotlin asset checklist
`models.dev.js` → `res/raw/models.dev.json` (strip the `export const MODELS_DEV = ` wrapper, keep pure JSON); `builtin_tools.json` → `res/raw/builtin_tools.json` verbatim; curated provider table + regexes (`SMART_KEYS`, `DUMB_KEYS`, `REASONING_MODELS`, `TEXTY`, `RESPONSES_MODELS`, `JEV_MODELS`) → Kotlin objects; `ocId()` → `Date.now()*0x1000` hex + 14 base62 chars from `crypto.randomBytes(14)`; relay port 8789 and `zenRelay` setting become irrelevant once OkHttp sets `User-Agent`/`x-opencode-*` directly.

# VoiceComic → Native Kotlin/Compose Port: Technical Spec

Sources: `index.html` (383), `js/app.js` (1826), `js/store.js` (58), `js/cast.js` (331), `css/ui.css` (207), plus `js/{ocr,chat,yolo,voices,ai,engine,import,util}.js`.

---

## 1. PROJECT DATA MODEL (exact)

### 1.1 IndexedDB (`js/store.js`)
- DB name `voicecomic`, version `2`. Two object stores, **no keyPath, out-of-line keys**:
  - `kv` — keys: `'project'`, `'settings'`, `'chat:current'`, `'model:bubbles:<modelId>'` (Uint8Array), `'model:bubbles:<modelId>:meta'` (`{bytes, version}`).
  - `chat` — keys: `'sessions'` (array), `'msgs:<sessionId>'` (array).
- Constants: `KEY_PROJECT='project'`, `KEY_SETTINGS='settings'`.

### 1.2 Persisted project (what `saveToDB` writes) — `projectForStore()` app.js:183
```js
{ kind: 'pages'|'clips',
  roles:  <Role[]>,              // full, incl. all fields
  clips:  <Clip[]>,              // full, incl. url + seg blobs (url kept in IDB, unused on load)
  pages:  [ { ...page, url removed } ]   // only top-level `url` (objectURL) stripped; `file` Blob KEPT
}
```
Only `page.url` is dropped. `page.file` (a `File`/`Blob`) is what makes IndexedDB load possible; on `init()` each `p.file` is turned back into `p.url = URL.createObjectURL(p.file)`.

### 1.3 `defaultProject()` (app.js:67)
`{ kind:'pages', pages:[], clips:[], roles: defaultRoles() }` — 3 roles: `Нарратор`(🎙,#93a0b8), `Персонаж 1`(🧑,#5b8cff), `Персонаж 2`(👩,#ff6b7a).

### 1.4 Page
| field | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string uuid32 | `uuid()` | `crypto.randomUUID()` with `-` stripped, 32 hex chars |
| `url` | string objectURL | — | **not persisted**; recomputed from `file` |
| `file` | Blob/File | — | persisted; source image |
| `filesize` | int | `page.size` | set at import |
| `w`, `h` | int px | `0` → measured by `probeMetrics` (fallback 1) | page 0 drives `res:'auto'` |
| `bubbles` | Bubble[] | `[]` | |
| `bubblesHaveBoxes` | bool | `true` | `res.boxes!==false`; **false for vision-OCR** → engine draws no bubble, no zoom anchor |
| `name` | string | `''` | only written by project-import merge |

### 1.5 Bubble (one spoken line)
`{ id:uuid, text:'', tr:'', roleId:'', x, y, w, h, order, audio:{blob,duration,noTrim}, clipSeg }`
- `x,y,w,h`: **canvas pixels of the OCR working canvas** (max dim 1600), NOT page pixels — Tesseract/YOLO path. Vision path: `x=y=w=h=null`, `order = i/rows` (0..1, uniform by page height). Manually added bubble in page editor: `{x:10,y:10,w:120,h:40}`, no `order`.
- `audio`: `{ blob: Blob, duration: number(sec), noTrim?: true }`. TTS writes `duration:0` then `ttsAll` back-fills via `measureTrimmedDuration` (TRIM = `{threshold:0.012, margin:0.05, minDur:0.25}`). Clip-sourced audio gets `noTrim:true` (already silence-cut).
- `clipSeg`: `int|null` — manual index of clip segment; `null` = auto.

### 1.6 Role (`project.roles[]`)
`{ id, name, emoji, color, voice, pitch, rate, volume, style, type, clipId, gender, manualVoice, castReason, pitchNum, rateNum, volumeNum, takeMode }`
- `type`: `'edge' | 'clip'`. `clipId`: id into `project.clips`.
- `pitch/rate/volume`: **legacy SSML strings** (`'+0Hz'`,`'+0%'`,`'+0%'`). Numeric sliders write `pitchNum` (-40..40), `rateNum` (-50..100, step 5), `volumeNum` (10..200, step 5, 100=unity) **plus** the derived string `volume = (v-100>0?'+':'')+(v-100)+'%'`. Engine `roleGain()` prefers `volumeNum`, clamps `0..2`.
- `gender`: `'male'|'female'|'other'` (absent in `defaultRoles()`/`addRole()`; set by AI cast + narrator).
- `manualVoice`: bool — true once user picks a voice in UI; never overwritten by auto-cast.
- `castReason`: `'manual'|'gender'|'free'|'other-lang'|'reused'`.
- `takeMode`: `'order'|'duration'` (absent ⇒ `'order'`).
- `emoji` auto-synced from gender: `{male:'🧔', female:'👩', other:'🤖'}`, fallback `🧑`. Narrator emoji `📖`.
- Palette `ROLE_COLORS` (index = `roles.length % 10`): `#5b8cff,#ff6b7a,#3ecf9a,#ffb454,#c084fc,#38bdf8,#fb7185,#a3e635,#f472b6,#60a5fa`.
- `style` (TTS_STYLES): `''|cheerful|excited|angry|sad|whisper|shouting|terrified|unfriendly|gentle`.

### 1.7 Clip (`project.clips[]`)
`{ id, name, url, duration, sr, count, segs:[ {startS, endS, duration, blob} ] }` — `sr`=sampleRate, `count`=`segs.length`, `blob`=16-bit PCM WAV (`audio/wav`) built by `samplesToWav`. Slicing params `clipsFromAudio`: `threshold 0.02, minSilence 0.32, minClip 0.3, maxClip 16`.

### 1.8 `settings` (persisted separately under `kv.settings`) — `defaultSettings()` verbatim
```js
{ ocr:'tesseract', detect:'yolo', lang:'rus', trlang:'ru',
  ai:'pollinations', key:'', aiurl:'', aimodel:'openai', aiGap:2500,
  zenRelay:'',
  voiceBackend:'edge', proxy:'',
  backendUrl:'', backendToken:'',
  gap:350, res:'1080x1920', fps:30, zoom:'smart', caption:'bubble', biling:'orig',
  musicBlob:null, mvol:15 }
```
Also attached transiently as `project.settings = settings` (engine reads `project.settings.gap`, `.zoom`, `.caption`, `.biling`, `.musicBlob`, `.mvol`).
`LANG_LOCALE`: rus→`ru`, eng→`en-US`, chi_sim→`zh-CN`, jpn→`ja-JP`, kor→`ko-KR`, spa→`es-ES`, fra→`fr-FR`, deu→`de-DE`, por→`pt-BR`.
Read-but-never-defaulted: `settings.rtl` (bool), `settings.bubbleDetect`.

### 1.9 Chat (IndexedDB `chat` store)
- `sessions`: `[{ id:'s'+Date.now(), title:'Сессия DD.MM HH:MM', ts }]`, sorted desc by `ts`; current id in `kv['chat:current']`.
- `msgs:<sid>`: `[{ role:'user'|'ai'|'err', content, ts, typing?, files?:[ {file:File, name, size, type, dataURL?, text?} ] }]`. `MAX_COPY=12`, `MAX_ATTACH_BYTES=400*1024`, `MAX_TOTAL_CHARS=24000`. Authors rendered as `Вы` / `ИИ` / `Ошибка`.

### 1.10 YOLO state (NOT in project/settings)
Module-level `_currentModelId` default `'yolov8m-seg-bubble'`; registry `YOLO_MODELS` `{ id,name,url,size:108982949,nPred:37,imgsz:640 }`; `custom` added at runtime `{id:'custom',name:'Кастомная модель',url,size:0,nPred:37,imgsz:640}`. Inference `CONF=0.25, IOU=0.45`.

### 1.11 EXPORTED JSON (`exportProject()`, app.js:1506) — filename `voicecomic_project.json`
```json
{ "version": 1,
  "settings": { ...full settings incl. musicBlob },
  "project": { "kind": "...", "roles": [<full Role>],
    "clips": [ {"id","name","duration","count"} ],
    "pages": [ {"id","w","h","name",
       "bubbles":[{"id","text","tr","roleId","x","y","w","h"}]} ] } }
```
**No images, no audio, no `order`, no `bubblesHaveBoxes`, no `filesize`, no `file`.** Toast: `Экспортирован сценарий без звука/страниц — файлы импортируйте отдельно`.

`importProject()` merge rules: `settings = {...defaultSettings(), ...j.settings}`; roles replaced wholesale only if array non-empty; `kind` accepted only if `pages|clips`; pages matched **first by `id` (unused-only), else by index if `project.pages.length === impPages.length`** — unmatched → `missing++`; per bubble, existing `{...b, audio: old?.audio}` (audio preserved, not overwritten by file); `w/h/name` merged with `||`; clips only counted, never replaced. Errors: `Файл не похож на проект VoiceComic`.

## 5. CASTING (`js/cast.js`) — automatic role distribution

**A. Name normalization** `normName(s)`: replace `[«»"“”'`*_~]`→space → collapse spaces → trim → strip trailing `[.!?,;:…]+` → collapse → trim → `toLowerCase` → `ё→е`.
- `NARRATOR='Нарратор'`. `NARRATOR_KEYS` = {нарратор, рассказчик, автор, закадровый, текст, narrator, narrator voice, off-screen, offscreen, ос, s.e.}.
- `UNKNOWN_KEYS` = {?, неизвестно, неясно, unknown, none, -, —, нет, n/a} or empty → **unassigned**, never auto-assigned to first role.
- `normGender` → `male|female|other` from `m|male|man|masc|муж|м` / `f|female|woman|fem|жен|ж`; `normVoiceGender` → `'m'|'f'|''`.

**B. `mergeCharacters(characters, existing, mkId)`** (AI answer → project roles):
1. Build `existingByName: normName→role` (first wins; duplicates in project tolerated).
2. For each AI char: skip if `isUnknownName`; skip if normName already seen (model duplicated); reuse existing role if free (`taken` set), else create `{id:mkId(), name:rawName, gender, isNew:true}`; fill `byName` + `speakers`; **only fill gender if existing was `other`**.
3. `unused` = normalized names of existing roles not in `byName`, excluding narrator names.
4. Returns `{characters, byName, speakers, unused}`.

**C. `resolveSpeaker(speaker, ctx, {narratorRoleId})`**: empty/unknown → `''`; narrator + narratorRoleId → narrator; exact `speakers` hit; else **prefix match** either direction (`Саске` ↔ `Саске Учиха`); else `''`.

**D. `planCasts(characters, voices, {langPrefix, manual:Set, narratorRoleId})` → Map roleId→{voice, reason}`:
1. `keyOf = c.roleId ?? c.id`.
2. `langPool` = voices whose `lang.toLowerCase().startsWith(langPrefix.toLowerCase())`; `useLangPool = langPool.length >= characters.length` (else fall back to full pool); `base = useLangPool ? langPool : pool`.
3. `used` = every already-assigned voice (incl. manual).
4. Pass 1 — keep manual/assigned: `if (c.voice && (manual.has(id) || !manual.size))` → `reason:'manual'`.
5. Pass 2 — pending with a required gender (narrator exempt; `other` intentionally unconstrained) take first free `base` voice of that gender → `reason:'gender'`.
6. Pass 3 — pending: any free `base` voice → `'free'` or `'other-lang'`.
7. Pass 4 — none left: reuse `base[0] || pool[0]` → `'reused'`.
8. Post-pass: if final voice's lang doesn't start with `langPrefix` and reason is not manual/reused → reason forced to `'other-lang'` (reason must reflect reality, not the pass).
`CAST_REASON = {manual:'вручную', gender:'по полу', free:'свободный', 'other-lang':'другой язык', reused:'повтор: голосов не хватило'}`.

**E. Data written back** (`aiRoles`/`autoCast`): new `project.roles` entries (emoji from gender, color = next `ROLE_COLORS`); `role.gender`, `role.emoji` sync, `role.voice`, `role.castReason`; `bubble.roleId`; AI call is batched `ROLE_BATCH=60` lines, `minGap 6000`; system prompt verbatim:
`Ты — режиссёр дубляжа манги/комикса. Определи, кто говорит каждую реплику. Язык реплик: <langName>. Правила: 1. В characters перечисли КАЖДОГО говорящего один раз: {"name":"Имя","gender":"male|female|other"}. 2. В lines верни {"idx":…,"character":"имя ровно как в characters"} для КАЖДОЙ реплики. 3. Имя выбирай устойчиво: один и тот же герой на всех страницах должен называться одинаково, сначала по имени, а не по прозвищу. 4. Закадровый текст, внутренний монолог и мысли автора — character: "Нарратор". 5. Если говорящего определить невозможно — character: "?" (не выдумывай имя). 6. Верни строго JSON без пояснений.`

**F. `planTakes/resolveTakes/planCasts` for clip takes**: `planTakes(lineDurs, segDurs, {byDuration})` — `order[i]=i` when `byDuration=false` (record order), `unused`/`missing` reported; `byDuration=true` sorts both lists ascending by duration and greedily matches closest with a monotone pointer. `resolveTakes({lineDurs,segDurs,mode,manual})` — manual per-line `clipSeg` overrides, validated as integer in `[0, segDurs.length)` else falls back to auto. `takeMismatch(a,b) = max(a/b, b/a)`; UI warns when `> 1.6`. Voice gating: role must have `type==='clip' && clipId`; durations from `audio.duration` or `estimateSpeakDur` (`max(1.1, min(14, len/13 + 0.55)) + (has whitespace ? 0.15 : 0)`).

## 6. KEY FLOWS (state machines) + AUTOSAVE

- **Autosave**: `autoSaveTimer()` = debounced **600 ms** → `saveToDB()` (writes `settings` then `projectForStore()` to `kv`); warns once per failure streak: `Автосохранение: <err>`; quota message: `не хватило места в хранилище браузера. Выгрузите проект в JSON и удалите лишние страницы/нарезки`. Triggered after: import, delPage/delClip, OCR, AI roles, translate, TTS, every text/role/voice/take edit, setMusic, option change, import/reset project. **Not** triggered by: render, preview, chat (chat has its own persistence), opening modals.
- **Boot**: `init()` → read `kv.settings` (merged over defaults) → read `kv.project` (requires `Array.isArray(pages) && roles`) → rebuild `page.url` from `page.file` → `probeMetrics` → `project.settings = settings` → `bindSettings` (once) → `setChatSettings` → `initChat` → `renderAll` → `wire`.
- **import**: `handleFiles` (split by `isAudioFile`; mixed → error toast) → `importPages` (`project.kind='pages'`, per page `{id,url,file,filesize,w:0,h:0,bubbles:[]}`, `probeMetrics`, label `комикс / книга · страниц: N`, toast `Добавлено страниц: N`) or `importAudio` (`kind='clips'`, slice by silence → `clips[]`, label `аудио / голосовые нарезки · клипов: N`, toast `Звук нарезан на фразы`) → progress hidden → autosave. Hard cap `MAX_PAGES=700`.
- **ocr**: guard `Нет страниц` → per page `ocrAll` → `p.bubbles = [{id,text,tr,roleId,x,y,w,h,order}]`, `p.bubblesHaveBoxes = res.boxes!==false` → render + autosave → (`goToScript` ⇒ `settab('script')`) → toast `OCR завершён`. YOLO-first: detect boxes → OCR each box; on YOLO failure falls back to full-page Tesseract.

package com.voicecomic.app.data

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import java.util.UUID

@Serializable
data class BubbleAudio(
    /** файл нарезки относительно каталога проекта, напр. clips/xx/seg-0.wav */
    val file: String = "",
    val duration: Double = 0.0,
    /** true — кусок вырезан из клипа, повторно обрезать тишину нельзя */
    val noTrim: Boolean = false
)

@Serializable
data class Bubble(
    val id: String = newId(),
    val text: String = "",
    /** перевод */
    val tr: String = "",
    val roleId: String = "",
    /** координаты в пикселях страницы; null — OCR без боксов (vision) */
    val x: Float? = null,
    val y: Float? = null,
    val w: Float? = null,
    val h: Float? = null,
    /** порядок чтения для vision-OCR (0..1) */
    val order: Float? = null,
    val audio: BubbleAudio? = null,
    /** ручная привязка нарезки клипа */
    val clipSeg: Int? = null
) {
    fun hasBox(): Boolean = x != null && y != null && w != null && h != null && w!! > 0f && h!! > 0f
}

@Serializable
data class Page(
    val id: String = newId(),
    val name: String = "",
    /** файл изображения относительно каталога проекта */
    val file: String = "",
    val filesize: Long = 0,
    val w: Int = 0,
    val h: Int = 0,
    /** false — OCR не дал боксов: пузыри рисуются только субтитрами, зум по ним не делается */
    val bubblesHaveBoxes: Boolean = true,
    val bubbles: List<Bubble> = emptyList()
)

@Serializable
data class Role(
    val id: String = newId(),
    val name: String = "",
    val emoji: String = "🧑",
    val color: String = "#5b8cff",
    /** Edge-TTS ShortName */
    val voice: String = "",
    /** legacy SSML-строки */
    val pitch: String = "+0Hz",

        val lang = parts[0].lowercase()
        val region = parts.drop(1).firstOrNull { it.length == 2 && it.all { c -> c.isLetter() } }

    suspend fun refreshFromMicrosoft(okhttp: okhttp3.OkHttpClient): Int {
        val gec = Gec.value()
        val url = "https://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/voices/list" +
            "?trustedclienttoken=${Gec.TRUSTED_CLIENT_TOKEN}" +
            "&Sec-MS-GEC=$gec" +
            "&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=${Gec.GEC_VERSION}"
        val req = okhttp.Request.Builder().url(url)
            .header("Accept-Language", "en-US,en;q=0.9")
            .header("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/${Gec.CHROMIUM}.0.0.0")
            .build()
        val body = okhttp.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
            if (!resp.isSuccessful) return 0
            resp.body?.string() ?: return 0
        }
        val root = kotlinx.serialization.json.Json.parseToJsonElement(body)
        val arr = root as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray ?: return 0
        val out = ArrayList<Voice>()
        for (item in arr) {
            val o = item as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject ?: continue
            fun str(k: String) = o[k]?.let {
                (it as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive)?.content
            }
            val short = str("ShortName") ?: continue
            if (!short.endsWith("Neural")) continue
            val loc = str("Locale") ?: short.take(5)
            val gender = (str("Gender") ?: "").lowercase().startsWith("f")
            out.add(Voice(short, normLocale(loc, short.take(5)), if (gender) "f" else "m"))
        }
        extra = out
        return out.size
    }
}

Now the render package: Timeline, FrameRenderer, AudioMixer, VideoExporter (+ EGL).

Timeline.kt:
```kotlin
data class Item(val page: Page, val pi: Int, val bubble: Bubble?, val t: Double, val dur: Double, val kind: String)
fun buildTimeline(pages: List<Page>, gapMs: Int): Pair<List<Item>, Double>
fun roleGain(role: Role?): Float
fun bubbleHasBox(b: Bubble, page: Page): Boolean
data class Cam(val sx: Float, sy: Float, sw: Float, sh: Float, zoom: Float)
fun cameraFor(item: Item, clock: Double, outW: Int, outH: Int, zoomMode: String): Cam
```

FrameRenderer.kt: draws frame onto a Bitmap Canvas:
```kotlin
class FrameRenderer(val outW: Int, val outH: Int) {
  fun draw(canvas: Canvas, bitmap: Bitmap?, item: Item, clock: Double, settings: Settings, role: Role?)
}
```
Implements: black bg, drawBitmap(src=crop rect, dst=full), captions (bubble mode & subtitle mode) with Paint text measurement.

AudioMixer.kt: builds the mix FloatArray at 44100:
```kotlin
class AudioMixer(val projectId: String, val store: ProjectStore) {
  fun render(timeline: List<Item>, total: Double, project: Project, settings: Settings, onProgress): FloatArray?
}
```
- speech: for each item with bubble audio: decode wav (or mp3? we store wav for TTS too — let me store TTS as wav: decode mp3 → trim → write wav). Read wav via Pcm.readWav, resample to 44100, offset = it.t + trimStart/sr... Actually simpler: we already store trimmed duration in audio.duration, and we save the *trimmed* wav when synthesizing. Wait: the web version kept the raw blob and trimmed at render time (playback offset/dur). To be faithful AND simpler, I'll store the raw TTS output (trimmed at synthesis time for duration measurement) — hmm.

Let me simplify but keep behavior: at synthesis time, we write the *raw* PCM (decoded mp3, not trimmed) to bubble file, and measure trimmed duration (TRIM) for `audio.duration`; store `trimStart` implicitly? The web version recomputes trim at render. If I store the raw and recompute trim at render (same TRIM params), behavior matches. But recomputing trim per render is cheap (PCM array). However I also need `trimStart` offset at render: trimSilence gives (start,end) → offset=start/sr, dur=(end-start)/sr. So store raw and recompute. Good — matches web exactly.

So BubbleAudio.file points to a WAV file with the full synthesized audio (24kHz mono). At render: read wav → mono float + sr; trim with TRIM; resample to 44100; mix at offset = it.t + trimStart/sr with gain roleGain(role).

For clip-sourced audio (noTrim): use whole file, dur = file duration.

Music: loop the music file at gain mvol/100*0.6.

VideoExporter: MediaCodec video (H.264) + EGL input surface, plus AAC audio encoder + MediaMuxer. Let me write:
- `class VideoExporter(outW, outH, fps, out: File)` with `suspend fun export(frames: Iterator/ provider)`. Better design: a callback-based API:

```kotlin
class Mp4Writer(val file: File, val width: Int, val height: Int, val fps: Int, val audioPcm: ShortArray?, val audioSr: Int)
suspend fun export(frameAt: suspend (index: Int, tSeconds: Double) -> Bitmap, totalFrames: Int, onProgress: (Double, String) -> Unit)
```
The frameAt callback draws a frame. Audio: encode in a separate thread/coroutine and mux when both ready. MediaMuxer requires writing samples from a single thread — I'll use a Mutex around muxer writes, with the video on the main coroutine and audio fed by a separate coroutine with a mutex. Standard sample code uses a single handler; with coroutines + Mutex it's fine (muxer.start() once both tracks are ready).

Simplification: encode audio fully first (AAC into a temp file? AAC elementary stream in a file, then mux both tracks reading from files) — that's a known simpler pattern: encode video to temp .h264 (Annex-B) and audio to temp .aac, then mux with MediaMuxer reading sample bytes from the files. That avoids the two-track concurrency complexity. Memory: video elementary stream for a 2-min video at 8Mbps ≈ 120MB on disk — acceptable in cache. Simpler and robust. I'll do that.

Then also export audio-only WAV + AAC/M4A (MediaMuxer with just audio track).

Let me write EglSurface + Mp4Writer.

EGL code (standard):
```kotlin
class CodecSurface(private val codec: MediaCodec, private val width: Int, private val height: Int) {
  private var display = EGL14.EGL_NO_DISPLAY
  private var context = EGL14.EGL_NO_CONTEXT
  private var surface = EGL14.EGL_NO_SURFACE
  private var program = 0
  private var tex = 0
  fun start() { ... }
  fun draw(bitmap: Bitmap, ptsUs: Long) { ... }
  fun stop() { ... }
}
```

Then the video encoder: MediaFormat AVC with color format surface, bitrate, fps, I-frame interval 2s, KEY_I_FRAME_INTERVAL. Feed frames from the FrameRenderer drawing into a Bitmap.

Then `mux(tempVideo, tempAudio, outFile)`: read Annex-B frames, convert to AVC sample format (AVCC) needed by MediaMuxer — requires converting NAL units to length-prefixed. Standard: parse the .h264 Annex-B, convert each NAL (type 1 or 5) to 4-byte length + payload. I'll implement that.

A good crop of errors. Let me fix them:

1. AiClient.kt:78 — `parseJsonLoose` uses `runCatching { return ... }` with non-null return type. Change to nullable function: `fun parseJsonLoose(raw: String): JsonElementOrNull?`. But callers do `AiClient.parseJsonLoose(res)?.element as? JsonArray` — works with nullable. And in openAiCompat: `(parseJsonLoose(content)?.toString() ?: content)`. OK make it nullable and remove the wrapper class? Keep the wrapper but nullable. Simpler: return `JsonElement?` and drop JsonElementOrNull. Callers: `AiClient.parseJsonLoose(out)?.element as? JsonObject` → change to `as? JsonObject`. Let me just make it return JsonElement? and fix call sites.

2. AiClient 219, 316, 398: "None of the following candidates is applicable" — likely `putJsonArray`/`add` overloads or `put("parameters", f["parameters"] ?: JsonObject(emptyMap()))` (put with Any? → JsonElement). Line 219: in buildOpenAiBody `putJsonArray("messages")` with `add(buildJsonObject {...})`? Hmm, need actual messages. Let me get detailed error output for those lines.

3. Providers.kt const val List → change to `val`.

4. MediaAudioDecoder: `max` unresolved (kotlin.math.max not imported), and `MediaCodec.BUFFER_FLAG_FORMAT_CHANGED` doesn't exist (it's in MediaCodecInfo.CodecConstants? Actually BUFFER_FLAG_FORMAT_CHANGED is defined in MediaCodec as 0x1? In Android, MediaCodec has BUFFER_FLAG_KEY_FRAME, BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM, BUFFER_FLAG_CODEC_CONFIG... FORMAT_CHANGED is a dequeue *return* code, not a flag. So use `if (info.flags and 4 != 0)`. Better: detect format change via `codec.outputFormat` on first output. Simplify: read outputFormat after INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED (dequeue returns that code). Let me handle `MediaCodec.INFO_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGED` in the loop.

5. VoiceCatalog: `okhttp.Request.Builder()` where okhttp is the OkHttpClient instance param named `okhttp` — I named the param `okhttp: OkHttpClient` then wrote `okhttp.Request.Builder()` meaning class. Rename param to `client`.

6. ProjectStore.kt:102 "Unclosed comment" — the KDoc contains `/*` ... Actually my comment `projects/<id>/...` contains `*/`? Look: "* projects/<id>/project.json      — проект, роли, клипы, настройки" ... The line `* projects/<id>/pages/<file>      — изображения страниц` fine. Hmm "Unclosed comment" at 102:1 — because the KDoc contains `*/` inside? `projects/<id>/clips/<id>/*.wav  — нарезки клипов` — yes! `/*.wav` contains `*/` which closes the comment early. Fix by rewording.

7. FileKinds 38: Byte vs Int comparisons: `if (str(0, 8) == "\u0089PNG...")` — str returns String, fine; line 38 is `head[0] == 0x52` → Byte vs Int. Fix by `.toInt() and 0xFF`.

8. Importer 58: `val pages = when {...}` — the `listOf(tmp)` branch gives List<File> vs List<ImportedPage> → type mismatch (Any). Fix: handle image branch separately: `listOf(decodeImage(tmp, name))`.

9. Importer 135: PdfRenderer(FileInputStream) — need FileDescriptor: `android.graphics.pdf.PdfRenderer(ParcelFileDescriptor)`; the constructor from InputStream doesn't exist (only FileDescriptor). Fix: open ParcelFileDescriptor from file.

10. Importer 193+: junrar API: `Junrar.extract(file)` doesn't exist. Correct API: `Junrar.create(File)`? The junrar library (com.github.junrar:junrar:7.x/8.x) has `com.github.junrar.Junrar` with static methods: `Junrar.extract(File)`? Let me check the actual API in the jar. Let me inspect the AAR/jar in the gradle cache to find the API.

11. Timeline 139: `resolveSize` returns Pair<Int,Int> but `Math.round(h/ratio)` is Long → coerce to Int.

12. VideoExporter 55: `CodecSurface(codec, ...)` — I removed the `codec` param from the constructor (class CodecSurface(codec: MediaCodec, width, height) — I wrote `class CodecSurface(codec: MediaCodec, private val width: Int...` then in start() I use `codec.createInputSurface()` but codec isn't a property. Need to store it: make it `private val codec: MediaCodec`.

13. VideoExporter 91: floatBuf returns FloatBuffer due to `.asFloatBuffer().apply{...}` — the apply returns FloatBuffer. Fix: return the ByteBuffer before asFloatBuffer, or declare return type ByteBuffer and structure accordingly:
```kotlin
private fun floatBuf(a: FloatArray): ByteBuffer {
    val bb = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(a.size*4).order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder())
    bb.asFloatBuffer().put(a)
    return bb
}
```

Let me check junrar API first, then fix everything.

13: async function ensureTesseractWorker(lang, logger) {

17:   if (!window.Tesseract) throw new Error('Tesseract не загружен (нет сети?)');

19:   if (_worker && _workerLang === langs) return _worker;
20:   if (_worker) { try { await _worker.terminate(); } catch (e) {} _worker = null; }
21:   _worker = await Tesseract.createWorker(langs, 1, {
22:     logger: (m) => {
23:       if (m.status === 'recognizing text' && typeof m.progress === 'number') {
24:         logger && logger(m.progress);
25:       }
26:     },
27:   });
28:   _workerLang = langs;
29:   return _worker;
30: }

32: function wordsToBubbles(words, pageW, pageH, { rtl = false, vertical = false } = {}) {
33:   const mapped = words
34:     .filter(w => w.text && String(w.text).trim())
35:     .map(w => ({
36:       x: w.bbox.x0, y: w.bbox.y0, w: w.bbox.x1 - w.bbox.x0, h: w.bbox.y1 - w.bbox.y0,
37:       text: w.text, conf: w.confidence,
38:     }));
39:   const bubbles = clusterBubbleWords(mapped, pageW, pageH);
40:   return sortBubblesReadingOrder(bubbles, { rtl, vertical });
41: }

43: async function makeCanvas(url, maxDim = 1600) {
44:   const img = await loadImage(url);
45:   const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight || 1));
46:   const c = document.createElement('canvas');
47:   c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.naturalWidth * scale));
48:   c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.naturalHeight * scale));
49:   c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
50:   return c;

65:     try {
66:       onProgress(0.05);
67:       const boxes = await detectBubbles(canvas, {
68:         onProgress: (n) => onProgress(0.05 + n * 0.4),
69:         onModel: () => onProgress(0.08, 'первое скачивание модели облачков (~108МБ)…'),
70:       });
71:       if (boxes.length) {

82:         onProgress(0.98);

98:       vertical: lang === 'jpn',

100:     return { bubbles, raw: data.text || '', w: canvas.width, h: canvas.height, boxes: true };
101:   }

103:   // vision-провайдер из каталога: OCR-селект = конкретный ИИ-провайдер.

228:   const minSil = Math.max(1, Math.floor(minSilence / (winMs / 1000)));

270: export function cleanMp3Frames(bytes) {
271:   const out = [];
272:   let i = 0;
273:   const n = bytes.length;
274:   while (i < n - 4) {
275:     if ((bytes[i] & 0xff) === 0xff && (bytes[i + 1] & 0xe0) === 0xe0) {
276:       const h = ((bytes[i] << 24) | (bytes[i + 1] << 16) | (bytes[i + 2] << 8) | bytes[i + 3]) >>> 0;
277:       const ver = (h >> 19) & 3;      // 0=V2.5, 1=res, 2=V2, 3=V1
278:       const layer = (h >> 17) & 3;    // 1=Layer III
279:       const brI = (h >> 12) & 0xf;
280:       const srI = (h >> 10) & 3;
281:       const pad = (h >> 9) & 1;
282:       if ((ver === 3 || ver === 2 || ver === 0) && layer === 1 && brI !== 0 && brI !== 0xf && srI !== 3) {
283:         let br, sr;
284:         if (ver === 3) {
285:           br = MP3_BR_V1[brI];
286:           sr = MP3_SR_V1[srI];
287:         } else if (ver === 2) {
288:           br = MP3_BR_V2[brI];
289:           sr = MP3_SR_V2s[srI];
290:         } else { // ver === 0 (V2.5)
291:           br = MP3_BR_V2[brI];
292:           sr = MP3_SR_V25[srI];
293:         }
294:         const len = Math.floor((ver === 3 ? 144 : 72) * br * 1000 / sr) + pad;
295:         if (br && sr && len > 0 && i + len <= n) {
296:           out.push(bytes.subarray(i, i + len));
297:           i += len;
298:           continue;
299:         }
300:       }
301:     }
302:     i++;
303:   }
304:   const total = out.reduce((s, a) => s + a.length, 0);
305:   const res = new Uint8Array(total);
306:   let p = 0;
307:   for (const a of out) { res.set(a, p); p += a.length; }
308:   return res;
