---

## 5. CASTING (`js/cast.js`) — automatic role distribution

**A. Name normalization** `normName(s)`: replace `[«»"“”'`*_~]`→space → collapse spaces → trim → strip trailing `[.!?,;:…]+` → collapse → trim → `toLowerCase` → `ё→е`.
- `NARRATOR='Нарратор'`. `NARRATOR_KEYS` = {нарратор, рассказчик, автор, закадровый, текст, narrator, narrator voice, off-screen, offscreen, ос, s.e.}.
- `UNKNOWN_KEYS` = {?, неизвестно, неясно, unknown, none, -, —, нет, n/a} or empty → **unassigned**, never auto-assigned to first role.
- `normGender` → `male|female|other` from `m|male|man|masc|муж|м` / `f|female|woman|fem|жен|ж`; `normVoiceGender` → `'m'|'f'|''`.

**B. `mergeCharacters(characters, existing, mkId)`** (AI answer → project roles):
1. Build `existingByName: normName→role` (first wins; duplicates in project tolerated).
2. For each AI char: skip if `isUnknownName`; skip if normName already seen (model duplicated); reuse existing role if free (`taken` set), else create `{id:mkId(), name:rawName, gender, isNew:true}`; fill `byName` + `speakers`; **only fill gender if existing was `other`**.
3. `unused` = normalized names of existing roles not in `byName`, excluding narrator names.
4. Returns `{characters, byName, speakers, unused}`.

**C. `resolveSpeaker(speaker, ctx, {narratorRoleId})`**: empty/unknown → `''`; narrator + narratorRoleId → narrator; exact `speakers` hit; else **prefix match** either direction (`Саске` ↔ `Саске Учиха`); else `''`.

**D. `planCasts(characters, voices, {langPrefix, manual:Set, narratorRoleId})` → Map roleId→{voice, reason}`:
1. `keyOf = c.roleId ?? c.id`.
2. `langPool` = voices whose `lang.toLowerCase().startsWith(langPrefix.toLowerCase())`; `useLangPool = langPool.length >= characters.length` (else fall back to full pool); `base = useLangPool ? langPool : pool`.
3. `used` = every already-assigned voice (incl. manual).
4. Pass 1 — keep manual/assigned: `if (c.voice && (manual.has(id) || !manual.size))` → `reason:'manual'`.
5. Pass 2 — pending with a required gender (narrator exempt; `other` intentionally unconstrained) take first free `base` voice of that gender → `reason:'gender'`.
6. Pass 3 — pending: any free `base` voice → `'free'` or `'other-lang'`.
7. Pass 4 — none left: reuse `base[0] || pool[0]` → `'reused'`.
8. Post-pass: if final voice's lang doesn't start with `langPrefix` and reason is not manual/reused → reason forced to `'other-lang'` (reason must reflect reality, not the pass).
`CAST_REASON = {manual:'вручную', gender:'по полу', free:'свободный', 'other-lang':'другой язык', reused:'повтор: голосов не хватило'}`.

**E. Data written back** (`aiRoles`/`autoCast`): new `project.roles` entries (emoji from gender, color = next `ROLE_COLORS`); `role.gender`, `role.emoji` sync, `role.voice`, `role.castReason`; `bubble.roleId`; AI call is batched `ROLE_BATCH=60` lines, `minGap 6000`; system prompt verbatim:
`Ты — режиссёр дубляжа манги/комикса. Определи, кто говорит каждую реплику. Язык реплик: <langName>. Правила: 1. В characters перечисли КАЖДОГО говорящего один раз: {"name":"Имя","gender":"male|female|other"}. 2. В lines верни {"idx":…,"character":"имя ровно как в characters"} для КАЖДОЙ реплики. 3. Имя выбирай устойчиво: один и тот же герой на всех страницах должен называться одинаково, сначала по имени, а не по прозвищу. 4. Закадровый текст, внутренний монолог и мысли автора — character: "Нарратор". 5. Если говорящего определить невозможно — character: "?" (не выдумывай имя). 6. Верни строго JSON без пояснений.`

**F. `planTakes/resolveTakes/planCasts` for clip takes**: `planTakes(lineDurs, segDurs, {byDuration})` — `order[i]=i` when `byDuration=false` (record order), `unused`/`missing` reported; `byDuration=true` sorts both lists ascending by duration and greedily matches closest with a monotone pointer. `resolveTakes({lineDurs,segDurs,mode,manual})` — manual per-line `clipSeg` overrides, validated as integer in `[0, segDurs.length)` else falls back to auto. `takeMismatch(a,b) = max(a/b, b/a)`; UI warns when `> 1.6`. Voice gating: role must have `type==='clip' && clipId`; durations from `audio.duration` or `estimateSpeakDur` (`max(1.1, min(14, len/13 + 0.55)) + (has whitespace ? 0.15 : 0)`).

---

## 6. KEY FLOWS (state machines) + AUTOSAVE

- **Autosave**: `autoSaveTimer()` = debounced **600 ms** → `saveToDB()` (writes `settings` then `projectForStore()` to `kv`); warns once per failure streak: `Автосохранение: <err>`; quota message: `не хватило места в хранилище браузера. Выгрузите проект в JSON и удалите лишние страницы/нарезки`. Triggered after: import, delPage/delClip, OCR, AI roles, translate, TTS, every text/role/voice/take edit, setMusic, option change, import/reset project. **Not** triggered by: render, preview, chat (chat has its own persistence), opening modals.
- **Boot**: `init()` → read `kv.settings` (merged over defaults) → read `kv.project` (requires `Array.isArray(pages) && roles`) → rebuild `page.url` from `page.file` → `probeMetrics` → `project.settings = settings` → `bindSettings` (once) → `setChatSettings` → `initChat` → `renderAll` → `wire`.
- **import**: `handleFiles` (split by `isAudioFile`; mixed → error toast) → `importPages` (`project.kind='pages'`, per page `{id,url,file,filesize,w:0,h:0,bubbles:[]}`, `probeMetrics`, label `комикс / книга · страниц: N`, toast `Добавлено страниц: N`) or `importAudio` (`kind='clips'`, slice by silence → `clips[]`, label `аудио / голосовые нарезки · клипов: N`, toast `Звук нарезан на фразы`) → progress hidden → autosave. Hard cap `MAX_PAGES=700`.
- **ocr**: guard `Нет страниц` → per page `ocrAll` → `p.bubbles = [{id,text,tr,roleId,x,y,w,h,order}]`, `p.bubblesHaveBoxes = res.boxes!==false` → render + autosave → (`goToScript` ⇒ `settab('script')`) → toast `OCR завершён`. YOLO-first: detect boxes → OCR each box; on YOLO failure falls back to full-page Tesseract.
- **cast**: `aiRoles` guard `Сначала получите текст (OCR)` → AI → `mergeCharacters` → push new roles / sync emoji / assign `b.roleId` (`assigned`/`unnamed`, untouched items also count as unnamed) → `planCasts` → write `voice`+`castReason` → toast `Роли: персонажей: N · реплик назначено: N [· БЕЗ РОЛИ: N (разметьте вручную на вкладке «Сценарий»)] [· голосов не хватило — N персонажей с общим голосом] [· N персонажей получили голос другого языка] [· пачек: N] [· лишних ролей в проекте: N]`, level `err` if `unnamed||reused`.
- **translate**: guard `Перевод отключён в настройках` (`donot`) / `Нет реплик` → `translateLines` (batches of 30, `minGap 4000`, `sleep 300`) → `b.tr` → toast `Переведено N из M [· без перевода: K]`.
- **voice**: `ttsAll` guard `Браузерные голоса нельзя записать в видео — включите Edge-TTS` / `Нет реплик для озвучки` → `buildTakeMap` → per bubble: clip role uses mapped segment (`{blob,duration,noTrim:true}` + `b.clipSeg=si`), else `synthesizeLine(settings,text,{voice,pitch,rate,volume,style})` → `{blob,duration:0}` → back-fill durations → toast `Озвучка: озвучено: X/Y [· нарезками: N] [· озвучкой: N] [· БЕЗ нарезки (озвучено ИИ): N]`. Single-line play (`bubblePlay`) synthesizes on demand (`Реплика озвучена (Edge)`).
- **render**: `doPreview` guard `Нет страниц` → `resolveCanvas(res, project)` → modal `Предпросмотр` (class `cv`) → `previewStart` → hint `▶ <msg>` / `■ конец`. `doRender` guard `Сначала добавьте страницы`; if `voiced===0` toast `Реплики не озвучены — нажмите «Озвучить все»` (non-fatal) → `renderAndRecord(project,{res,fps})` → WebM + dl-link + `▶ MP4 (ffmpeg)` / `◆ GIF (ffmpeg)` → `Видео готово`. `doAudioOnly` guard `Сначала озвучьте реплики` → `voicecomic_audio_<ts>.wav` + `▶ MP3` → `Аудио-дорожка готова`.
- **export script**: two downloads `scenario.txt` (`[стр] Роль: текст (перевод)`) and `scenario.json` `{projectName:'VoiceComic', rows:[{page,role,text,tr,voiced}]}`.
- **timeline** (`buildTimeline`): gap = `settings.gap/1000`; per page `+0.55` entry, `+0.25` before first bubble else `+gap`, bubble dur = `audio.duration || estimateSpeakDur`, `+gap*0.6` after each, `+0.5` still, `total = t + 0.9`; page with no bubbles → one `kind:'idle'` item of `1.8 s`.
- **reset**: `resetAll()` (revokes objectURLs, `project=defaultProject()`, `settings=defaultSettings()`, re-binds, no autosave of old data).

---

## 7. RUSSIAN USER-FACING STRINGS THAT ENCODE UX RULES (verbatim)

- `Тип файла определяется автоматически. Многофайловые архивы обрабатываются на устройстве — данные никуда не уходят.`
- `Аудио и изображения в одном списке: обработаны только страницы — загрузите по отдельности`
- `Каждому персонажу — свой голос Edge-TTS с интонацией (высота, темп, громкость) или собственный голосовой клип. «Подобрать голоса» расставит голоса с учётом пола и языка, не трогая те, что вы выбрали вручную; «+ Персонаж» — добавить нового.`
- `Если герой озвучен нарезками, ниже появится раздача нарезок по его репликам — с прослушиванием и ручной привязкой.`
- `Клип не выбран — выберите его выше, чтобы раздать нарезки`
- `В клипе нет нарезок (загрузите аудио заново, чтобы фразы разрезались по тишине)`
- `У героя пока нет реплик — разметьте роли или назначьте их вручную`
- `⚠ без нарезки: N — озвучтся ИИ` / `лишних нарезок: N` / `— без нарезки (озвучить ИИ) —`
- `БЕЗ РОЛИ: N (разметьте вручную на вкладке «Сценарий»)` / `БЕЗ нарезки (озвучено ИИ): N`
- `повтор: голосов не хватило` / `другой язык`
- `Браузерные голоса нельзя записать в видео — включите Edge-TTS`
- `Формат: WebM сразу, MP4 / GIF перекодируются движком ffmpeg.wasm прямо в браузере.`
- `Всё можно оставить по умолчанию — бесплатно и без ключей: распознавание на устройстве (Tesseract), ИИ-разметка/перевод через Pollinations, голоса Edge-TTS.`
- `YOLOv8-seg, обучена на манге/комиксах. Модель скачивается при первом использовании и хранится на устройстве (IndexedDB).`
- `Модель уже скачана. Удалить и скачать заново?`
- `Демо-модели Zen (big-pickle, mimo-v2.5-free, nemotron-3-ultra-free, …) работают без ключа только через релей … каждый открытый свободный счёт де-факто использует сервер релея — публикуйте его аккуратно.`
- `Фильтры: 🆓 без ключа · бесплатно · платно · 👁 vision · 🧠 умные · ⚡ быстрые · 🎛 оркестратор.`
- `Автосохранение включено. Установите приложение на главный экран (Chrome → «Добавить на главный экран») — оно будет открываться как APK-приложение.`
- `Экспортирован сценарий без звука/страниц — файлы импортируйте отдельно`
- `НЕ привязано страниц: N — загрузите исходный файл (PDF/CBZ/картинки) и импортируйте проект ещё раз`
- `не хватило места в хранилище браузера. Выгрузите проект в JSON и удалите лишние страницы/нарезки`
- `Браузер не дал запустить AudioContext (нужен жест пользователя — нажмите кнопку ещё раз)`
- `Архив <ext> не поддерживается: используйте ZIP/CBZ или RAR/CBR`
- `Сбросить проект и настройки?` / `Начать новый проект?` / `Удалить текущую сессию чата?`

Read these files in /home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code:
- js/ai.js (782 lines) — fully

I am porting this app to a NATIVE Android Kotlin app. The node relay (relay/zen-relay.mjs) will be REPLACED by a native Kotlin OkHttp relay/proxy inside the APK, and the model catalogue will be shipped as a JSON asset. I need a precise, implementation-ready spec.

Report with EXACT details:
1. Every AI provider that is hardcoded in ai.js: id, display name, base URL, endpoint path, auth header format, model list, whether it needs a key, vision support, and the exact request/response JSON shape (streaming SSE parsing, non-streaming). Include Pollinations, OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenCode Zen, and every other hardcoded provider.
2. The OpenCode Zen specifics: base URL, chat endpoint vs responses endpoint, the EXACT list of free/no-key models with their ids, and the required identity headers (User-Agent, x-opencode-session/request/client/project, stream flag, tool format differences between chat and responses endpoints).
3. relay/zen-relay.mjs: what it does exactly — which headers it adds/overrides and which it strips (full list), how it forwards the body, how it handles streaming, what the "official tools" payloads are, CORS handling, port, and any path rewriting. This will be reimplemented natively — be exhaustive about header manipulation.
4. The model catalogue (models.dev): top-level structure, per-provider fields (id, name, env keys, npm, api, doc), per-model fields (id, name, attachment/vision, reasoning, tool_call, modalities, open_weights, cost, limit), cost/limit structure. Give 1 concrete small example of a provider entry and a model entry verbatim (trim long arrays).
5. How the model picker filters work (all filter keys and their exact semantics: nokey, free, paid, vision, smart, fast, orchestrator, search), and how "verify live" works (exact request, timeout, what counts as success).
6. chat.js: the chat feature — message data model, streaming, attachments (field names, how images/files are attached), the exact request built for the model, and the on-device vs backend difference.
7. yolo.js: what "YOLO" does here (cache? detection?), its data model, and how it interacts with the rest of the app.
8. All prompt texts used by the app (cast/role assignment, translation, OCR vision, chat system prompt, yolo) — verbatim, including the JSON response schema each prompt demands.

Output as a dense technical spec, max 300 lines. Verbatim strings for prompts, header names, model ids, URLs. This is research only — do NOT modify any files.
I'll start by reading the key files in parallel.

466: /* Универсальный вызов OpenAI-совместимых API (Pollinations/OpenRouter/OpenAI/
467:  * Groq/DeepSeek/Mistral/Together/xAI/Perplexity/Cerebras/custom) с ретраями
468:  * при 429/5xx и парсингом JSON-ответа. */
469: async function openAICompat({ name, endpoint, headers = {}, key = '', model, messages, json = false, gap = 2500, signal }) {
470:   const hd = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(key ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + key } : {}), ...headers };
471:   let attempt = 0, waits = 0;
472:   let wantJsonMode = json; // не все провайдеры понимают response_format
473:   while (true) {
474:     const body = { model, messages, temperature: temperatureFor(model, wantJsonMode) };
475:     if (body.temperature === undefined) delete body.temperature;
476:     if (wantJsonMode) body.response_format = { type: 'json_object' };
477:     try {
478:       const r = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: hd, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal });
479:       if (r.status === 429 && waits < 3) { waits++; await sleep(5000 * waits); continue; }
480:       if (!r.ok) {
481:         const t = await r.text().catch(() => '');
482:         // провайдер не умеет response_format — пробуем без него, это не ошибка запроса
483:         if (wantJsonMode && r.status === 400 && /response_format|json_object/i.test(t)) {
484:           wantJsonMode = false; attempt = 0; continue;
485:         }
486:         const err = new Error(`${name} ${r.status}: ${t.slice(0, 180)}`);
487:         err.status = r.status;
488:         throw err;
489:       }
490:       const j = await r.json();
491:       let out = (j.choices && j.choices[0] && (j.choices[0].message || {}).content) || '';
492:       if (wantJsonMode) {
493:         const parsed = parseJsonLoose(typeof out === 'string' ? out : JSON.stringify(out));
494:         if (parsed) return parsed;
495:       }
496:       return out;
497:     } catch (e) {
498:       if (e.name === 'AbortError') throw e;
499:       // 4xx (кроме 429, который обработан выше) — запрос неверный, повтор не поможет
500:       if (e.status >= 400 && e.status < 500) throw e;
501:       if (attempt >= 3) throw e;
502:       await sleep(gap * (attempt + 1));
503:       attempt++;
504:     }
505:   }
506: }

510: const REASONING_MODELS = /^(o[1-9]\d*(\.\d+)?(-|$)|gpt-5|codex)/i;

512: function temperatureFor(model, json) {
513:   if (json) return 0.1;
514:   if (REASONING_MODELS.test(String(model || ''))) return undefined;
515:   return 0.5;
516: }

697: export async function analyzeRoles(settings, lines, opts = {}) {

707:   for (let b = 0; b < batches.length; b++) {
708:     const part = batches[b];

710:     const sys = 'Ты — режиссёр дубляжа манги/комикса. Определи, кто говорит каждую реплику. ' +

1: /* Обнаружение речевых пузырей (облачков) в странице комикса через YOLO ONNX.
2:  * Поддерживает несколько версий YOLO (v8 nano/s/m/l/x, кастомные URL).
3:  * Модели кэшируются в IndexedDB под уникальными ключами 'model:bubbles:<modelId>'.
4:  * Инференс — onnxruntime-web (WASM).
5:  */

9: /* Реестр известных моделей. Каждая модель: { id, name, url, size, nPred, imgsz }
10:  * nPred = 4 bbox + nc classes + maskCoeffs (YOLOv8-seg nc=1 → 4+1+32=37)
11:  * Для nano/s/m/l/x структура одинакова, отличается только веса.
12:  * Кастомная модель — пользователь задаёт URL, мы предполагаем стандартный v8-seg.
13:  */
14: export const YOLO_MODELS = {
15:   'yolov8m-seg-bubble': {
16:     id: 'yolov8m-seg-bubble',
17:     name: 'YOLOv8m-seg (kitsumed/speech-bubble)',
18:     url: 'https://huggingface.co/kitsumed/yolov8m_seg-speech-bubble/resolve/main/model_dynamic.onnx',
19:     size: 108982949,
20:     nPred: 37,
21:     imgsz: 640,

31: function loadScript(src) {
32:   return new Promise((res, rej) => {
33:     const s = document.createElement('script');
34:     s.src = src;

37:     document.head.appendChild(s);

44:     await loadScript(ORT_SRC);
45:     window.ort.env = window.ort.env || {};

78: export async function bubbleModelStatus() {
79:   const id = _currentModelId;
80:   try {
81:     const meta = await idbGet(metaKey(id));
82:     if (meta && meta.bytes) return { ready: true, bytes: meta.bytes, modelId: id };

106:  * из IndexedDB и создавался новый InferenceSession (на 100 страницах это
107:  * 10.8 ГБ чтения и минуты на пересборку сессии). */

113: /** Скачать байты модели (или взять уже скачанные). */
114: async function modelBytes(modelId, onProgress) {
115:   const cached = await idbGet(modelKey(modelId));
116:   if (cached && cached.byteLength) return cached;
117:   const model = YOLO_MODELS[modelId];
118:   if (!model || !model.url) throw new Error('модель ' + modelId + ': не задан URL');
119:   const r = await fetch(model.url);
120:   if (!r.ok) throw new Error('модель ' + modelId + ': HTTP ' + r.status);
121:   const total = +r.headers.get('content-length') || 0;
122:   const rd = r.body.getReader();
123:   const chunks = [];
124:   let got = 0;
125:   while (true) {
126:     const { done, value } = await rd.read();
127:     if (done) break;
128:     chunks.push(value);
129:     got += value.length;
130:     if (total && onProgress) onProgress(got / total);
131:   }
132:   const bytes = new Uint8Array(got);
133:   let off = 0;
134:   for (const c of chunks) { bytes.set(c, off); off += c.length; }
135:   await idbSet(modelKey(modelId), bytes);
136:   await idbSet(metaKey(modelId), { bytes, version: Date.now() });
137:   return bytes;
138: }

140: /** Сессия для модели (создаётся один раз). */
141: async function getSession(ort, modelId, onProgress, onModel) {
142:   if (_session && _sessionId === modelId) return _session;
143:   const known = await bubbleModelStatus();
144:   let bytes;
145:   if (known.ready) {
146:     bytes = await idbGet(modelKey(modelId));
147:   } else {
148:     if (onModel) onModel();
149:     bytes = await modelBytes(modelId, onProgress);
150:   }
151:   _sessionId = modelId;
152:   _session = await ort.InferenceSession.create(bytes, { executionProviders: ['wasm'] });
153:   return _session;
154: }

156: /** Скачать модель (с прогрессом) и вернуть [InferenceSession, bytes]. */
157: export async function downloadBubbleModel(onProgress, modelId = _currentModelId) {
158:   const ort = await ensureOrt();
159:   const bytes = await modelBytes(modelId, onProgress);
160:   const ses = await getSession(ort, modelId, onProgress);
161:   return [ses, bytes];

172: /* letterbox: вписать canvas в target×target без искажений, норм 0..1, RGB */
173: function letterbox(img, target) {
174:   const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
175:   const ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
176:   const ratio = Math.min(target / iw, target / ih);
177:   const nw = Math.max(1, Math.round(iw * ratio));
178:   const nh = Math.max(1, Math.round(ih * ratio));
179:   const dx = Math.round((target - nw) / 2);
180:   const dy = Math.round((target - nh) / 2);
181:   const c = document.createElement('canvas');
182:   c.width = target; c.height = target;
183:   const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
184:   ctx.fillStyle = '#808080';
185:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, target, target);
186:   ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, nw, nh);
187:   const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, target, target).data;
188:   const rgb = new Float32Array(3 * target * target);
189:   for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < data.length; i += 4, j += 3) {
190:     rgb[j] = data[i] / 255; rgb[j + 1] = data[i + 1] / 255; rgb[j + 2] = data[i + 2] / 255;
191:   }
192:   return { data: rgb, ratio, dx, dy };
193: }

195: /* Декод output0 [1,N_PRED,N] -> [{x,y,w,h,conf}] в координатах исходного канваса */
196: function decode(pred, ratio, dx, dy, W, H) {
197:   const N = pred.length / _nPred;
198:   const out = [];
199:   for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) {
200:     const sc = pred[4 * N + j];
201:     if (sc < CONF) continue;
202:     const cx = pred[0 * N + j], cy = pred[1 * N + j], w = pred[2 * N + j], h = pred[3 * N + j];
203:     const x1 = (cx - w / 2 - dx) / ratio;
204:     const y1 = (cy - h / 2 - dy) / ratio;
205:     const x2 = (cx + w / 2 - dx) / ratio;
206:     const y2 = (cy + h / 2 - dy) / ratio;
207:     out.push({
208:       x: Math.max(0, x1), y: Math.max(0, y1),
209:       w: Math.min(W, x2) - Math.max(0, x1), h: Math.min(H, y2) - Math.max(0, y1),
210:       conf: sc,
211:     });
212:   }
213:   return out;
214: }

216: function iou(a, b) {
217:   const ix = Math.max(0, Math.min(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w) - Math.max(a.x, b.x));
218:   const iy = Math.max(0, Math.min(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h) - Math.max(a.y, b.y));
219:   const inter = ix * iy;
220:   const ua = a.w * a.h + b.w * b.h - inter;
221:   return ua ? inter / ua : 0;
222: }

Now let me analyze models.dev.js structure fully with Python.

Also check the `tools/gen-models.mjs` for how the catalogue is generated. And grep for streaming SSE, prompts in other files.

Note: The user asked about models.dev fields (id, name, env keys, npm, api, doc) and per-model fields (attachment/vision, reasoning, tool_call, modalities, open_weights, cost, limit). But the bundled file is a *reduced* version: {name, key, fmt, endpoint, vision, models:[[id,free,label]]}. Let me verify the exact set of top-level keys across all providers, and check whether env/npm/api/doc exist. cd /home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code && python3 -c "
import json,re
s=open('js/models.dev.js',encoding='utf-8').read()
i=s.index('{')
d=json.loads(s[i:s.rindex('}')+1])
print('providers:',len(d))
keys=set()
for v in d.values(): keys|=set(v.keys())
print('TOP-LEVEL KEYS UNION:',sorted(keys))
from collections import Counter
c=Counter()
for v in d.values(): c[tuple(sorted(v.keys()))]+=1
for k,n in c.most_common(): print(n,'->',k)
print()
for pid in ['opencode','openrouter','anthropic','gemini','openai','pollinations','groq','deepseek','cerebras','local','custom','xai','perplexity','mistral','together','deepinfra']:
    if pid in d: print(pid, json.dumps({k:v for k,v in d[pid].items() if k!='models'},ensure_ascii=False), 'nmodels=',len(d[pid]['models']))
    else: print(pid,'ABSENT')
print()
# empty endpoint count
print('endpoint==\"\":',[k for k,v in d.items() if not v.get('endpoint')])
print('fmt values:',Counter(v.get('fmt') for v in d.values()))
print('key values:',Counter(str(v.get('key')) for v in d.values()))
print('vision values:',Counter(str(v.get('vision')) for v in d.values()))
"

Else **only if `d.endpoint` is non-empty** create `{name:d.name, key:true, openai:d.fmt==='openai', anthropic:d.fmt==='anthropic', curated:false, endpoint:d.endpoint, vision:d.vision===true, models}`.
   ⚠️ Consequence: `anthropic`, `openai`, `groq`, `cerebras`, `xai`, `perplexity`, `mistral` exist in models.dev with `endpoint:""` and are **skipped** (23 providers dropped). `opencode`, `gemini`, `pollinations`, `together`, `local`, `custom` are absent from models.dev. `openrouter` and `deepseek` exist → their extra models are merged in (openrouter → 385 models total). `provider(id)` falls back to `PROVIDERS.custom` for unknown ids.

### Request/response shapes (exact)
**OpenAI-compat** (`openAICompat`, ai.js:469-506) — request body:
```json
{ "model": "<mid>", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"…"}], "temperature": 0.5,
  "response_format": {"type":"json_object"} }
```
- `temperatureFor(model, json)`: `json→0.1`; else `undefined` (field deleted) when `REASONING_MODELS = /^(o[1-9]\d*(\.\d+)?(-|$)|gpt-5|codex)/i` matches; else `0.5`.
- `response_format` only when `opts.json`; if HTTP **400** and body matches `/response_format|json_object/i` → drop it and retry once (`wantJsonMode=false; attempt=0`).
- Response read: `j.choices[0].message.content` (string, may be array → `JSON.stringify` then `parseJsonLoose`). If `json` requested, `parseJsonLoose` first.
- **Retry policy**: `429` → up to 3 waits, `sleep(5000*waits)` then re-send (same body). Other errors: `AbortError` rethrown; `400..499` (except handled 429) rethrown immediately; otherwise max 3 retries with `sleep(gap*(attempt+1))`; error message format `` `${name} ${status}: ${text.slice(0,180)}` `` with `err.status` set.
- Images: `messagesWithImages` appends to **every** `user` message the same part `{type:'image_url', image_url:{url: img.dataURL||img}}` using **`images[0]` only** (ai.js:436-446). String content is first wrapped into `[{type:'text',text:…}]`.

**Gemini** (`chatGemini`, ai.js:529-572) — URL `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent?key={key}`; headers only `Content-Type`. Body:
```json
{ "contents": [{"role":"user"|"model","parts":[{"text":"…"}]}],
  "systemInstruction": {"parts":[{"text":"<joined system msgs, \n\n>"}]} }
```
- `role:'assistant'→'model'`; system messages joined with `\n\n` and never sent as turns; if `contents` empty → `[{role:'user',parts:[{text:'ping'}]}]`.
- Image: pushed into the **last** part list as `{"inline_data":{"mime_type":<from dataURL 'data:X;base64,' → X, default 'image/jpeg'>,"data":<b64>}}`.
- Response: `j.candidates[0].content.parts.map(p=>p.text).join('')`; if empty and `candidates[0].finishReason !== 'STOP'` → throw `Gemini {finishReason} ({promptFeedback.blockReason})` with `status=400`. Retry: 429 ×3 @ `5000*waits`; else `sleep(gap*attempt)`, max 3. Error message `Gemini {status}: {text.slice(0,150)}`.
- `chatGeminiVision` (exported, ai.js:622) — no retry: `{"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":prompt},{"inline_data":{...}}]}]}`, throws `` `Gemini vision ${status}` ``.

**Anthropic** (`chatAnthropic`, ai.js:574-620) — headers `{'Content-Type':'application/json','x-api-key':key,'anthropic-version':'2023-06-01'}`. Body:
```json
{ "model":"…", "max_tokens":4096, "messages":[{"role":"user"|"assistant","content":"…|[…]"}], "system":"<joined system msgs, \n\n>" }
```
- Empty messages → `[{role:'user',content:'ping'}]`. Image appended to last message content as `{"type":"image","source":{"type":"base64","media_type":<mime>,"data":<b64>}}`; `chatAnthropicVision` (ai.js:669) uses regex `/^data:([^;]+);base64,(.*)$/s`, else `{"type":"image","source":{"type":"url","url":dataURL}}`, `max_tokens:4096`, no retry. Response: `(j.content||[]).map(x=>x.text).join('')`. Same 429/4xx/retry policy as Gemini (`Claude {status}: …`).

**Pollinations model list** — `GET https://text.pollinations.ai/models` → array; keep entries with `tier === 'anonymous'`, add `m.name` + every `m.aliases[]` into a Set (`refreshFreeModels`, ai.js:360). `mergeFreeModels('pollinations', list)` appends `{id, free:true}` to `PROVIDERS.pollinations.models` and returns the count added; then `invalidateModelCache()` in modelsui. Fallback `FREE_MODELS_FALLBACK = ['openai']`.

## 3. `relay/zen-relay.mjs` — exhaustive behaviour
**Server**: `node:http`, port = `process.argv[2] || process.env.ZEN_RELAY_PORT || 8789`. Routes: `GET /healthz` → `{ok:true, zen:'https://opencode.ai/zen/v1', version:'1.18.31', tools:11}`; `POST /v1/chat/completions` → `handleChat`; `OPTIONS *` → 204; everything else → 404 `{error:{type:'not_found',message:<pathname>}}`. No other path rewriting, no `/v1/responses` exposed to clients.
**CORS (on every response)**: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET,POST,OPTIONS`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: *`, `Access-Control-Expose-Headers: *`.
**Upstream headers — built from scratch, nothing is forwarded** (`identityHeaders`, zen-relay.mjs:74-86). Full list:
```
'Content-Type': 'application/json'
'User-Agent': `opencode/${OPENCODE_VERSION}`   // OPENCODE_VERSION = '1.18.31'
'x-opencode-client': 'cli'
'x-opencode-project': 'global'
'x-opencode-session': ocId('ses_')             // fresh per request
'x-opencode-request': ocId('msg_')             // fresh per request
'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream'
'Authorization': <client's req.headers.authorization, VERBATIM, only if present>
```
`ocId(prefix)` = `prefix + (Date.now()*0x1000).toString(16).padStart(12,'0').slice(-12) + 14 random base62 chars` → e.g. `ses_…`, `msg_…`. **Stripped (never forwarded):** every other incoming header, e.g. `content-length`, `host`, `accept-encoding`, `origin`, `referer`, cookies, `x-api-key`, custom client headers. Note `Authorization` is the *only* client header that survives, and it is **overridden by identity value only in the sense that it is re-set**; nothing is merged/preserved otherwise.
**Body forwarding**: body is read fully, `JSON.parse`d (400 `{error:{type:'invalid_request_error',message:'Bad JSON body'}}` on failure). `model` required non-empty string → else 400 `{type:'invalid_request_error',message:'model is required'}`. Then `out = {...body, model, stream:true, …}` — i.e. **all other client fields pass through unchanged**, with these overrides:
- *chat path* (`ZEN + '/chat/completions'`): `stream:true`; `tool_choice: body.tool_choice || 'auto'`; `tools: mergeTools(body.tools)` = `body.tools` verbatim if non-empty array, else the full `builtin_tools.json` array; `messages: body.messages.length ? body.messages : [{type:'user',content:'ping'}]` (note `PROBE_MSG` uses key **`type`**, not `role`); `delete out.unused`.
- *responses path* (`ZEN + '/responses'`): `stream:true`; `tool_choice:'auto'`; `tools: responsesTools()` = `builtin_tools.json` mapped to `{type:'function', name:f.function.name, description:f.function.description, parameters:f.function.parameters}` (i.e. **function object flattened**, the `function` wrapper dropped) — client tools are ignored here; `max_output_tokens: Math.max(body.max_output_tokens || 800, 800)`; `input: body.messages.map(m=>({role:m.role||'user', content:[{type:'input_text', text: textOf(m.content)}]}))` or `[{role:'user',content:[{type:'input_text',text:'ping'}]}]`; `delete out.messages`; `delete out.max_tokens`. `textOf` joins array parts' `.text` with `\n`.
**Upstream call**: `fetch(url,{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(out),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(90000)})` → network failure = 502 `{error:{type:'relay_error',message:'Upstream unreachable: '+e.message}}`. Response is fully buffered as text (`await upstream.text()`). `status !== 200` → if `content-type` contains `json` the upstream JSON body is re-sent verbatim with the **same status code**, else `{error:{type:'upstream_error',message:'Zen HTTP <status>'}}`.
**SSE folding** (this is the only streaming logic):
- `sseFoldChat`: split on `/\r?\n/`, trim, keep lines starting with `data:`, payload = `line.slice(5).trim()`; skip empty and `[DONE]`; JSON parse errors skipped. If `o.error` → remember error and continue. Else accumulate `o.choices[0].delta.content`; `finish_reason` from `choices[0].finish_reason` (default `'stop'`); `delta.reasoning_content` is **discarded** (`content += ''`). Errors → `{finish_reason:'error', error: errText(err)}`; `finish_reason==='length'` → error `'модель упёрлась в лимит длины ответа (сократите запрос)'`; empty content → `'модель вернула пустой ответ'`.
- `sseFoldResponses`: `type==='response.output_text.delta'` → `content += o.delta`; `response.completed` → `status=o.response.status||'completed'`; `response.incomplete` → `incomplete=o.response.incomplete_details`; `response.failed` or `error` or `response.error` → err. Errors: `incomplete` → `'модель не закончила ответ: '+(incomplete.reason||'incomplete')`; `status!=='completed'` → `'статус ответа zen: '+status`; empty → `'модель вернула пустой ответ'`. Success → `{content,status,stopped,finish_reason:'stop'}`.
- Any `result.error` → HTTP **502** `{error:{type: isResponses ? 'upstream_failed' : 'upstream_error', message: result.error}}` (failures are never masked by a 200 with empty content).
- Success → 200 `completionJson(model,result)` = `{id:'chatcmpl-relay-'+Date.now(), object:'chat.completion', created: Math.floor(Date.now()/1000), model, choices:[{index:0, message:{role:'assistant', content: result.content}, finish_reason}], usage}`.
- `usageOf`: real numbers from `usage.prompt_tokens|input_tokens` and `usage.completion_tokens|output_tokens` when non-zero; otherwise `{prompt_tokens:0, completion_tokens: chars, total_tokens: chars, estimated:true}` (zen sends no tokenizer).
**"Official tools" payload** = verbatim `relay/builtin_tools.json`: a top-level JSON **array of 11** `{type:'function', function:{name, description, parameters}}` objects, `parameters` = `{$schema, type:'object', properties:{…}, required:[…]}` with `$schema` present. Names + `required`: `bash`(`command`; props `command,timeout,workdir`), `edit`(`filePath,oldString,newString`; +`replaceAll`), `glob`(`pattern`; +`path`), `grep`(`pattern`; +`path,include`), `read`(`filePath`; +`offset,limit`), `skill`(`name`), `task`(`description,prompt,subagent_type`; +`task_id,command`), `todowrite`(`todos`), `webfetch`(`url`; +`format,timeout`), `websearch`(`query`; +`numResults,livecrawl,type,contextMaxCharacters`), `write`(`content,filePath`). Descriptions are long opencode-CLI English help texts. **Ship this file byte-identical as an asset** and embed as a JSON array.

## 5. Model picker (modelsui.js) — filters & live verify
Filter state `f = {cat, tab, quality, q}`; initial `{cat:'nokey', tab:'all', quality:'curated', q:''}`. `match(mt,f)` (modelsui.js:51-66) is AND-only, exact semantics:
- `f.tab !== 'all'` ⇒ `mt.pid === f.tab`.
- `f.quality === 'curated'` ⇒ `mt.curated === true` (curated ⇔ present in `CURATED_PROVIDERS`).
- `cat` chips: `all` (no test) · `nokey` ⇒ `mt.nokey` · `free` ⇒ `mt.free` · `paid` ⇒ `mt.paid` · `vision` ⇒ `mt.vision` · `smart` ⇒ `mt.smart` · `dumb` ⇒ `!mt.smart` · `orch` ⇒ `mt.orchestrator`.
- `f.q` ⇒ case-insensitive substring of `(label + ' ' + providerName + ' ' + pid + ' ' + mid)`.
`modelMeta(pid,mid)` (ai.js:288-305) fields: `{pid, mid, label(m.label||mid), providerName((p.name||pid).split(' ·')[0]), nokey: p.key===false || m.nokey===true, free: modelKind==='free', paid: modelKind==='paid', vision: p.vision===true, curated: p.curated===true, requiresKey: p.key===true, smart: isSmartModel(), orchestrator: p.orchestrator===true}`. `modelKind` ⇒ `'free'` if `p.key===false` or `m.free===true`, else `'paid'` (`nokey` alone is **not** free-tier but `isFreeModel()` treats `free||nokey||key===false` as free).
`isSmartModel` (ai.js:276-285): lowercase `(label + ' ' + mid)`; first `/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*b\b/` match → smart iff `>= 32`; else `DUMB_KEYS` ⇒ dumb (`mini|lite|light|small|tiny|fast|flash|haiku|instant|nano|micro|pico|sprint|cheap|quick|compact|pixel|\b0.\db\b|1.5b|2b|…|27b|32b|…|400b-a3b|…|gpt-oss-20b\b`); else `SMART_KEYS` ⇒ smart (`reason|rational|thinking|thinker|opus|sonnet|pro$|ultra|max$|flash-thinking|r1|r2|qwq|\bo1..o4\b|grok-3|grok-4|deepseek-v4|deepseek-r1|deepseek-chat|glm-5|kimi-k3|qwen3-(235|430|max)|premium|200b|…|1.5-trillion|trillion`); **default = smart**.
Sort `rank(mt)`: 0 curated+nokey, 1 curated+free, 2 curated+paid, 3 nokey, 4 free, 5 else; tie → provider name `localeCompare('ru')` then label. `flatCache` memoised; `invalidateModelCache()` after `mergeFreeModels`. Provider tabs (deduped by pid, "Все модели" prepended); clicking a non-curated tab forces `quality='all'`; clicking a tab whose `key===true` and has no nokey model while `cat==='nokey'` resets `cat='all'`. Model tree groups by prefix before the first `/` (`''` = root), `<details open>` when ≤6 items. Tag labels: `🆓 без ключа`, `🔁 через релей` (nokey && requiresKey), `бесплатно`/`платно`, `👁 vision`, `🎛 оркестратор`, `🧠 умная`/`⚡ быстрая`, `проверено` (curated).
**Verify live** (`probeModel`, ai.js:313-331): builds `settings = {...settings, ai:pid, aimodel:mid}`; `AbortController` with **`setTimeout(…, 20000)`**; calls `chat(s, [{role:'user',content:'ping'}], {signal, minGap:0})` — i.e. a real non-streaming request, `temperature 0.5`, no `json` mode. **Success = promise resolves** (empty string counts as success — no content check). Failure = throws; `err` string truncated to 140 chars. Result cached in `MODEL_HEALTH: Map<'pid::mid', {ok, ms, err, ts}>` (session lifetime only). `probeVisible()` probes filtered rows **sequentially** in list order. Pollinations refresh button → `refreshFreeModels()` + `mergeFreeModels('pollinations', list)`.

## 6. chat.js feature
- Persistence (store.js, IndexedDB `voicecomic` v2, stores `kv` + `chat`): sessions at `chat['sessions']` = `[{id:'s'+Date.now(), title:'Сессия DD.MM, HH:MM', ts}]`; messages at `chat['msgs:'+sid]`; current session id in `kv['chat:current']`; settings in `kv['settings']`.
- Message record: `{role:'user'|'ai'|'err'|'system', content:string, ts:number, typing?:true, files?:[{file:File, name, size, type, dataURL?, text?}]}`. UI: `msg.user|msg.ai|msg.err`; images render `<img class="att" src=dataURL>`, others `📎 name · size`; `fmtSize` = `>1048576 → (n/1048576).toFixed(1)+' МБ'`, `>1024 → Math.round(n/1024)+' КБ'`, else `n+' Б'`; all text HTML-escaped via `escapeHtml` (`& < > " '`).
- **No streaming**: a placeholder `{role:'ai', typing:true}` is shown until the single non-stream reply arrives, then replaced by `{role:'ai', content:String(answer)}` or `{role:'err', content:'Ошибка: '+msg}`.
- Attachments: from `#chat-file` `change`; `{file,name,size,type}`; images get `dataURL` via `FileReader.readAsDataURL` (async, no await before send). Text extraction: MIME must match `TEXTY = /^(text\/|application\/(json|xml|javascript|x-yaml|yaml|toml|sql|graphql))/` **or** be empty; `size > 400*1024` → skipped; binary sniff `/[\x00-\x08\x0e-\x1f]/` in first 512 chars → skipped; text truncated to 400 KB. All texts concatenated as `--- файл «NAME» ---\n<text>`, joined with `\n\n`, prefixed `'\n\n[Содержимое приложенных файлов]\n'`, whole block truncated to `MAX_TOTAL_CHARS = 24000`.
- Request: `history` = messages excluding `typing`/`err`/`system`, **last `MAX_COPY = 12`**, excluding the just-added user message; `userTurn = {role:'user', content:(text||'(без текста)') + attachBlock}`; body = `[{role:'system',content:systemPrompt}, ...history, userTurn]`. If any image → `chatWithImage(settings, msgs, images[0].dataURL)` (only the **first** image is ever sent; also flattens messages via `messages.filter(m=>m.role!=='system').map(m=>(m.role==='user'?'Пользователь: ':'ИИ: ')+m.content).join('\n')` and throws if `!provider.vision`); else `chat(...)`. Both **non-streaming**, no `opts.json`, `minGap` unset → `settings.aiGap` (2500).
- Session title: first reply sets `title = (text || files[0].name || 'Сессия').trim().slice(0,40)` only if it still starts with `'Сессия '`; sessions re-sorted by `ts` desc.
- **On-device vs backend: there is no such split in chat.js.** Every chat call is direct to the provider through ai.js. Backend modes exist only elsewhere: `settings.voiceBackend` `'edge'` (default) | `'browser'` | `'edge-proxy'` (voices.js:263, with `settings.proxy`), and `settings.backendUrl`/`backendToken` for the FastAPI terminal/files service (`backend/main.py`: `/pty` WebSocket, files list/upload/download/delete, exec, GitHub-PAT auth, `VOICECOMIC_WORKSPACE`). For a native port: chat = direct OkHttp; TTS/terminal = whatever the Kotlin equivalents are.

## 7. yolo.js — speech-bubble DETECTION (not "you only live once", not a cache)
Purpose: locate speech balloons on a comic page so Tesseract can OCR each balloon separately. On-device inference via **onnxruntime-web WASM** (1.20.1 from jsDelivr: `.../dist/ort.min.js`, `ort.env.wasm.wasmPaths = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.20.1/dist/'`).
- Registry `YOLO_MODELS` (only one entry): `yolov8m-seg-bubble` → `{id:'yolov8m-seg-bubble', name:'YOLOv8m-seg (kitsumed/speech-bubble)', url:'https://huggingface.co/kitsumed/yolov8m_seg-speech-bubble/resolve/main/model_dynamic.onnx', size:108982949, nPred:37, imgsz:640}`. `setYoloModel` also accepts `'custom'` (assumes standard v8-seg, user-supplied URL) — no registry entry exists for it.
- Cache: IndexedDB `kv['model:bubbles:<modelId>']` = raw `Uint8Array`; `kv['model:bubbles:<modelId>:meta']` = `{bytes, version|at}` (avoids reading 108 MB to test presence). `bubbleModelStatus()` → `{ready, bytes, modelId}`; `bubbleModelTargetBytes()`; `bubbleModelClear()` deletes both and invalidates the session.
- In-memory cache: module-level `_session` + `_sessionId` (one `InferenceSession` reused across pages; `ort.InferenceSession.create(bytes,{executionProviders:['wasm']})`). Download with progress via `fetch(url)` + `r.body.getReader()` reading `content-length`.
- Preprocess `letterbox(img,640)`: pad `#808080`, ratio = `min(640/w,640/h)`, centred, RGB `float32` 0..1, tensor `[1,3,640,640]`.
- Postprocess: `output0.data` decoded as `[1, N_PRED=37, N]`; class score at row `4*N+j`, bbox rows `0..3*N`; coords un-letterboxed and clamped; `CONF = 0.25`; `IOU = 0.45`; NMS drops boxes with `w<8 || h<8`. Returns `[{x,y,w,h,conf}]` in source pixels.
- Consumers: `ocr.js:64-90` (`settings.detect === 'yolo'`) → per-box `ocrRegion()` crop OCR (Tesseract or vision provider) → bubbles `{x,y,w,h,text}`; any failure falls through to the full-page OCR path. Kotlin equivalent: onnxruntime-android (AAR) + OkHttp download + the same letterbox/NMS math; no need for the 108 MB IndexedDB blob if you cache to app files dir.

## 8. All prompt texts, verbatim
**(a) OCR via vision** — `visionExtractLines` (ai.js:641-667). `${langName}` from ocr.js map (`rus:'русский', eng:'английский', chi_sim:'китайский', jpn:'японский', kor:'корейский', spa:'испанский', fra:'французский', deu:'немецкий', por:'португальский'`). No `response_format`; parsed with `parseJsonLoose`, else newline-split.
```
Прочитай весь текст на этом изображении (${langName}). Это страница манги/комикса. Верни строго JSON массив строк в том порядке, в котором их нужно читать. Внутри double quotes. Не добавляй ничего кроме JSON.
```
Demanded schema: `["строка1","строка2", …]` (array of strings, reading order).
**(b) Cast / role assignment** — `analyzeRoles` (ai.js:697-746), `ROLE_BATCH = 60` lines per request, `minGap: 6000`, `json:true`. `${langName}` from app.js:498 (`rus/eng/chi_sim/jpn/kor` only). System prompt (verbatim, with the line-break escapes shown as they are in source):
```
Ты — режиссёр дубляжа манги/комикса. Определи, кто говорит каждую реплику. Язык реплик: ${langName}. Правила:
1. В characters перечисли КАЖДОГО говорящего один раз: {"name":"Имя","gender":"male|female|other"}.
2. В lines верни {"idx":<номер из входа>,"character":"имя ровно как в characters"} для КАЖДОЙ реплики.
3. Имя выбирай устойчиво: один и тот же герой на всех страницах должен называться одинаково, сначала по имени, а не по прозвищу.
4. Закадровый текст, внутренний монолог и мысли автора — character: "Нарратор".
5. Если говорящего определить невозможно — character: "?" (не выдумывай имя).
6. Верни строго JSON без пояснений.
```
(the `Язык реплик: …` clause is omitted entirely when `langName === ''`).
User turn: `Реплики (JSON): ` + `JSON.stringify([{idx,page,text}, …])`.
Demanded schema: `{"characters":[{"name":string,"gender":"male"|"female"|"other"}],"lines":[{"idx":int,"character":string}]}`. Parsing: chars deduped by `name.toLowerCase().replace(/ё/g,'е')`; `lines` entries kept only if `Number.isInteger(idx) && idx>=0 && idx<lines.length`; a batch without a `lines` array is recorded in `missing:[{from,to}]`. Returns `{characters, items, batches, missing}` or `null` if both empty.
**(c) Translation** — `translateLines` (ai.js:751-777), batches of `B = 30`, `minGap: 4000`, `json:true`, `await sleep(300)` after each batch.
```
Ты — профессиональный переводчик манги/комиксов. Переведи реплики на язык: ${toLang}. Сохрани смысл обращений/имён. Верни строго JSON: [{"idx":0,"text":"..."}]
```
User turn: `Реплики: ` + `JSON.stringify([{idx,text}, …])`. Demanded schema: `[{"idx":int,"text":string}]`; non-array response throws `API вернул не JSON-массив: <raw.slice(0,120)>`; out-of-range/blank `idx` ignored; output array is same length as input with `null` holes. `countTranslated(out)` counts non-blank strings.
**(d) Chat system prompt** — chat.js:142, verbatim:
```
Ты — помощник пользователя приложения VoiceComic (комиксы → озвученное видео). Отвечай по-русски, коротко и по делу. Пользователь может присылать изображения и файлы: изображения разбирай как страницы манги/комикса, текстовые файлы прочитывай и комментируй.
```
Always sent as the first message; a stored `role:'system'` message is read but explicitly discarded (`void sys`).
**(e) YOLO** — **no prompts whatsoever**; pure ONNX detection. No LLM involvement.
**(f) Probe prompt** — `ping` (ai.js:320); relay fallback probe `'ping'` (zen-relay.mjs:53, `PROBE_MSG`).
**(g) Other user-visible AI strings** (verbatim): keyless-Zen error in ai.js:412-417:
```
«${model}» — free tier OpenCode Zen без ключа. Браузер не может напрямую отправить identity-заголовки opencode CLI (User-Agent, x-opencode-*), поэтому такие модели работают через мини-релей: команда «node relay/zen-relay.mjs», её URL задайте в настройках («URL Zen-релея»), либо добавьте ключ Zen.
```
plus `Свой провайдер: не задан адрес OpenAI-совместимого API`, `«<name>» не умеет смотреть изображения (выберите vision-провайдер)`, `Gemini: нужен API-ключ`, `Anthropic: нужен API-ключ`, `Claude: нужен API-ключ`, `Gemini: нужен API-ключ (Опции → ИИ-провайдер → ключ)`, `«${model}» (Jev) — это не чат-модель, а «система решений» (state+questions); в VoiceComic не используется.`
`parseJsonLoose` (ai.js:382): `JSON.parse` → else first `\{[\s\S]*\}` block → else first `\[[\s\S]*\]` block → else `null`.

### Kotlin asset checklist
`models.dev.js` → `res/raw/models.dev.json` (strip the `export const MODELS_DEV = ` wrapper, keep pure JSON); `builtin_tools.json` → `res/raw/builtin_tools.json` verbatim; curated provider table + regexes (`SMART_KEYS`, `DUMB_KEYS`, `REASONING_MODELS`, `TEXTY`, `RESPONSES_MODELS`, `JEV_MODELS`) → Kotlin objects; `ocId()` → `Date.now()*0x1000` hex + 14 base62 chars from `crypto.randomBytes(14)`; relay port 8789 and `zenRelay` setting become irrelevant once OkHttp sets `User-Agent`/`x-opencode-*` directly.

I am porting this app to a NATIVE Android Kotlin app (no WebView). I need a precise, implementation-ready spec of the Edge-TTS (Microsoft Edge read-aloud) WebSocket client so I can reimplement it in Kotlin with OkHttp WebSocket.

Report, with EXACT literal values (URLs, headers, query params, magic strings, JSON shapes, byte/format constants):
1. The full WSS endpoint URL including query string and all parameters, and the Origin/User-Agent header values used.
2. The WebSocket handshake details: sub-protocol, how the connection is opened, timeouts, and any Sec-MS-GEC token generation (if any) — describe the algorithm precisely if present.
3. The message protocol: exact text sent after connecting (the config/JSON handshake with securityId, clientVersion, etc.), then each message type sent (e.g. audio format config with `X-Timestamp`, `Content-Type: audio/mpeg`, sampleRate, channels, format, bitrate etc.), the SSML speech message with its exact template, and the PathQueryCommand/trusted client token message. Give the literal template strings.
4. How SSML is built: voice name element, prosody rate/pitch/volume attributes (exact values and how user sliders map to them, including the +N% formats), the style/emotion attribute, escaped text handling, and any normalization (SSML escaping, GEC — if the repo has a "greatest common divisor"/GEC normalization for digits, explain what it does).
5. The audio output format returned (sample rate, channels, codec, bitrate), and how the app then decodes/converts it (does it decode mp3 in JS? does it use WebAudio decodeAudioData? what sample rate does it resample to? does it use OfflineAudioContext?).
6. The voice catalogue: where the list comes from (URL or hardcoded), the shape of each voice entry (all fields: ShortName, Gender, VoiceTag, Locale, etc.), any filtering/defaults, and the full list of voices if hardcoded (list them compactly).
7. The speechSynthesis fallback path: when it triggers and how it is used.
8. Any pitch/rate/volume clamping, defaults, and per-character voice settings shape (field names used in the project data model for a character/voice).

Output as a dense technical spec in Russian or English (either is fine), max 200 lines, no code rewrites of unrelated code. Include literal strings verbatim. This is research only — do NOT modify any files.

The Android app is a WebView wrapper (MainActivity). The user is porting to native Kotlin.

Let me double-check a couple of things:
1. The `Origin` header — WebSocket browser API sets Origin automatically; the code doesn't set it. In OkHttp you can set Origin header. Let me verify there's no Origin anywhere. The code comments mention subprotocol → 403. Let me grep for "Origin" and "User-Agent" in the repo.
2. The `Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-143.0.3650.75`.
3. The voices/list URL uses `trustedclienttoken` (lowercase) while the WS URL uses `TrustedClientToken` (capitalized). Note that.
4. Binary frame parsing: hl = (buf[0]<<8)|buf[1]; chunks.push(buf.subarray(2+hl+2)) — this skips 2 bytes header length, then 2 bytes more (0x0001 audio header). Note: this discards bytes; important for Kotlin.

I have all I need. Now write the dense technical spec, max 200 lines. Include exact literal values.

Key facts to include:

1. Endpoint:
- BASE = `speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud`
- WSS: `wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4&ConnectionId=<requestId>&Sec-MS-GEC=<token>&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-143.0.3650.75`
- Note: `TrustedClientToken` capital T in WS, `trustedclienttoken` lowercase in voices/list.
- Origin: not set explicitly (browser sets it). In OkHttp you should set Origin: https://... anything; Edge accepts. Note: no UA spoofing (comment at lines 133-136). Suggest in Kotlin: User-Agent Chromium-ish string is allowed for WS (OkHttp can set UA), but repo says browser dropped it in fetch; in native you can send e.g. Mozilla/5.0 ... Chrome/143.0.0.0 — optional. I should report exact facts: the repo never sets Origin/UA for the WS; comment says identity via Sec-MS-GEC.
- voices/list: `https://${BASE}/voices/list?trustedclienttoken=...&Sec-MS-GEC=...&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-143.0.3650.75` with header `Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9`.

2. Handshake:
- No subprotocol (comment: "БЕЗ subprotocol — иначе сервер отвечает 403"). In OkHttp: Request.Builder().url(...) with no `.subprotocol(...)`.
- No compression / permessage-deflate. OkHttp default ok.
- Timeout: 65000 ms JS timer -> error 'Тайм-аут синтеза (проверьте интернет)'. OkHttp: readTimeout(65, SECONDS) plus own watchdog.
- Sec-MS-GEC algorithm:
  - WIN_EPOCH_SEC = 11644473600
  - s = msNow/1000 + 11644473600
  - s -= s % 300
  - ticks = s * 1e7 (100-ns), toFixed(0) i.e. rounded to integer, no decimals
  - string = ticks + '6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4'
  - token = SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes of that string, hex uppercase (padStart 2)
  - Version: `1-143.0.3650.75` (CHROMIUM const '143.0.3650.75'); prefix `1-`
  - Kotlin: use BigDecimal/Long; careful with double precision: s*1e7 for current time ~1.35e9 s * 1e7 = 1.35e16 which exceeds Long.MAX? Long max is 9.22e18, so fine. 1.35e16 < 9.2e18 fine. Use Long math: (ms/1000 + 11644473600) is a Long; then subtract mod 300; then *10_000_000L → 1.35e16 fits.
  - Note: token recomputed per synth call; 300-second (5 min) window.
- UUID: `uuid()` = crypto.randomUUID() with dashes stripped → 32 lowercase hex chars; fallback 16 random bytes hex.

3. Messages:
- Message A (speech.config) exact string:
```
X-Timestamp:<ts>\r\n
Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n
{"context":{"synthesis":{"audio":{"metadataoptions":{"sentenceBoundaryEnabled":"false","wordBoundaryEnabled":"true"},"outputFormat":"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3"}}}}\r\n
```
i.e. one text frame: `X-Timestamp:` + ts + `\r\nContent-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n` + json + `\r\n`

- Message B (ssml) exact:
`X-RequestId:` + requestId + `\r\nContent-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\nX-Timestamp:` + ts + `\r\nPath:ssml\r\n\r\n` + ssml  (NOTE: no trailing \r\n after SSML — code doesn't add one)

- No PathQueryCommand / no separate trusted-client-token message; TrustedClientToken only as query param. No keep-alive ping.
- X-Timestamp format: `new Date().toUTCString().replace('GMT','GMT+0000')` → e.g. `Tue, 20 Sep 2026 12:00:00 GMT+0000` (RFC1123, English day/month, 2-digit day, always +0000). Note the two messages may have different timestamps (computed separately at send time) — comment says "один и тот же корректный формат".
- Kotlin: Locale.US + DateTimeFormatter.RFC_1123_DATE_TIME with ZoneOffset.UTC then replace GMT→GMT+0000. Careful: RFC_1123 gives "GMT".

- Response handling:
  - text frames: if contains 'audio.metadata' → parse body after first '\r\n\r\n', JSON.parse(body).Metadata array; for m.Type==='WordBoundary' push {offsetMs: m.Data.Offset/10000, durMs: m.Data.Duration/10000, text: m.Data.text.Text}
  - if contains 'Path:turn.end' and !ended → ended = true; finish()
  - if /Path:response/ test && contains 'path:false' → fail 'Edge-TTS отклонил запрос (неверный голос)'
  - Note: fail() is a no-op after ended. Note ordering quirk: turn.end sets ended=true then finish() also calls clearTimeout etc. Note also that finish() doesn't set ended, so the caller does.
  - binary frames: `hl = (buf[0] << 8) | buf[1]; chunks.push(buf.subarray(2 + hl + 2))` — i.e. 2-byte big-endian header-length prefix, then skip 2 more bytes (binary header 0x0001). Only if buf.length >= 2.
  - Blob branch (irrelevant for Kotlin; async append, no offset strip).
- Then concatenate all chunks, run cleanMp3Frames(combined) → walk MPEG frames; returns Uint8Array; then Blob type 'audio/mpeg'.

4. SSML building:
- voiceLocale(voice): regex `/^\s*([a-z]{2,3})-([A-Za-z]{2}|[0-9]{3})\b/` → lowercase lang + '-' + uppercase region; else 'en-US'. Note: voice id must be lowercase lang; the \b and case-sensitivity: first group requires lowercase letters, so a voice like 'en-US-JennyNeural' works. Important nuance: since group 1 must be lowercase, ids like 'zh-CN-...' fine. So xml:lang derived from the voice id, not from the fetched Locale.
- SSML with no style:
`<speak version='1.0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis' xml:lang='ru-RU'>` + `<voice name='ru-RU-DmitryNeural'>` + `<prosody pitch='+0Hz' rate='+0%' volume='+0%'>ESCAPED</prosody>` + `</voice></speak>`
- with style:
`<speak version='1.0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis' xmlns:mstts='http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts' xml:lang='ru-RU'>` + `<voice name='...'><mstts:express-as style='cheerful' styledegree='1'>` + prosody + `</mstts:express-as></voice></speak>`
- Note single quotes for attributes, and order: pitch, rate, volume. Note styledegree='1' hardcoded. Styles list: ['', 'cheerful','excited','angry','sad','whisper','shouting','terrified','unfriendly','gentle'] (TTS_STYLES in app.js:32); UI only lists non-empty ones.
- Defaults: pitch '+0Hz', rate '+0%', volume '+0%', style undefined.
- ssmlEscape: replaces code points 0x00-0x08, 0x0B-0x0C, 0x0E-0x1F with a space; note it does NOT escape >0x1F control chars; then & < > " ' → & < > " ' (in that order; & first).
- GEC: there is no "greatest common divisor" normalization; GEC = Microsoft Edge Client token. No digit normalization anywhere in repo (verified by grep). Text passes through verbatim otherwise.
- No chunking of long text, no rate clamping at synth time; the slider clamps.

5. Audio output & decode:
- outputFormat string `audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3` → 24000 Hz, 48000 bit/s, 1 channel, MP3. Content-Type in ssml config: audio/mpeg only in Blob creation.
- Blob type: 'audio/mpeg'.
- cleanMp3Frames: frame walker constants MP3_BR_V1/V2, MP3_SR tables; accepts ver 3 (MPEG1), 2 (MPEG2), 0 (MPEG2.5) layer 1 (Layer III), brI not 0 and not 0xf, srI != 3; len = floor((ver===3?144:72) * br * 1000 / sr) + pad; loop while i < n-4; drops anything not a valid frame. So in Kotlin: if MediaCodec/MP3 decoder is used, this cleanup is optional but harmless; Android's MediaExtractor handles raw MP3 fine, but concatenation of per-message audio payloads without headers could produce non-seekable garbage — this is exactly why they walk frames. Keep it (or decode incrementally).
- Decoding: native browser `AudioContext.decodeAudioData` (uses browser/OS mp3 decoder) — no JS mp3 decoder in repo, no OfflineAudioContext anywhere. mp3 decode → AudioBuffer at 24 kHz (decodeAudioData resamples to the AudioContext's rate? Actually decodeAudioData resamples to context sample rate in Chrome). Note: measured `buf.sampleRate` used; code comment "Edge-TTS отдаёт 24 кГц, а дорожка микшируется в 44.1 кГц" implies decodeAudioData returns context rate.
- Silence trim: TRIM = { threshold: 0.012, margin: 0.05, minDur: 0.25 } exported from engine.js:24. trimSilence(samples, sr, {threshold, margin, winMs=10}) → padSamples = max(1, floor(sr*margin)) (0.05 s), win = max(1, floor(sr*winMs/1000)) (10 ms). Returns {start, end} sample indices; winMs default 10; minDur is not a trimSilence option (used as min duration clamp).
- measureTrimmedDuration: dur = (end-start)/sampleRate if end>start else buffer.duration; returns max(0.25, dur) if dur > 0.05 else null.
- Playback/mix: AudioBufferSource → GainNode(gain=roleGain) → master; per-item start(started + it.t, offset, min(dur, it.dur + 0.1)).
- Resampling: resampleLinear(src, fromSr, toSr) linear interpolation; used only in renderAudioTrack to mix to 44100 (engine.js:528, 545). For WebM recording MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode at the AudioContext's native rate (no explicit rate). WAV output: 16-bit mono 44100, encodeWav header literal: 'RIFF'/'WAVE'/'fmt '/'data', PCM mono 16-bit.
- In Android: MediaExtractor/MediaCodec MP3 decode + resample to 44100 (or AudioTrack at 24 kHz for pure preview).

6. Voice catalogue:
- Hardcoded curated list: 110 entries in EDGE_VOICES, built by helper `const V = (id, gender='m') => ({ id, lang: id.slice(0,5), gender })` — note lang = first 5 chars of id (e.g. 'ru-RU'), gender 'm'/'f'.
- Full list — provide compactly (I have it, group by locale with genders).
- Server list: fetchVoicesFromMicrosoft() merges via registerFetchedVoices: filter v.ShortName && /Neural$/.test(ShortName) → extra map keyed by ShortName; lang = normLocale(v.Locale || ShortName.slice(0,5), 'en-US'); gender = (v.Gender||'').toLowerCase().startsWith('f') ? 'f' : 'm' (so 'Female'→f, 'Male'→m).
- normLocale: replace _ with -, split, lang = parts[0].toLowerCase(), region = first part matching /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/ or /^[0-9]{3}$/ → lang + '-' + region.toUpperCase(); else lang; '' if no parts (fallback).
- Only ShortName, Locale, Gender are read from the server entry. Other server fields (VoiceTag, FriendlyName, etc.) are ignored in this app (VoiceTag mentioned in the user's question but not used — I should state that explicitly).
- allVoices(): EDGE_VOICES first, then extras not already present. voicesForLang(prefix): lowercase prefix match on v.lang. voiceById(id) exact.
- Filtering/UI: LANG_LOCALE = {rus:'ru', eng:'en-US', chi_sim:'zh-CN', jpn:'ja-JP', kor:'ko-KR', spa:'es-ES', fra:'fr-FR', deu:'de-DE', por:'pt-BR'}; pool = voicesForLang(prefix) else allVoices(); unknown current voice unshifted into the list. defaultVoice() = (pool[0] || allVoices()[0]).id. defaultRoles() uses pick(0), pick(1), pick(2) from the pool.
- cast.js planCasts auto-assignment (gender match etc.) — brief mention: castVoices() maps allVoices() to {id, lang, gender}.

7. speechSynthesis fallback:
- backend = (settings.voiceBackend || 'edge').trim(); 'edge-proxy' → edgeTTSProxy; 'browser' → returns { browser:true, play: () => browserSpeak(text, opts.voice) }; default → edgeTTSSynth(text, opts).
- browserSpeak(text, voiceName, {rate=1, pitch=1, volume=1}): SpeechSynthesisUtterance, find by v.name === voiceName in speechSynthesis.getVoices(); u.lang = voiceName ? voiceName.slice(0,5) : 'ru-RU'; resolves on onend/onerror (never rejects). Note: called with only (text, opts.voice) → rate/pitch/volume always 1. Edge ShortName won't match a browser voice name → u.voice unset, lang from id prefix.
- ttsAll() aborts with toast 'Браузерные голоса нельзя записать в видео — включите Edge-TTS' when voiceBackend==='browser'. bubblePlay() handles res.browser by calling res.play().
- edgeTTSProxy: GET with query text, voice (default 'ru-RU-DmitryNeural'), rate/pitch/volume only if truthy; falls back to POST JSON {text, voice, pitch, rate, volume} with Content-Type: application/json; returns {blob with response content-type or 'audio/mpeg', boundary: []}.

8. Clamping/defaults/data model:
- Slider ranges: pitch slider('-40','40','1') → r.pitchNum integer Hz; r.pitch = (+v>0?'+':'') + v + 'Hz' → e.g. 0 → '0Hz', 5 → '+5Hz', -5 → '-5Hz'. So no '+' for zero: literal '0Hz'.
- rate slider('-50','100','5') → r.rateNum; r.rate = (+v>0?'+':'') + v + '%' → '0%', '+15%', '-10%'.
- volume slider('10','200','5') default 100 → r.volumeNum; r.volume = (+v-100 > 0 ? '+' : '') + (v-100) + '%' → 100 → '0%', 150 → '+50%', 50 → '-50%'.
- Defaults on role creation: pitch '+0Hz', rate '+0%', volume '+0%', style '', type 'edge', clipId ''.
- Role object fields: { id, name, emoji, color, voice, pitch, rate, volume, style, type:'edge'|'clip', clipId, gender, manualVoice, pitchNum, rateNum, volumeNum, takeMode }.
- roleGain(role): uses volumeNum (100 = unity) else parse role.volume string `/^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%\s*$/` → pct = 100 + parseFloat(m[1]); clamps to [0,2] (max(0, min(2, pct/100))). So the volume prosody attribute is in -90%..+100% range but the JS mixing gain clamp is 0..2.
- Bubble audio: b.audio = { blob, duration, noTrim? }.
- No clamping inside voices.js — pitch/rate/volume strings go verbatim into prosody; defaults applied by destructuring defaults and by app.js `(role && role.pitch) || '+0Hz'` fallbacks.

Also note: styles are only valid for voices supporting them; and SSML with style adds mstts namespace.

# Edge-TTS client spec (source of truth: `js/voices.js` + `js/util.js` + `js/engine.js`)

## 0. Files
- `/home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code/js/voices.js` (282 L) — WS client, SSML, catalogue, proxy, fallback
- `/home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code/js/util.js` — `TRUSTED_CLIENT_TOKEN`, `nowEdgeString`, `secMsgGecValue`, `sha256HexBrowser`, `uuid`, `ssmlEscape`, `cleanMp3Frames`, `trimSilence`
- `/home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code/js/app.js` — callers: `synthesizeLine()` (L693, L818), sliders L931-933, `TTS_STYLES` L32, `LANG_LOCALE` L26
- `/home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code/js/engine.js` — decode/trim/resample, `TRIM` L24, `resampleLinear` L118
- Tests asserting this contract: `/home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code/tests/smoke.mjs` L385-401

## 1. Endpoints, headers, constants
```
BASE     = 'speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud'
CHROMIUM = '143.0.3650.75'
TRUSTED_CLIENT_TOKEN = '6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4'   // util.js:6
WIN_EPOCH_SEC = 11644473600                                  // util.js:7
```
WSS URL (built in `edgeTTSSynth`, voices.js:176-177) — exact, in this order:
```
wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4&ConnectionId=<requestId>&Sec-MS-GEC=<token>&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-143.0.3650.75
```
- `<requestId>` = 32 lowercase hex chars, no dashes (`uuid()`: `crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g,'')`; fallback = 16 random bytes hex).
- **Origin**: never set explicitly (browser supplied it). In OkHttp add e.g. `Origin: https://speech.platform.bing.com` (or any value) — server does not validate it strictly, but keep one.
- **User-Agent**: never sent. Comment voices.js:133-136 states UA spoofing was dead code in `fetch`; identity is provided by `Sec-MS-GEC`. In OkHttp you *may* send `User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/143.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/143.0.0.0` — optional, not required by this implementation.
- `Sec-MS-GEC-Version` value is literally `1-143.0.3650.75` (prefix `1-` + CHROMIUM).
- Voice-list REST (voices.js:139-140): `https://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/voices/list?trustedclienttoken=6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4&Sec-MS-GEC=<token>&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-143.0.3650.75` — note **lowercase** `trustedclienttoken` here vs capital `TrustedClientToken` in the WS URL. Header: `Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9`. No key/auth.

## 2. WebSocket handshake
- `new WebSocket(url)` with **no sub-protocol** — comment L182: `// БЕЗ subprotocol — иначе сервер отвечает 403`. In OkHttp: do **not** call `Request.Builder().subprotocol(...)`. OkHttp's default `permessage-deflate` is not requested → nothing to disable.
- `ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer'`.
- Timeout: single JS watchdog `setTimeout(..., 65000)` → reject `new Error('Тайм-аут синтеза (проверьте интернет)')`. Kotlin: `OkHttpClient` `pingInterval` unused, set `readTimeout(65, TimeUnit.SECONDS)` (or `callTimeout(70s)`) plus your own watchdog; `ended`/`fail` guard makes the promise settle once.
- Lifecycle: `onerror` → fail `'Edge-TTS: сеть недоступна или сервер не ответил'`; on `turn.end` → concatenate, close (code 1000/normal), resolve; `ws.close()` in a try/catch on both finish and fail.

## 3. Sec-MS-GEC algorithm (exact, `util.js:15-35` + `voices.js:148`)
```kotlin
s     = msNow / 1000 + 11644473600          // seconds since 1601-01-01 UTC (double in JS, Long ok in Kotlin)
s    -= s % 300                             // floor to lower bound of 5-minute window
ticks = round(s * 1e7).toLong()             // 100-ns ticks; JS uses .toFixed(0) → 1.33e16, fits in Long
raw   = ticks.toString() + "6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4"
token = SHA-256(UTF-8(raw)) → 32 hex chars UPPERCASE (lowercase b → padStart('0'), then toUpperCase)
```
Recomputed per synthesis call; valid up to 300 s (recompute on reconnect/retry).

## 4. Message protocol (all sent as **text** WebSocket frames, right after `onopen`, in this order)

Msg 1 — speech.config (voices.js:209-211), literal template:
```
X-Timestamp:{ts}\r\nContent-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n{"context":{"synthesis":{"audio":{"metadataoptions":{"sentenceBoundaryEnabled":"false","wordBoundaryEnabled":"true"},"outputFormat":"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3"}}}}\r\n
```
(the trailing `\r\n` after the JSON **is** sent). Note lowercase `metadataoptions`.

Msg 2 — ssml (voices.js:212-214), literal template (**no** trailing `\r\n`):
```
X-RequestId:{requestId}\r\nContent-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\nX-Timestamp:{ts}\r\nPath:ssml\r\n\r\n{SSML}
```
`{ts}` = `nowEdgeString()` = `new Date().toUTCString().replace('GMT','GMT+0000')` → e.g. `Tue, 20 Sep 2026 12:00:00 GMT+0000` (RFC-1123, `en-US` day/month names, 2-digit day, always `+0000`, never `Z`). Kotlin: `DateTimeFormatter.RFC_1123_DATE_TIME.withLocale(Locale.US)` on an `Instant` at UTC then `.replace("GMT","GMT+0000")`. The two messages are formatted independently (may differ by a second) but use the identical format.

**No third message.** There is **no** `PathQueryCommand` / `Path:query` and no separate trusted-client-token message in this implementation; `TrustedClientToken` is a URL query parameter only. No keep-alive/ping text frames.

Receiving:
- text frame containing `audio.metadata`: body = substring after first `\r\n\r\n`; `JSON.parse(body).Metadata[]`; for `Type === 'WordBoundary'` push `{ offsetMs: Data.Offset/10000, durMs: Data.Duration/10000, text: Data.text.Text }` (ticks→ms, ÷10000) into `boundary` (unused by the app afterwards).
- text frame containing `Path:turn.end` (and `!ended`) → `ended = true; finish()`.
- text frame matching `/Path:response/` **and** containing `path:false` → fail `Error('Edge-TTS отклонил запрос (неверный голос)')`.
- **binary** frame: `if (len >= 2) { hl = (buf[0] << 8) | buf[1]; chunks.push(buf.subarray(2 + hl + 2)); }` — 2-byte big-endian header length, then **skip 2 more bytes** (Edge binary audio header `0x0001`). Kotlin: `hl = (b[0].toInt() and 0xFF shl 8) or (b[1].toInt() and 0xFF); payload = b.copyOfRange(2 + hl + 2, b.size)`.
- (Browser `Blob` branch: whole blob appended, no header strip — irrelevant for Kotlin/OkHttp which always delivers ByteString/ByteArray.)

## 5. SSML construction (`SSML()`, voices.js:159-171)
Locale from the voice id, not from the catalogue entry:
`voiceLocale('ru-RU-DmitryNeural')` via `/^\s*([a-z]{2,3})-([A-Za-z]{2}|[0-9]{3})\b/` → `ru-RU`; fallback `'en-US'`. (Group 1 is lowercase-only, so ids must be lowercase-prefixed.)

No style (exact):
```
<speak version='1.0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis' xml:lang='ru-RU'><voice name='ru-RU-DmitryNeural'><prosody pitch='+0Hz' rate='+0%' volume='+0%'>ESCAPED</prosody></voice></speak>
```
With style (exact; note extra `xmlns:mstts`, hardcoded `styledegree='1'`, prosody nested *inside* express-as):
```
<speak version='1.0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis' xmlns:mstts='http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts' xml:lang='ru-RU'><voice name='ru-RU-DmitryNeural'><mstts:express-as style='cheerful' styledegree='1'><prosody pitch='+0Hz' rate='+0%' volume='+0%'>ESCAPED</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
```
- Single-quoted attributes; order `pitch, rate, volume`; defaults `pitch='+0Hz'`, `rate='+0%'`, `volume='+0%'`, `style` absent.
- `TTS_STYLES` (app.js:32) = `['', 'cheerful', 'excited', 'angry', 'sad', 'whisper', 'shouting', 'terrified', 'unfriendly', 'gentle']`.
- Escaping `ssmlEscape` (util.js:53-68): code points `0x00-0x08`, `0x0B-0x0C`, `0x0E-0x1F` → `' '` (note: `0x09`, `0x0A`, `0x0D`, `0x7F+` untouched); then in order `&`→`&`, `<`→`<`, `>`→`>`, `"`→`"`, `'`→`'`.
- **No GEC-digit normalization exists.** "GEC" in this repo = *Microsoft Edge Client* token only (§3). There is no greatest-common-divisor / number-word / digit expansion, no rate/pitch clamping inside `voices.js`, and no text chunking — the escaped text goes in verbatim. Strings are passed verbatim to prosody.

## 6. Audio format & decode path
- Requested: `"outputFormat":"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3"` → **24000 Hz, 48000 bit/s, 1 channel, MP3/MPEG**. Blob is created as `new Blob([mp3], { type: 'audio/mpeg' })`.
- Before the Blob, `cleanMp3Frames(combined)` (util.js:264-309) walks MPEG frames and drops inter-frame garbage: sync `(b0&0xFF)==0xFF && (b1&0xE0)==0xE0`; header `ver=(h>>19)&3` (3=V1, 2=V2, 0=V2.5), `layer=(h>>17)&3` (must be `1` = Layer III), `brI!==0 && brI!==0xF`, `srI!==3`; tables `MP3_BR_V1=[0,32,40,48,56,64,80,96,112,128,160,192,224,256,320]`, `MP3_BR_V2=[0,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64,80,96,112,128,144,160]`, `MP3_SR_V1=[44100,48000,32000]`, `MP3_SR_V2s=[22050,24000,16000]`, `MP3_SR_V25=[11025,12000,8000]`; frame length `floor((ver==3?144:72) * br * 1000 / sr) + pad`, loop while `i < n-4`.
- Decoding: **native `AudioContext.decodeAudioData()`** (browser/OS MP3 decoder). No JS MP3 decoder, **no `OfflineAudioContext`** anywhere in the repo. WebAudio resamples to the context rate.
- Trim: `TRIM = { threshold: 0.012, margin: 0.05, minDur: 0.25 }` (engine.js:24); `trimSilence(samples, sr, {threshold, margin, winMs=10})`: window = `floor(sr*0.01)`, pad = `floor(sr*0.05)` samples, peak-based, returns `{start,end}` indices.
- `measureTrimmedDuration`: `dur = end>start ? (end-start)/sr : buf.duration`; return `max(0.25, dur)` if `dur > 0.05` else `null`; on decode error → `null` (falls back to `HTMLAudioElement.duration`).
- Mixing: `BufferSource → GainNode(gain=roleGain(role)) → master`; `src.start(started + it.t, offset, min(dur, it.dur + 0.1))`.
- Resample: linear (`resampleLinear`, engine.js:118) used **only** in `renderAudioTrack` to `sr = 44100` (L528, L545). WAV export: 16-bit mono 44100 (`encodeWav`, header literals `RIFF`/`WAVE`/`fmt `/`data`); final MP3 via ffmpeg `-codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 4`. WebM path uses the AudioContext's own rate (MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode), no manual resample.
- Android mapping: `MediaExtractor`+`MediaCodec` (`audio/mpeg`) or Media3 → PCM; concat only the stripped payloads or feed the frame-walked buffer; keep 24 kHz for preview or resample 24000→44100 for the mix, gain from `roleGain`.

## 7. Voice catalogue
- Hardcoded curated list `EDGE_VOICES` — **110 entries**, built by `const V = (id, gender='m') => ({ id, lang: id.slice(0,5), gender })`; entry shape is only `{ id, lang, gender }` with `gender ∈ {'m','f'}`, `lang` = first 5 chars of the id.
- Optional server merge `fetchVoicesFromMicrosoft()` → `registerFetchedVoices(list)`: keeps entries with `ShortName` matching `/Neural$/`; maps to `{ id: ShortName, lang: normLocale(Locale || ShortName.slice(0,5), 'en-US'), gender: (Gender||'').toLowerCase().startsWith('f') ? 'f' : 'm' }`. **Only `ShortName`, `Locale`, `Gender` are read** — `VoiceTag`, `FriendlyName`, `SuggestedCodec`, `Status` etc. are ignored.
- `normLocale(loc, fallback)`: `_`→`-`; `lang=parts[0].toLowerCase()`; `region` = first part matching `/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/` or `/^[0-9]{3}$/`; result `lang + '-' + region.toUpperCase()` else `lang`; empty → fallback (`'en-US'`). Examples: `zh-Hans-CN`→`zh-CN`, `ca-ES-valencia`→`ca-ES`, `es-419`→`es-419`.
- `allVoices()` = hardcoded first, then extras not already present. `voicesForLang(prefix)` = case-insensitive `startsWith` on `lang`. `voiceById(id)` = exact match.
- UI filter: `LANG_LOCALE = {rus:'ru', eng:'en-US', chi_sim:'zh-CN', jpn:'ja-JP', kor:'ko-KR', spa:'es-ES', fra:'fr-FR', deu:'de-DE', por:'pt-BR'}`; pool = `voicesForLang(prefix)` else `allVoices()`; an unknown current voice is `unshift`ed into the pool. `defaultVoice()` = `(pool[0] || allVoices()[0]).id`. New roles use `pool[0]`, `pool[1]`, `pool[2]` (modulo total count).
- Full hardcoded list, `lang: Name(g)`:
```
ru-RU: Dmitry(m) Svetlana(f) Dariya(f) Pavel(m)          en-US: Christopher(m) Jenny(f) Guy(m) Aria(f) EmmaMultilingual(f)
Andrew(m) Brian(m) Amy(f) Michelle(f) Roger(m) Steffan(m) Ana(f)
en-GB: Sonia(f) Ryan(m) Thomas(m) Libby(f)             en-AU: Natasha(f) William(m)   en-CA: Clara(f) Liam(m)
en-IN: Neerja(f) Prabhat(m)                          en-IE: Emily(f) Connor(m)      en-NZ: Molly(f) Mitchell(m)

it-IT: Elsa(f) Isabella(f) Diego(m)                 pt-BR: Francisca(f) Antonio(m)  pt-PT: Raquel(f) Duarte(m)

sv-SE: Sofie(f) Mattias(m)                          nb-NO: Pernille(f) Finn(m)     da-DK: Christel(f) Jeppe(m)
fi-FI: Selma(f) Harri(m)                            cs-CZ: Vlasta(f) Antonin(m)    el-GR: Athina(f) Nestoras(m)
hu-HU: Noemi(f) Tamas(m)                            ro-RO: Alina(f) Emil(m)       vi-VN: HoaiMy(f) NamMinh(m)
```

(exact id is `ar-SA-ZariyahNeural`; the odd "Sariyah" above is a typo marker — the literal is `V('ar-SA-ZariyahNeural', 'f')`.)

## 8. speechSynthesis fallback
`settings.voiceBackend` default `'edge'`; `synthesizeLine()` (voices.js:262-269) dispatches: `'edge-proxy'` → `edgeTTSProxy`; `'browser'` → `{ browser: true, play: () => browserSpeak(text, opts.voice) }`; anything else → `edgeTTSSynth`.
- `browserSpeak(text, voiceName, {rate=1,pitch=1,volume=1})`: `new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text)`; `u.voice = speechSynthesis.getVoices().find(v => v.name === voiceName)` (Edge `ShortName`s never match, so `voice` stays unset); `u.lang = voiceName ? voiceName.slice(0,5) : 'ru-RU'`; resolves on `onend` **or** `onerror` (never rejects). Always called with only 2 args ⇒ rate/pitch/volume = 1.
- `ttsAll()` refuses when `voiceBackend === 'browser'`: toast `'Браузерные голоса нельзя записать в видео — включите Edge-TTS'`. `bubblePlay()` handles `res.browser` via `res.play?.()`.
- Proxy mode: `edgeTTSProxy` → GET `{proxy}?text=…&voice=<id or 'ru-RU-DmitryNeural'>&rate&pitch&volume` (rate/pitch/volume appended only when truthy, `&` vs `?` chosen by `proxy.includes('?')`), content-type from response or `'audio/mpeg'`; on any throw/failure → POST JSON `{text, voice, pitch, rate, volume}` with `Content-Type: application/json`; `boundary` is always `[]`.

## 9. Clamping, defaults, data model
- No clamping in `voices.js`; values flow verbatim into `prosody`. Sliders (app.js:931-933) are the clamp: pitch `min=-40 max=40 step=1 Hz`; rate `min=-50 max=100 step=5 %`; volume `min=10 max=200 step=5 %, default 100`.
- String formats: `pitch = (+v>0 ? '+' : '') + v + 'Hz'` → `0Hz`, `+12Hz`, `-7Hz` (note: **no `+` for zero**, despite the stored default being `'+0Hz'`); `rate = (+v>0?'+':'')+v+'%'` → `0%`, `+15%`; `volume = (+v-100>0?'+':'')+(v-100)+'%'` → `0%` at 100, `+50%` at 150, `-50%` at 50.
- Role defaults: `{ id, name, emoji, color, voice, pitch:'+0Hz', rate:'+0%', volume:'+0%', style:'', type:'edge'|'clip', clipId:'', gender:'male'|'female'|'other', manualVoice:false, pitchNum, rateNum, volumeNum, takeMode }`. Call-site fallbacks: `voice || defaultVoice()`, `pitch || '+0Hz'`, `rate || '+0%'`, `volume || '+0%'`, `style || ''`. Bubble audio: `b.audio = { blob, duration, noTrim? }`; auto-cast via `cast.js planCasts(characters, castVoices(), {langPrefix, manual, narratorRoleId})` using only `{id, lang, gender}`.
- Runtime loudness is **separate** from the SSML `volume`: `roleGain(role)` uses `volumeNum` (100 = unity) else parses `role.volume` with `/^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%\s*$/` → `pct = 100 + value`, then `clamp(pct/100, 0, 2)`. Timeline: page lead-in `+0.55 s`, per-line `+0.25 s` (first) or `gap` (default 350 ms) before, `gap*0.6` after, page tail `+0.5 s`, final `+0.9 s`; unvoiced line estimate `max(1.1, min(14, len/13 + 0.55)) + (has space ? 0.15 : 0)`.

## 10. Kotlin pitfalls
1. Do not send `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` (403). 2. Strip binary frames as `2 + headerLen + 2`. 3. Uppercase hex GEC, `1-143.0.3650.75`. 4. `X-Timestamp` = RFC-1123 with `GMT+0000`, no `Z`. 5. `metadataoptions` lowercase, exact JSON key order/содержимое. 6. `xml:lang` from the voice-id regex (fallback `en-US`) — the app's whole point (L167-168 comment: hardcoded `en-US` broke RU/JA prosody). 7. Only 2 client messages; no query/trusted-token message. 8. `X-RequestId` must equal the `ConnectionId` query value (32 hex, no dashes).
