parts.text:
Read /home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code/js/engine.js fully (672 lines), plus /home/runner/hub-work/comic2film/code/js/util.js (399 lines), and grep app.js for how engine.js is invoked.

I am porting this app to a NATIVE Android Kotlin app (no WebView, no canvas, no ffmpeg.wasm). I need a precise, implementation-ready spec of the video timeline + rendering + export pipeline so I can reimplement it with MediaCodec/MediaMuxer and Android Canvas/Bitmap.

Report with EXACT numbers/formulas/field names:
1. Data model of the timeline: the shape of clips/segments/characters/replies as used by the engine (all field names), how a page becomes a clip, how audio duration determines clip length, gap/pause between clips, transitions if any, and total duration computation (exact formula).
2. Ken Burns effect: the exact formula for zoom/pan over time (from/to zoom, focus point, easing function name and implementation), which direction presets exist, and defaults.
3. Frame rendering: resolution options and defaults, fps options and defaults, background color, how a page bitmap is drawn/scaled/cropped (aspect handling, letterbox vs cover), and how subtitles/speech bubbles are drawn (font sizes, padding, background color/alpha, position, wrapping, stroke).
4. Preview playback: how playback position/time is tracked, how audio clips are scheduled and played (WebAudio), volume, and any progress reporting.
5. Export: the MediaRecorder configuration (mimeType, bitsPerSecond, audio constraints), how the WebM is produced, and the ffmpeg.wasm commands for MP4/GIF/audio export (exact ffmpeg args), plus how the output file is saved/downloaded.
6. Audio export: WAV/MP3 export details, the MP3 frame walker in util.js (how duration/bitrate/frames are parsed — exact algorithm), and GEC (whatever normalization util.js does) — describe precisely.
7. Silence-based audio splitting (used for "нарезки голосов"): exact algorithm, thresholds, min/max durations, padding values.
8. Bubble clustering / grouping algorithm in util.js: exact algorithm and parameters.
9. Any known workarounds/hacks with comments in the code (grep for comments mentioning "fixed", "bug", "работает", "костыль") — list them, they encode hard-won knowledge.

Output as a dense technical spec, max 250 lines, formulas and constants verbatim, no code rewrites of unrelated code. This is research only — do NOT modify any files.
I'll start by reading the two core files and locating app.js entry points.

22:  * измерения длительности озвучки (иначе таймлайн считает по полному блобу,
23:  * а звучит обрезанный кусок, и реплики расходятся с картинкой). */
24: export const TRIM = { threshold: 0.012, margin: 0.05, minDur: 0.25 };

26: export function estimateSpeakDur(text) {
27:   const t = String(text || '');
28:   if (!t.trim()) return 0;
29:   return Math.max(1.1, Math.min(14, t.length / 13 + 0.55)) + (/\s/.test(t) ? 0.15 : 0);

33:  * тишиной. Возвращает null, если декодировать не удалось. */

35:   try {
36:     const buf = await actx.decodeAudioData(await blob.arrayBuffer());
37:     const ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
38:     const { start, end } = trimSilence(ch, buf.sampleRate, TRIM);
39:     const dur = end > start ? (end - start) / buf.sampleRate : buf.duration;
40:     return dur > 0.05 ? Math.max(TRIM.minDur, dur) : null;
41:   } catch (e) {

43:   }

47:  * а строка вида '+0%' теряла знак и превращалась в 0.9. Приоритет у числа,

63:  * Таймлайн
64:  * ================================================================ */
65: export function buildTimeline(project) {
66:   const s = project.settings || {};
67:   const gap = (s.gap != null ? s.gap : 350) / 1000;
68:   const items = [];
69:   let t = 0;
70:   project.pages.forEach((page, pi) => {

72:     if (!bubbles.length) {

74:       t += 1.8;

86:     });

88:   });

93: /* ================================================================
94:  * Аудио: декод + обрезка тишины, схема воспроизведения
95:  * ================================================================ */
96: async function decodeToBuffer(actx, blob) {
97:   const arr = await blob.arrayBuffer();
98:   const buf = await actx.decodeAudioData(arr.slice(0));
99:   return buf;
100: }

127:     const i1 = Math.min(src.length - 1, i0 + 1);
128:     const frac = pos - i0;

135:  * Видео

142:   if (!_imgLoading.has(url)) {
143:     _imgLoading.set(url, loadImage(url)
144:       .then(img => { _imgCache.set(url, img); return img; })
145:       .catch(() => null));
146:   }
147:   return _imgLoading.get(url);
148: }
149: function pageImgSync(url) { return _imgCache.get(url) || null; }

151: const smooth = (a) => a * a * (3 - 2 * a); // smoothstep
152: 
153: function bubbleHasBox(b, page) {
154:   if (!b) return false;
155:   if (page && page.bubblesHaveBoxes === false) return false;
156:   return b.x != null && b.y != null && b.w > 0 && b.h > 0;
157: }
158: 
159: function cameraFor(item, clock, P, C, zoomMode) {
160:   const pw = P.w || 1, ph = P.h || 1;
161:   const W = C.w, H = C.h;
162:   const cover = Math.max(W / pw, H / ph);
163:   const cx = pw / 2, cy = ph / 2;
164:   const clampV = (v, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
165: 
166:   if (bubbleHasBox(item.bubble, item.page) && zoomMode !== 'none') {
167:     const b = item.bubble;
168:     const bC2x = b.x + b.w / 2, bC2y = b.y + b.h / 2;
169:     if (zoomMode === 'pan') {
170:       // панорама к реплике с зумом 1.15
171:       const crop = cover * 1.15;
172:       const vw = W / crop, vh = H / crop;
173:       const sx2 = clampV(bC2x - vw / 2, 0, Math.max(0, pw - vw));
174:       const sy2 = clampV(bC2y - vh / 2, 0, Math.max(0, ph - vh));
175:       return { sx: sx2, sy: sy2, sw: vw, sh: vh, zoom: crop };
176:     }
177:     const prog = item.dur > 0 ? smooth(Math.min(1, (clock - item.t) / item.dur)) : 0;
178:     const zoomFrom = cover * 1.2, zoomTo = cover * Math.max(1, Math.min(2.6, Math.max(W / (b.w * 1.3 + 1), H / (b.h * 1.3 + 1))));
179:     const crop = zoomFrom + (zoomTo - zoomFrom) * prog;
180:     const vw = W / crop, vh = H / crop;
181:     const sx = clampV(bC2x - vw / 2, 0, Math.max(0, pw - vw));
182:     const sy = clampV(bC2y - vh / 2, 0, Math.max(0, ph - vh));
183:     return { sx, sy, sw: vw, sh: vh, zoom: crop };
184:   }
185: 
186:   // idle / статично: панорама по странице
187:   const z = zoomMode === 'none' ? cover : cover * 1.12;
188:   const vw = W / z, vh = H / z;
189:   let sx = cx - vw / 2, sy = cy - vh / 2;
190:   if (zoomMode === 'pan' || zoomMode === 'smart') {
191:     // движение сверху вниз / слева направо по фазе
192:     const phase = item.t === undefined ? 0.5 : smooth(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (clock - item.t) / (item.dur || 1))));
193:     if (ph > pw * 1.2 || ph > 1.2 * pw) { const r = Math.max(0, ph - vh); sy = clampV(((phase - 0.5) * 2) * r * 0.6 + cy - vh / 2, 0, r); }
194:     else { const r = Math.max(0, pw - vw); sx = clampV((phase - 0.5) * 2 * r * 0.8 + cx - vw / 2, 0, r); }
195:   }
196:   sx = clampV(sx, 0, Math.max(0, pw - vw));
197:   sy = clampV(sy, 0, Math.max(0, ph - vh));
198:   return { sx, sy, sw: vw, sh: vh, zoom: z };
199: }

201: function wrapLines(ctx, text, maxW) {
202:   const words = String(text).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
203:   if (!words.length) return [''];
204:   const lines = []; let cur = '';
205:   for (const w of words) {
206:     const test = cur ? cur + ' ' + w : w;
207:     if (ctx.measureText(test).width > maxW && cur) { lines.push(cur); cur = w; }
208:     else cur = test;
209:   }
210:   if (cur) lines.push(cur);
211:   return lines;
212: }

214: function drawCaption(ctx, item, cam, C, project, settings) {
215:   // субтитры снизу. Реплика без координат (vision-OCR не отдаёт bbox)
216:   // всегда рисуется нижней подписью: выдумывать прямоугольник нельзя.
217:   const mode = bubbleHasBox(item.bubble, item.page) ? (settings.caption || 'bubble') : (settings.caption === 'none' ? 'none' : 'sub');
218:   const biling = settings.biling || 'orig';
219:   const role = item.bubble && project.roles.find(r => r.id === item.bubble.roleId);
220:   const mainText = item.bubble ? item.bubble.text : '';
221:   const trText = item.bubble ? item.bubble.tr : '';
222: 
223:   if (mode === 'none') return;
224: 
225:   if (mode === 'bubble' && bubbleHasBox(item.bubble, item.page)) {
226:     // прямоугольник пузыря в координатах страницы → экран
227:     const px = item.bubble.x, py = item.bubble.y, pww = item.bubble.w, phh = item.bubble.h;
228:     const sxx = (px - cam.sx) * (C.w / cam.sw);
229:     const syy = (py - cam.sy) * (C.h / cam.sh);
230:     const ww = pww * (C.w / cam.sw);
231:     const hh = phh * (C.h / cam.sh);
232:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
233:     ctx.strokeStyle = role ? role.color : '#555';
234:     ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, Math.min(6, C.w / 300));
235:     roundRect(ctx, sxx, syy, ww, hh, 10);
236:     ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
237:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
238:     ctx.font = `600 ${Math.max(13, ww / 14)}px system-ui`;
239:     ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
240:     const pad = Math.max(4, ww * 0.04);
241:     const lines = wrapLines(ctx, mainText, ww - pad * 2);
242:     const maxLines = Math.floor((hh - pad * 2) / (ctx.measureText('М').width * 1.4));
243:     const shown = lines.slice(0, Math.max(1, maxLines)).join(' ');
244:     ctx.fillText(shown, sxx + pad, syy + pad, ww - pad * 2);
245:     if (role) {
246:       ctx.font = `700 ${Math.max(11, C.w / 130)}px system-ui`;
247:       ctx.fillStyle = role.color;
248:       ctx.fillText((role.emoji || '') + ' ' + role.name, sxx + pad, Math.max(2, syy - ctx.measureText('М').width * 1.3));
249:     }
250:     return;
251:   }
252: 
253:   // субтитры снизу. biling: 'orig' — только оригинал, 'origtr' — оригинал
254:   // + перевод, 'tr' — перевод (с оригиналом, если перевода нет).
255:   const show = biling === 'tr' ? (trText || mainText) : mainText;
256:   let second = '';
257:   if (biling === 'tr') second = trText ? mainText : '';
258:   else if (biling !== 'orig') second = trText;
259:   const lineH = Math.max(26, C.h * 0.055);
260:   const bandH = lineH * (second ? 2.1 : 1.25) + 26;
261:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
262:   ctx.fillRect(0, C.h - bandH, C.w, bandH);
263:   ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
264:   const fs = Math.max(18, C.h * 0.042);
265:   ctx.font = `700 ${fs}px system-ui`;
266:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
267:   if (role) {
268:     ctx.fillStyle = role.color;
269:     ctx.fillText((role.emoji || '') + ' ' + role.name, C.w / 2, C.h - bandH + 14);
270:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
271:   }
272:   ctx.fillText(show, C.w / 2, C.h - (second ? bandH * 0.62 : bandH * 0.55), C.w * 0.92);
273:   if (second) {
274:     ctx.font = `500 ${fs * 0.72}px system-ui`;
275:     ctx.fillStyle = '#cfd8e8';
276:     ctx.fillText(second, C.w / 2, C.h - lineH, C.w * 0.92);
277:   }
278: }
279: 
280: function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
281:   r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
282:   ctx.beginPath();
283:   ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
284:   ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
285:   ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
286:   ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
287:   ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
288:   ctx.closePath();
289: }

291: /* ================================================================
292:  * Общая подготовка сессии: декод всех буферов, планирование, микс.
293:  * ================================================================ */
294: async function prepareSession(project, actx, onProgress) {
295:   const { items: timeline, total } = buildTimeline(project);
296:   const settings = project.settings || {};
297: 
298:   // декод всех буферов реплик
299:   const buffers = new Map();
300:   const audibles = timeline.filter(i => i.bubble && i.bubble.audio && i.bubble.audio.blob);
301:   for (let i = 0; i < audibles.length; i++) {
302:     const it = audibles[i];
303:     // клипы, нарезанные пользователем, уже без тишины (noTrim) — не режем их
304:     // ещё раз, иначе длительность в таймлайне (seg.duration) разойдётся со звуком
305:     const noTrim = it.bubble.audio.noTrim === true;
306:     try { buffers.set(it.bubble.id, await makePartBuffer(actx, it.bubble.audio.blob, !noTrim)); }
307:     catch (e) { buffers.set(it.bubble.id, null); }
308:     onProgress && onProgress((i / Math.max(1, audibles.length)) * 0.25, 'декодирование аудио');
309:   }
310: 
311:   const master = actx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 1;
312:   const dest = actx.createMediaStreamDestination();
313:   master.connect(dest);
314:   const started = actx.currentTime + 0.8;
315:   const scheduled = new Set();
316: 
317:   function scheduleItem(it) {
318:     if (!it.bubble || scheduled.has(it.bubble.id)) return;
319:     scheduled.add(it.bubble.id);
320:     const pb = buffers.get(it.bubble.id);
321:     if (!pb) return;
322:     const role = project.roles.find(r => r.id === it.bubble.roleId);
323:     const g = actx.createGain();
324:     g.gain.value = roleGain(role);
325:     const src = actx.createBufferSource();
326:     src.buffer = pb.buffer;
327:     src.connect(g); g.connect(master);
328:     src.start(started + it.t, pb.offset, Math.min(pb.dur, it.dur + 0.1));
329:   }
330: 
331:   // музыкальный фон
332:   return { timeline, total, buffers, master, dest, started, actx, scheduleItem, settings };
333: }

335: /* Проигрывание в canvas (предпросмотр). abortToken: Promise, резолв = стоп. */
336: async function previewSession(project, canvas, opts, onProgress, abortToken) {
337:   const { w, h } = opts;
338:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
339:   const actx = opts.actx || new AudioContext();
340:   if (actx.state === 'suspended') await actx.resume();
341:   const settings = project.settings || {};
342: 
343:   const { timeline, total, scheduleItem, master, started } = await prepareSession(
344:     project, actx,
345:     (p, m) => onProgress && onProgress(p * 0.5, m)
346:   );
347:   const musicSrc = await startMusic(actx, settings, master);
348: 
349:   let stopped = false, raf = 0;
350:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
351:     if (abortToken) abortToken.then(() => { stopped = true; if (!raf) resolve({ stopped: true }); });
352: 
353:     // прогреев страниц
354:     for (const p of project.pages) pageImg(p.url);
355: 
356:     const onFrame = () => {
357:       const clock = actx.currentTime - started;
358:       scheduleAhead(timeline, clock, scheduleItem);
359:       const item = currentItem(timeline, clock);
360:       const page = item.page;
361:       const cam = cameraFor(item, clock, { w: page.w || 1, h: page.h || 1 }, { w, h }, settings.zoom || 'smart');
362:       const img = pageImgSync(page.url);
363:       if (img && img.complete) {
364:         ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
365:         ctx.drawImage(img, cam.sx, cam.sy, cam.sw, cam.sh, 0, 0, w, h);
366:       } else {
367:         ctx.fillStyle = '#111'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
368:       }
369:       drawCaption(ctx, item, cam, { w, h }, project, settings);
370:       const pct = Math.min(1, clock / total);
371:       onProgress && onProgress(0.5 + pct * 0.5, `предпросмотр: ${fmtDur(clock)} / ${fmtDur(total)}`);
372:       if (!stopped && clock < total) raf = requestAnimationFrame(onFrame);
373:       else finish();
374:     };
375:     const finish = () => {
376:       if (stopped) { resolve({ stopped: true }); return; }
377:       stopped = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
378:       try { if (musicSrc) musicSrc.stop(); } catch (e) {}
379:       resolve({ stopped: false });
380:     };
381:     onProgress && onProgress(0.02, 'старт');
382:     try { musicSrc && musicSrc.start(started); } catch (e) {}
383:     raf = requestAnimationFrame(onFrame);
384:   });
385: }
386: 
387: function scheduleAhead(timeline, clock, scheduleItem) {
388:   for (const it of timeline) if (it.bubble && it.t <= clock + 0.4) scheduleItem(it);
389: }
390: 
391: function currentItem(timeline, clock) {
392:   let item = timeline[0];
393:   for (const it of timeline) { if (it.t <= clock) item = it; else break; }
394:   return item;
395: }
396: 
397: async function startMusic(actx, settings, master) {
398:   if (!settings.musicBlob) return null;
399:   try {
400:     const buf = await decodeToBuffer(actx, settings.musicBlob);
401:     const s = actx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = buf; s.loop = true;
402:     const g = actx.createGain(); g.gain.value = ((settings.mvol ?? 15) / 100) * 0.6;
403:     s.connect(g); g.connect(master);
404:     return s;
405:   } catch (e) { return null; }
406: }

408: function pickMime() {
409:   const tries = [
410:     'video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus', 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus',
411:     'video/webm;codecs=vp9', 'video/webm',
412:   ];
413:   for (const t of tries) { try { if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(t)) return t; } catch (e) {} }
414:   return 'video/webm';
415: }

417: export async function resolveCanvas(resSpec, project) {
418:   if (resSpec === 'auto') {
419:     const p = project.pages[0];
420:     const ratio = p && p.w ? p.h / p.w : 16 / 9;
421:     const h = 1080, w = Math.round(h / ratio);
422:     return { w: w - (w % 2), h };
423:   }
424:   const [w, h] = resSpec.split('x').map(n => parseInt(n, 10));
425:   return { w, h };
426: }

428: /* Предпросмотр: воспроизведение в canvas без записи.
429:  * abortToken — Promise, при резолве проигрывание останавливается.
430:  * Возвращает { stop(), done }.
431:  */
432: export function previewStart(project, canvas, opts, onProgress, abortToken) {
433:   const { w, h } = opts;
434:   canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
435:   const actx = new AudioContext();
436:   const run = previewSession(project, canvas, { w, h, actx }, onProgress, abortToken);
437:   return {
438:     stop: () => { actx.close().catch(() => {}); },
439:     done: run,
440:   };
441: }

443: /* ================================================================
444:  * Полная запись видео (WebM): единый AudioContext + canvas + dest.
445:  * Возвращает { blob, ext, mimeType, duration }.
446:  * ================================================================ */
447: export async function renderAndRecord(project, opts, onProgress) {
448:   const { w, h } = await resolveCanvas(opts.res, project);
449:   const fps = opts.fps || 30;
450:   const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
451:   canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
452:   const settings = project.settings || {};
453: 
454:   const actx = new AudioContext();
455:   // Без resume() suspended-контекст не двигает currentTime, clock не растёт,
456:   // цикл кадров не останавливается и MediaRecorder никогда не завершается.
457:   if (actx.state === 'suspended') { try { await actx.resume(); } catch (e) {} }
458:   if (actx.state === 'suspended') {
459:     try { await actx.close(); } catch (e) {}
460:     throw new Error('Браузер не дал запустить AudioContext (нужен жест пользователя — нажмите кнопку ещё раз)');
461:   }
462:   const { timeline, total, master, dest, started, scheduleItem } = await prepareSession(project, actx, onProgress);
463:   const musicSrc = await startMusic(actx, settings, master);
464: 
465:   const vstream = canvas.captureStream(fps);
466:   if (dest.stream.getAudioTracks().length) vstream.addTrack(dest.stream.getAudioTracks()[0]);
467:   const mimeType = pickMime();
468:   const rec = new MediaRecorder(vstream, { mimeType, videoBitsPerSecond: Math.min(16e6, w * h * fps * 0.14) });
469:   const chunks = [];
470:   rec.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.size) chunks.push(e.data); };
471: 
472:   return new Promise((resolve) => {
473:     const doneP = new Promise((res) => rec.onstop = res);
474:     // Страховка: если что-то пойдёт не так (подвисший currentTime, потерянный
475:     // элемент таймлайна), рекордер всё равно остановится и промис завершится.
476:     const guard = setTimeout(() => { try { rec.stop(); } catch (e) {} }, (total + 20) * 1000);
477:     const startAll = () => {
478:       // предзагрузка страниц
479:       for (const p of project.pages) pageImg(p.url);
480:       rec.start(1000);
481:       const cctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
482:       let raf = 0;
483:       onProgress && onProgress(0.03, 'старт записи');
484:       try { musicSrc && musicSrc.start(started); } catch (e) {}
485: 
486:       const onFrame = () => {
487:         const clock = actx.currentTime - started;
488:         scheduleAhead(timeline, clock, scheduleItem);
489:         const item = currentItem(timeline, clock);
490:         // currentItem возвращает undefined только на пустом таймлайне; раньше
491:         // тут был return без остановки rec — запись висела вечно
492:         if (!item) { try { rec.stop(); } catch (e) {} return; }
493:         const page = item.page;
494:         const cam = cameraFor(item, clock, { w: page.w || 1, h: page.h || 1 }, { w, h }, settings.zoom || 'smart');
495:         const img = pageImgSync(page.url);
496:         if (img && img.complete) {
497:           cctx.fillStyle = '#000'; cctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
498:           cctx.drawImage(img, cam.sx, cam.sy, cam.sw, cam.sh, 0, 0, w, h);
499:         } else {
500:           cctx.fillStyle = '#111'; cctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
501:         }
502:         drawCaption(cctx, item, cam, { w, h }, project, settings);
503:         const pct = Math.min(1, clock / total);
504:         onProgress && onProgress(0.1 + pct * 0.85, `запись: ${fmtDur(clock)} / ${fmtDur(total)} • ${w}×${h}`);
505:         if (clock < total) raf = requestAnimationFrame(onFrame);
506:         else setTimeout(() => { try { rec.stop(); } catch (e) {} }, 120);
507:       };
508: 
509:       raf = requestAnimationFrame(onFrame);
510:       doneP.then(() => {
511:         clearTimeout(guard);
512:         cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
513:         try { musicSrc && musicSrc.stop(); } catch (e) {}
514:         const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: mimeType });
515:         const ext = mimeType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';
516:         resolve({ blob, ext, mimeType, duration: total });
517:       });
518:     };
519:     setTimeout(() => { try { startAll(); } catch (e) { resolve({ error: e }); } }, 50);
520:   });
521: }

523: /* ================================================================
524:  * Только аудио-дорожка (WAV) + MP3 через ffmpeg
525:  * ================================================================ */
526: export async function renderAudioTrack(project, onProgress) {
527:   const actx = new AudioContext();
528:   const sr = 44100;
529:   const settings = project.settings || {};
530:   const { items, total } = buildTimeline(project);
531:   const buffers = new Map();
532:   for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
533:     const it = items[i];
534:     if (it.bubble && it.bubble.audio && it.bubble.audio.blob) {
535:       const noTrim = it.bubble.audio.noTrim === true;
536:       try { buffers.set(it.bubble.id, await makePartBuffer(actx, it.bubble.audio.blob, !noTrim)); }
537:       catch (e) { buffers.set(it.bubble.id, null); }
538:     }
539:     onProgress && onProgress((i / Math.max(1, items.length)) * 0.5, 'декод аудио');
540:   }
541:   const frameCount = Math.ceil(total * sr);
542:   const out = new Float32Array(frameCount);
543:   const mixAdd = (buf, offsetSec, vol) => {
544:     let ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
545:     if (buf.sampleRate !== sr) ch = resampleLinear(ch, buf.sampleRate, sr);
546:     const i0 = Math.floor(offsetSec * sr);
547:     if (i0 >= frameCount) return;
548:     const n = Math.min(ch.length, frameCount - i0);
549:     for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) out[i0 + k] += ch[k] * vol;
550:   };
551:   for (const it of items) {
552:     const pb = buffers.get(it.bubble ? it.bubble.id : '');
553:     if (!pb) continue;
554:     const role = it.bubble && project.roles.find(r => r.id === it.bubble.roleId);
555:     mixAdd(pb.buffer, it.t + pb.offset, roleGain(role));
556:   }
557:   if (settings.musicBlob) {
558:     try {
559:       const m = await decodeToBuffer(actx, settings.musicBlob);
560:       const g = (settings.mvol ?? 15) / 100 * 0.6;
561:       // зациклить по длительности; при duration <= 0 шаг обязан быть > 0,
562:       // иначе pos не растёт и цикл не заканчивается никогда
563:       const step = m.duration > 0 ? m.duration : (total > 0 ? total : 1);
564:       let pos = 0, guard = 0;
565:       while (pos < total && guard++ < 10000) { mixAdd(m, pos, g); pos += step; }
566:     } catch (e) {}
567:   }
568: 
569:   // WAV 16bit mono
570:   const pcm = new Int16Array(out.length);
571:   for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) { const v = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, out[i])); pcm[i] = v < 0 ? v * 0x8000 : v * 0x7fff; }
572:   const wav = encodeWav(pcm, sr);

I have everything. Now write the dense spec, max 250 lines. Must include exact numbers/formulas/field names.

Let me structure it per the 9 questions. Be precise and dense.

Key things to note for the Android port:
- Frame timing is rAF-driven, not fixed fps → for MediaCodec use fixed k/fps PTS.
- Canvas cover-crop drawing: drawImage(img, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, W, H) — src rect crop → dest full frame = "cover" (crop, no letterbox), background fill #000 first (or #111 if image not loaded).
- Text: uses measureText('М') — Kotlin equivalent needs a specific Cyrillic М glyph width in the same font (system-ui 600/700) — can't match exactly; but must replicate formulas.

Let me carefully write out the roundRect radius = min(10, w/2, h/2).

Also the bubble-mode label position: `Math.max(2, syy - ctx.measureText('М').width * 1.3)`.

Also `ctx.fillText(shown, sxx+pad, syy+pad, ww - pad*2)` — the 4th arg maxWidth squeezes text horizontally (must replicate with Paint.measureText scaling? Android has no maxWidth; use `paint.setTextScaleX`? Or just note it).

Let me now write out the spec. Aim for ~230 lines.

Also worth including: `project.settings` must be set before buildTimeline (app.js does `project.settings = settings` in doPreview/doRender/doAudioOnly; smoke test [439] asserts it).

Total duration exact formula:
```
gap = (settings.gap ?? 350)/1000
t = 0
for each page:
  if bubbles empty: item(t, dur=1.8, kind='idle'); t += 1.8
  else:
    t += 0.55
    for bi, b in bubbles:
      t += (bi === 0 ? 0.25 : gap)
      dur = b.audio?.duration || estimateSpeakDur(b.text)
      item(t, dur, 'line'); t += dur; t += gap*0.6
    t += 0.5
total = t + 0.9
```

estimateSpeakDur: if !t.trim() → 0; else max(1.1, min(14, len/13 + 0.55)) + (/\s/.test(t) ? 0.15 : 0).

roleGain: volumeNum (100 = unity) preferred; else parse role.volume string '±N%' → pct = 100 + N; clamp [0, 2].

Camera: cover = max(W/pw, H/ph).

Zoom modes: 'smart' (default), 'zoom', 'pan', 'none'.

For 'smart' with box: zoomFrom = cover*1.2, zoomTo = cover * clamp(1, 2.6, max(W/(b.w*1.3+1), H/(b.h*1.3+1))), prog = smooth(min(1, (clock - item.t)/item.dur)), crop = lerp.
For 'pan' with box: crop = cover*1.15 fixed, sx/sy centered on bubble center clamped.
For 'none' with box: falls to the idle branch with z = cover.
Idle branch: z = cover (none) or cover*1.12; pan offsets: if ph > 1.2*pw → vertical: sy = clamp(((phase-0.5)*2)*r*0.6 + cy - vh/2, 0, r) with r = max(0, ph - vh); else horizontal sx = clamp((phase-0.5)*2*r*0.8 + cx - vw/2, 0, r), r = max(0, pw - vw). phase = smooth(clamp01((clock - item.t)/(item.dur||1))) (item.t undefined → 0.5).

Note: zoomMode 'zoom' with a box does the Ken Burns zoom; 'zoom' without box → static at cover*1.12 (since the pan branch only for 'pan'/'smart').

Note in the idle branch for 'none': z = cover and the pan branch is skipped, so it's static.

smoothstep: a*a*(3-2a).

Subtitle band: lineH = max(26, C.h*0.055); bandH = lineH*(second ? 2.1 : 1.25) + 26; fill rgba(0,0,0,0.55) over (0, C.h-bandH, C.w, bandH); role label at y = C.h - bandH + 14, font 700 fs, color role.color; main text at y = C.h - (second ? bandH*0.62 : bandH*0.55), maxWidth C.w*0.92; second line font 500 fs*0.72, color #cfd8e8, y = C.h - lineH. fs = max(18, C.h*0.042). textAlign center, baseline middle.

Bubble mode: fill rgba(255,255,255,0.92), stroke role.color else #555, lineWidth = clamp(2, 6, C.w/300), radius min(10, ww/2, hh/2), text color #111, font 600 max(13, ww/14)px, align left, baseline top, pad = max(4, ww*0.04), wrap width = ww - 2*pad, maxLines = max(1, floor((hh - 2*pad)/(measureText('М').width*1.4))), shown = lines.slice(0, maxLines).join(' '), role label font 700 max(11, C.w/130)px at y = max(2, syy - measureText('М').width*1.3).

Export: MediaRecorder(vstream, { mimeType, videoBitsPerSecond: min(16e6, w*h*fps*0.14) }); rec.start(1000) timeslice; guard timeout (total+20)*1000; stop 120ms after end.

ffmpeg args verbatim.

Audio export: sr=44100, frameCount = ceil(total*sr), mixAdd at it.t + pb.offset, resampleLinear if sampleRate differs, music loop with step = m.duration>0 ? m.duration : (total>0?total:1), guard 10000 iterations, music gain (mvol??15)/100*0.6, clipping to [-1,1], pcm = v<0 ? v*0x8000 : v*0x7fff, WAV 16-bit mono.

Note: mixAdd mixes into a mono-summed buffer? No — getChannelData(0) only (first channel). And mix is additive with no soft clipping (only clamp at WAV encode).

MP3: `-codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 4`.

MP3 frame walker algorithm: scan for sync 0xFF & 0xE0; parse header 32-bit; ver = (h>>19)&3, layer = (h>>17)&3 (must be 1), brI = (h>>12)&0xF (not 0, not 0xF), srI = (h>>10)&3 (not 3), pad = (h>>9)&1; tables; len = floor((ver===3 ? 144 : 72) * br * 1000 / sr) + pad; accept if br && sr && len>0 && i+len<=n; push subarray, i += len (fast-forward), else i++ (byte-wise resync). Note: output has no ID3 tags added/removed, no CRC check, no re-encoding; it's a byte-level frame extractor that strips inter-frame garbage. Also note: Edge sends 24 kHz 48 kbps mono MP3 → ver=2 (MPEG2), br table MP3_BR_V2 (48 at index... brI=6 → 48), sr 22050/24000/16000 table.

GEC: as above.

sliceSegments: parameters used by clipsFromAudio: threshold 0.02, minSilence 0.32, minClip 0.3, maxClip 16, winMs default 40. Defaults in signature: threshold 0.02, winMs 40, minSilence 0.3, minClip 0.35, maxClip 15.

Note the important: activity[k] = (sum/win) > threshold² — i.e., compares mean-square against threshold². This is not exactly RMS; it's mean square compared to threshold squared (which equals RMS² vs threshold² → equivalent to RMS > threshold actually! mean square = RMS². So `sum/win > thr*thr` ⇔ RMS > thr. OK, exactly RMS > threshold.) Good, so it IS RMS.

Hmm, careful: sum/win is the mean of v*v = RMS². Comparing to threshold² ⇔ RMS > threshold (both non-negative). So it's exactly RMS > threshold. Good.

trimSilence in import.js is called with defaults { threshold: 0.02, margin: 0.09, winMs: 10 } (not the engine TRIM). Note padSamples = max(1, floor(sr*margin)) — margin in seconds.

Then segs mapped to absolute source time: startS + tStart/sr, endS + tStart/sr. Note endS is NOT clamped by tEnd but body is already trimmed.

### `buildTimeline(project)` — exact algorithm
```
gap = (settings.gap ?? 350) / 1000          // seconds
t = 0
for page in project.pages:                   // order = array order
  if page.bubbles empty:
     items.push({page, pi, bubble:null, t, dur:1.8, kind:'idle'}); t += 1.8; continue
  t += 0.55                                  // page fade-in ("заезд")
  for bi, b in bubbles:
     t += (bi === 0 ? 0.25 : gap)            // pre-roll
     dur = (b.audio && b.audio.duration) ? b.audio.duration : estimateSpeakDur(b.text)
     items.push({page, pi, bubble:b, t, dur, kind:'line'})
     t += dur
     t += gap * 0.6                          // post-gap
  t += 0.5                                   // hold before next page
total = t + 0.9                              // tail pad
```
Item fields: `{ page, pi (index), bubble, t, dur, kind:'idle'|'line' }`. **No transitions, no cross-fades, no per-page offset track.** Idle pages get no 0.55/0.5 and no trailing gap. An empty `pages[]` yields `items:[]` and `total:0.9`.

`estimateSpeakDur(text)`: `0` if `!text.trim()`; else `max(1.1, min(14, len/13 + 0.55)) + (/\s/.test(text) ? 0.15 : 0)` (13 chars/sec).

`roleGain(role)`: `pct = role.volumeNum` if finite number (100 = unity); else parse `role.volume` with `/^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%\s*$/` → `pct = 100 + v`; then `gain = clamp(pct/100, 0, 2)`. Missing role → `1`.

`TRIM = { threshold:0.012, margin:0.05, minDur:0.25 }` — single source of truth for both rendering and duration measurement (engine.js:24).

`previewStart(project, canvas, {w,h}, onProgress, abortToken)` → `{ stop: () => actx.close(), done: Promise }`.

- Decoding progress `p*0.5`; frame progress `0.5 + min(1, clock/total)*0.5`, message `` `предпросмотр: ${fmtDur(clock)} / ${fmtDur(total)}` ``.
- **Item lookup** `currentItem`: last item with `t <= clock` (falls back to `timeline[0]`). Before an item's `t` the previous item is still shown (no black gap).
- **Scheduling** `scheduleAhead`: every frame, `scheduleItem(it)` for all items with `t <= clock + 0.4` (0.4 s look-ahead); `scheduled` Set keyed by `bubble.id` (dedup).
- Graph: `BufferSource → Gain(roleGain) → master(Gain=1) → MediaStreamDestination`. `src.start(started + it.t, pb.offset, Math.min(pb.dur, it.dur + 0.1))` — offset = trimmed start sample, length capped at `dur + 0.1 s`.

- Abort: `abortToken.then(...)` sets `stopped`; canvas loop exits when `clock >= total`.

### MP3 frame walker `cleanMp3Frames(bytes)` (util.js:270)
Tables: `MP3_BR_V1=[0,32,40,48,56,64,80,96,112,128,160,192,224,256,320]` (kbps), `MP3_BR_V2=[0,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64,80,96,112,128,144,160]`, `MP3_SR_V1=[44100,48000,32000]`, `MP3_SR_V2s=[22050,24000,16000]`, `MP3_SR_V25=[11025,12000,8000]`.
```
i = 0
while i < n-4:
  if bytes[i]==0xff && (bytes[i+1] & 0xe0)==0xe0:
     h = BE32(bytes[i..i+3]) >>> 0
     ver=(h>>19)&3  (0=V2.5,1=res,2=V2,3=V1);  layer=(h>>17)&3 (must be 1)
     brI=(h>>12)&0xF (reject 0 and 0xF);  srI=(h>>10)&3 (reject 3)
     pad=(h>>9)&1
     if ver in {3,2,0} && layer==1 && brI∉{0,15} && srI!=3:
        br,sr = (V1:BR_V1/SR_V1) | (V2:BR_V2/SR_V2s) | (V2.5:BR_V2/SR_V25)
        len = floor((ver==3 ? 144 : 72) * br * 1000 / sr) + pad
        if br && sr && len>0 && i+len<=n:  emit bytes[i..i+len); i += len; continue
  i += 1                               // byte-wise resync
```
Output = concatenation of the surviving frames; **no ID3v2/ID3v1 parsing or rewriting, no CRC check, no re-encode** — it only strips inter-frame garbage that Edge's binary WebSocket chunks inject. Duration is never computed from frames (see §7: trimmed PCM is measured instead). Edge sends MPEG-2 L3 @ 48 kbps / 24 kHz ⟹ `ver=2`, `brI=6` (48), `srI=1` (24000), `len = floor(72*48000/24000) + pad = 144 + pad`. Synthesis handshake: `outputFormat:"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3"`; each binary WS message is `u16 headerLen` + `headerLen` bytes + 2 bytes ⟹ payload `subarray(2 + hl + 2)` (voices.js:235).

## 7. Silence splitting (`sliceSegments`, util.js:215; used by "нарезки голосов")
Signature defaults: `{ threshold = 0.02, winMs = 40, minSilence = 0.3, minClip = 0.35, maxClip = 15 }`. `clipsFromAudio` (import.js:168) calls it with `threshold:0.02, minSilence:0.32, minClip:0.3, maxClip:16`.
```
win = max(1, floor(sr*winMs/1000));  steps = floor(n/win)
activity[k] = (sum(v*v for k*win .. k*win+win) / win) > threshold^2     // ⇔ RMS > threshold
minSil = max(1, floor(minSilence / (winMs/1000)))                       // silent windows
state machine over k in [0..steps] (k==steps ⇒ act=0):
  act   : if !inClip {inClip=true; cStart=k}; silence=0; cEnd=k
  !act  : if inClip { silence++; if silence>=minSil → emit, inClip=false }
emit: s = cStart*win/sr ; e = min(n, (cEnd+1)*win)/sr
      if e-s >= minClip → push {startS:s, endS: min(e, s+maxClip)}
after loop: if still inClip → same emit (tail segment with no trailing silence)
```
**No padding is added to segment edges** (contrast `trimSilence`). Pre-pass in `clipsFromAudio`: `trimSilence(samples, sr)` with the **util defaults** `{ threshold:0.02, margin:0.09, winMs:10 }` (NOT the engine's `TRIM`); the body is sliced and offsets converted back: `startS + tStart/sr`, `endS + tStart/sr`. Also downmixes all channels to mono by averaging first.
`trimSilence(samples, sr, {threshold=0.02, margin=0.09, winMs=10})`: `win = max(1, floor(sr*winMs/1000))`, `padSamples = max(1, floor(sr*margin))` (**margin in seconds, converted to samples, not bytes**); forward scan for first window with **peak** `> threshold` ⟹ `start = max(0, i-padSamples)`; backward scan ⟹ `end = min(n, i+win+padSamples)`; pure silence ⟹ `{start:0,end:0}`.
Engine variant (`trimmedPlayRange`): `TRIM` = threshold `0.012`, margin `0.05 s`, minDur `0.25`; result `dur = max(0.25, (end-start)/sr)`.

## 8. Bubble clustering (`clusterBubbleWords`, util.js:113)
Input `words:[{x,y,w,h,text}]`, `pageW`, `pageH`.
```
thrX = max(14, pageW*0.055)
thrY = max(12, pageH*0.028)
for all i<j (O(n²)):
  gapX = max(0, max(a.x,b.x) - min(a.x+a.w, b.x+b.w))
  gapY = max(0, max(a.y,b.y) - min(a.y+a.h, b.y+b.h))
  if gapX < thrX && gapY < thrY: union(i,j)          // union-find, path halving
group → bbox = min x/y, max x+w / y+h
       text = words sorted by (y, x) → join(' ') → /\s+/g→' ' → trim()
return {rect:[x,y,w,h], x, y, w, h, text, words}
```
Reading order `sortBubblesReadingOrder(bubbles, {rtl=false, vertical=false, cols=2})`: `pageW/pageH = max(x+w) / max(y+h)` over bubbles (||1). Horizontal mode: `bands = 6`, `band = min(5, floor((y + h/2)/(pageH/6)))`, sort band asc then x asc (rtl: `(x+w)` desc). Vertical mode: `col = floor(x/(pageW/cols))`, sort col asc (rtl desc) then y, x.
`estimatePauseMs(text)`: base 220; last char `?`/`!`/`…` ⟹ +140, `.`/`;` ⟹ +70; `+ min(220, len*7)`. **Unused by the timeline** (engine uses the fixed constants in §1) — informational only.

### Port-critical divergences to decide
- Web path is rAF-clock + `captureStream(fps)`; MediaCodec wants deterministic PTS `k/fps`. Use `total` rounded up to a whole frame count for the last frame.
- Web path mixes audio in real time through WebAudio; native should pre-render the whole bus to PCM (reuse §6 math exactly) and feed MediaCodec — that also makes the `min(pb.dur, it.dur+0.1)` cap and the `+0.1 s` tail deterministic.
- `drawImage` crop → dest stretch is non-uniform-free (same aspect by construction because `cover` guarantees fill); Android `Canvas.drawBitmap(bitmap, srcRect, dstRect, paint)` with `FILTER_BITMAP` reproduces it exactly.
- `measureText` based line metrics (`М` width × 1.4 for line height, × 1.3 for the role-label offset) have no native analogue — pin the same Roboto/system-ui weights (600/700/500) and accept ±1-line differences, or hardcode ratios measured on-device.
